mounts.name: Abyss Worm
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Mistress Sassz'ine
Location: Tomb of Sargeras
mounts.desc: The shadows that trail off of its scales are otherworldly, is this creature from the depths of Azeroth's oceans?

mounts.name: Accented Pseudoshell
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: The plants of the deep lands often emulate the creatures of of Azeroth. The purpose of the mimicry is unknown, but can be quite disturbing when the terrestrial mollusks are on the wrong end of an arboreal meal.

mounts.name: Acherus Deathcharger
mounts.srcText: Trainer: Death Knight
mounts.desc: Some horses merely adopt the dark. This horse was born in it, molded by it.

mounts.name: Acid Belcher
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Skreeg the Devourer
Zone: Eredath
mounts.desc: Twice as acid-filled as the usual fiend.

mounts.name: Acidic Void Creeper
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Shad'anis
Zone: K'aresh
Cost: 7 Untethered Coin
mounts.desc: This creeper has feasted on noxious fumes resulting in its body being infused with powerful acids.

mounts.name: Admiralty Stallion
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Provisioner Fray
Zone: Tiragarde Sound
Faction: Proudmoore Admiralty - Exalted
Cost: 10000g
mounts.desc: These sleek white stallions are the few mounts allowed to embark on Kul Tiran ships.

mounts.name: Adorned Northeron Gryphon
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: The elder gryphon riders and high shamans of the Northeron Wildhammer often adorned their gryphons in ornate, feather-clad pieces, indicating their rank and status.

mounts.name: Adorned Vombata
mounts.srcText: Profession: Protoform Synthesis
mounts.desc: Red-colored vombata are considered lucky by the Enlightened. It was a red vombata that was present when they first arrived in Zereth Mortis.

mounts.name: Aerial Unit R-21/X
mounts.srcText: Drop: King Mechagon
mounts.desc: King Mechagon's private aerial unit, complete with deployable blast cannon and foot warmers.

mounts.name: Alabaster Hyena
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Hoarder Jena
Zone: Vol'dun
Faction: Voldunai - Exalted
Cost: 10000g
mounts.desc: These hyena are used by the Voldunai to quickly move unseen throughout the sands.

mounts.name: Alabaster Stormtalon
mounts.srcText: Trading Post / Shop
mounts.desc: Chiseled by the stonemasons of Stormwind, this stone gryphon symbolizes the unbending courage of the Alliance.

mounts.name: Alabaster Thunderwing
mounts.srcText: Trading Post / Shop
mounts.desc: Chiseled by the stoneworkers of Orgrimmar, this stone wind rider is a symbol of the unwavering strength of the Horde.

mounts.name: Albino Drake
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Leading the Cavalry
Category: General
mounts.desc: Even the Draconic Native Association tests proved inconclusive in determining if the albino drake is related to a known dragonflight. -Breanni

mounts.name: Albino Mana Ray
mounts.srcText: World Event: WoW Remix: Legion
mounts.desc: The shattering of Argus caused the mana rays to mutate and adapt to their surroundings. Some of them abandoned their pigments in favor of strengthening their senses.

mounts.name: Algarian Stormrider
mounts.srcText: Promotion: The War Within Heroic Edition
mounts.desc: Flying true even in the harshest conditions, this lightning-infused rook was trained to soar through the skies of the Isle of Dorn and into the depths below.

mounts.name: Alunira
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Alunira
Zone: Isle of Dorn
mounts.desc: For so long, the very embodiment of the clouds laid trapped atop a mountain of lightning. And at last, I can feel the wind at my back once again.

mounts.name: Amalgam of Rage
mounts.srcText: Promotion: Diablo IV
mounts.desc: The fearsome beast ridden by Astaroth himself is now yours to command.

mounts.name: Amani Battle Bear
mounts.srcText: Drop: Kasha's Bag
mounts.desc: The Amani trolls decorate these ferocious mounts in magic amulets and ceremonial masks as a way to venerate the bear god Nalorakk.

mounts.name: Amani Blessed Bear
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Magovu
Zone: Zul'Aman
Cost: 6000 Voidlight Marl
mounts.desc: Once symbols of conquest, these war-bears now stride again, reborn through Nalorakk's blessing and the renewed spirit of the Amani.

mounts.name: Amani Dragonhawk
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Landro Longshot
Location: Booty Bay
mounts.desc: Dragonhawks liberated from troll enslavement are considered among the most loyal of all their kin.

mounts.name: Amani Hex Bear
mounts.desc: Tricked into fighting along the Hex, this fierce creature now fights for the Amani tribe, hoping to find its way back into the good graces of Nalorakk.

mounts.name: Amani Hunting Bear
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Cupri
Zone: Shattrath City
Cost: 5000 Timewarped Badge
mounts.desc: The Amani trolls ride this fierce creature on ceremonial hunts in honor of the bear god Nalorakk.

mounts.name: Amani Sharptalon
mounts.srcText: Drop: Zul'Aman Rare Creatures
mounts.desc: A rare variety of the Amani eagle, Sharptalons strike with terrifying precision and fly with unparalleled grace.

mounts.name: Amani Sunfeather
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Chel the Chip
Feature: Abundance
Cost: 1600 Unalloyed Abundance
mounts.desc: Born of Abundance and the forest's renewal, these eagles gleam in the setting sun, a living sign of the Amani's rekindled strength.

mounts.name: Amani Windcaller
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Magovu
Zone: Zul'Aman
Cost: 8000 Voidlight Marl
mounts.desc: Swift as the storm and sharp as lightning, these sacred eagles bear the mark of Akil'zon, carrying their riders on the winds of her blessing.

mounts.name: Amber Ardenmoth
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Wild Hunt Supplies
Zone: Ardenweald
mounts.desc: The brilliant orange hue of the amber ardenmoth signals to predators that it is dangerous to eat. Consuming one of these creatures will put a predator into a dreamless sleep for years.

mounts.name: Amber Primordial Direhorn
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Zandalari Warbringer
Zone: Dread Wastes, Kun-Lai Summit, Townlong Steppes, Valley of the Four Winds
mounts.desc: There is an old Zandalari saying about wild direhorns: "Run!"

mounts.name: Amber Pterrordax
mounts.srcText: World Event: WoW Remix: Mists of Pandaria
mounts.desc: The Pterrordax could and would eat you in seconds. Are you sure sitting on its back is a good idea?

mounts.name: Amber Scorpion
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Ambersmith Zikk
Zone: Dread Wastes
Faction: The Klaxxi - Exalted
Cost: 10000g
mounts.desc: The Klaxxi ride massive scorpions into battle against their enemies. A carapace hardened by amber provides superior protection while on the battlefield.

mounts.name: Amber Shardhide
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Duchess Mynx
Zone: Korthia
Faction: Death's Advance - Revered
Cost: 5000 Stygia
mounts.desc: The bright colors of Korthian wildlife indicate that they have either few predators, or are tough enough to fight back.

mounts.name: Amber Skitterfly
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: A gift from Granpap Whiskers to the Trading Post, amber skitterflies are remarkably docile.

mounts.name: Amberback Arboon
mounts.srcText: In-Game Shop
mounts.desc: The golden blossoms of the amberback arboon are a sign of its age and wisdom. A rarity among rarities, even seeing one is considered good luck.

mounts.name: Amethyst Mechsuit
mounts.srcText: Vendor: Lindormi
mounts.desc: Where diamond reflects perfection, amethyst resonates with power.

mounts.name: Amethyst Ruinstrider
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Toraan the Revered
Zone: Argus
Faction: Argussian Reach - Exalted
Cost: 10000g
mounts.desc: Talbuks, native to Argus, have evolved chitinous plates to survive the decades of ceaseless war that ravages the landscape.

mounts.name: Ancestral Clefthoof
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: This clefthoof has seen ages pass, witnessing everything and patiently teaching many to ride.

mounts.name: Ancestral War Bear
mounts.srcText:
Treasure: Honored Warrior's Cache
Zone: Zul'Aman
mounts.desc: Its tread resounds with the memory of ancient warriors, a living symbol of the unwavering ferocity the Amani revere.

mounts.name: Ancient Salamanther
mounts.srcText: Drop: The Forbidden Reach
mounts.desc: Due to their preference for dark caves and murky waters, sightings of this unique breed of salamanther are so rare that many researchers thought they had gone extinct.

mounts.name: Ankoan Waveray
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Artisan Okata
Zone: Nazjatar
Faction: Ankoan - Exalted
Cost: 250 Prismatic Manapearl
mounts.desc: The Ankoan have been battling the naga for years, and with a natural affinity for the sea, training the local wildlife was a natural strategy.

mounts.name: Anointed Protostag
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Vilo
Zone: Zereth Mortis
Faction: The Enlightened - Revered
Cost: 5000 Reservoir Anima
mounts.desc: Only those most esteemed by the Enlightened are trusted with the reins of this rare cervid.

mounts.name: Antoran Charhound
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Shatug
Zone: Antorus, the Burning Throne
mounts.desc: Sargeras' own hound was maybe once a felstalker, but over the years the Dark Titan reforged and reshaped his companion into something much more powerful. When, at last, he was pleased with his creation, he set about creating more of the hounds, and imbuing them with shadow and flame.

mounts.name: Antoran Gloomhound
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Glory of the Argus Raider
Category: Dungeons & Raids
mounts.desc: Sargeras' own hound was maybe once a felstalker, but over the years the Dark Titan reforged and reshaped his companion into something much more powerful. When, at last, he was pleased with his creation, he set about creating more of the hounds, and imbuing them with shadow and flame.

mounts.name: Anu'relos, Flame's Guidance
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Fyrakk
Zone: Amirdrassil, the Dream's Hope (Mythic)
mounts.desc: Though her feathers flicker with flame's destructive potential, they do not scorch, but simply radiate a comfortable heat.

mounts.name: Anu'shalla, Shadow's Guidance
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Insurmountable Collection
Category: Mounts
mounts.desc: Her wings cut through the sky like shadows on a moonlit night.

mounts.name: Apophic Soul Crusher
mounts.srcText: Achievement: Let Me Solo Him: Azta'rec
mounts.desc: Once powered by the arcane, now fueled solely by the tortured spirits of the unfaithful.

mounts.name: Aquamarine Basilisk
mounts.srcText: World Event: WoW Remix: Legion
mounts.desc: Despite their name, aquamarine basilisks feast on a variety of coastal crystals and oceanic rocks.

mounts.name: Aquamarine Swarmite
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Lady Vinazian
Zone: Azj-Kahet
Cost: 3940 Kej
Vendor: Y'tekhi
Zone: Azj-Kahet
Cost: 3940 Kej
mounts.desc: While it's not exactly common, the representatives of the Severed Threads assure you that swarmites are more than capable of carrying your weight if you choose to ride it.

mounts.name: Arboreal Gulper
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Humon'gozz
Zone: Ardenweald
mounts.desc: The wood and foliage growing atop this toad is a natural part of its body, helping it siphon anima from the air to nourish itself.

mounts.name: Arboreal Pseudoshell
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: The plants of the deep lands often emulate the creatures of Azeroth. The purpose of the mimicry is unknown, but can be quite disturbing when the terrestrial mollusks are on the wrong end of an arboreal meal.

mounts.name: Arcadian War Turtle
mounts.srcText: Vendor: Xur'ios
mounts.desc: Bred for destruction by an insane warlord in a far-off land, but at least the seat is warm.

mounts.name: Arcanist's Manasaber
mounts.srcText:
Quest: Fate of the Nightborne
Zone: Suramar
mounts.desc:
Upon her return to The Nighthold, First Arcanist Thalyssra saw to it that adventurers who helped her liberate Suramar were rewarded with prized mounts from the royal stable.
Summoning this mount in Suramar City will also apply Masquerade.

mounts.name: Arcanovoid Construct
mounts.srcText: Achievement: Let Me Solo Him: Nullaeus
mounts.desc: The Void's influence is far-reaching and overpowering enough that even an Arcane Guardian can be made to kneel.

mounts.name: Arcberry Manasaber
mounts.srcText: World Event: WoW Remix: Legion
mounts.desc: Named for their resemblance to the bright berries made into arcwine, these proud cats have a keen awareness of the ley lines that travel beneath them.

mounts.name: Archmage's Felscorned Disc
mounts.srcText: World Event: WoW Remix: Legion
mounts.desc: Some mages say fel magics are "volatile" or "corruptive" or "forbidden". Some mages are wrong.

mounts.name: Archmage's Great Raven
mounts.srcText: In-Game Shop
mounts.desc: Perhaps a little older and a bit more gray instead of customary darkened midnight, this raven still represents one of the most powerful arcane masters of Azeroth, the Guardian Khadgar.

mounts.name: Archmage's Prismatic Disc
mounts.srcText: Quest: Dispersion of the Discs
mounts.desc: Three elements have been fused to create this magical disc, which is attuned to your specific magical powers.

mounts.name: Ardenweald Wilderling
mounts.srcText:
Covenant: Night Fae
Zone: Ardenweald
mounts.desc: As anima flows to the distant wealds of Ardenweald once more, the wilderlings awaken and cautiously emerge from their canopy burrows.

mounts.name: Argent Charger
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Dame Evniki Kapsalis
Zone: Icecrown
Cost: 100 Champion's Seal
mounts.desc: Trained to accept only champions of the Light as a rider.

mounts.name: Argent Hippogryph
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Faction Quartermasters
Location: Argent Tournament, Icecrown
Cost: 150 Champion's Seal
mounts.desc: Argent Hippogryphs will partner with only the bravest and most battle-tested champions.

mounts.name: Argent Warhorse
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Dame Evniki Kapsalis
Zone: Icecrown
Cost: 100 Champion's Seal
mounts.desc: Given only to those who prove themselves a champion in the Argent Tournament.

mounts.name: Armored Bloodwing
mounts.srcText: In-Game Shop
mounts.desc: This monstrous, flesh-eating bat is the undisputed ruler of the night skies.

mounts.name: Armored Blue Dragonhawk
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Mount Parade
Category: General
mounts.desc: After you amassed a massive menagerie of 200 mounts, the animal authorities of the Alliance sent you a means to keep them in line (and out of their hair).

mounts.name: Armored Blue Wind Rider
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Mei Francis
Zone: Crystalsong Forest
Cost: 2000g
mounts.desc: They are not native to Northrend, but they have adapted extremely well to the cold. -Mei Francis

mounts.name: Armored Bonehoof Tauralus
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Sabriel the Bonecleaver
Covenant: Necrolord
Zone: Maldraxxus
mounts.desc: A favored mount of the House of the Chosen, the tauralus only gets more angry and vicious when exposed to battle.

mounts.name: Armored Brown Bear
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Mei Francis
Zone: Crystalsong Forest
Cost: 750g
mounts.desc: This ursine mount's swiftness is enhanced by its heavy armor, imbued with magic from Kirin Tor magi.

mounts.name: Armored Brown Bear
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Mei Francis
Zone: Crystalsong Forest
Cost: 750g
mounts.desc: Your cries of "For the Horde!" will be much more menacing from atop a heavily armored bear that's barreling down on Alliance at top speed.

mounts.name: Armored Chosen Tauralus
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Things To Do When You're Dead
Category: Covenant Sanctums
mounts.desc: The tauralus has two tails, which are both absolutely necessary for whipping away buzzing pests like the bloodlouse.

mounts.name: Armored Frostboar
mounts.srcText: Achievement: Advanced Husbandry
mounts.desc: Subsists almost entirely on a diet of frozen berries. Though it finds slow off-worlders equally tasty.

mounts.name: Armored Frostwolf
mounts.srcText: Achievement: The Stable Master
mounts.desc: It's trained to survive the harsh climate of Frostfire Ridge, so it snuggles as if its life depended on it.

mounts.name: Armored Golden Pterrordax
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: Painted and adorned with gold, these Pterrordax patrol the skies over the tomb of Atal'Dazar.

mounts.name: Armored Irontusk
mounts.srcText:
Vendor:
Faction: Sha'tari Defense - Exalted
Location: Garrison Trading Post
Cost: 5,000g + 5,000 Apexis Crystal
mounts.desc: It is said an elekk never forgets. No wonder it despises the Iron Horde, considering the torment the orcs put the beast through.

mounts.name: Armored Plaguerot Tauralus
mounts.srcText:
Covenant: Necrolord
Vendor: Su Zettai
Zone: Maldraxxus
Cost: 3000 Reservoir Anima
mounts.desc: When fully armored, a tauralus can take an incredible amount of damage before falling, making it a valuable ally in battle.

mounts.name: Armored Razorback
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Vengeance, Deathtalon, Terrorfist, Doomroller
Zone: Tanaan Jungle
mounts.desc: Never... ever... EVER... let it smell bacon on you.

mounts.name: Armored Razzashi Raptor
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Bloodlord Mandokir
Zone: Zul'Gurub
mounts.desc: The purebred royal raptors of Zul'Gurub, these mounts have become a rare sight in Stranglethorn Vale. The Gurubashi have been known to fly into a rage at the sight of any non-troll riding one of their precious beasts.

mounts.name: Armored Red Dragonhawk
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Mount Parade
Category: General
mounts.desc: This rare breed of dragonhawk is a mark of honor in the Horde, gifted by the blood elves. It reflects your tireless effort to amass a small army of mounts.

mounts.name: Armored Siege Kodo
mounts.srcText: Trading Post / Shop
mounts.desc: Only the strongest and most fearless of kodos can be trained to become living siege weapons. Even the highest walls won't keep them out for long.

mounts.name: Armored Skyscreamer
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Glory of the Thundering Raider
Category: Dungeons & Raids
mounts.desc: Only those heroic souls who surmount every challenge the mogu tyrants place before them can proudly fly the skies on a war-prepared skyscreamer.

mounts.name: Armored Snowy Gryphon
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Mei Francis
Zone: Crystalsong Forest
Cost: 2000g
mounts.desc: The nice thing is that when they attack, blood almost never stains their feathers. -Mei Francis

mounts.name: Armored Vorquin Leystrider
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Treysh
Zone: The Forbidden Reach
Cost: 80g
Vendor: Tethalash
Zone: Valdrakken
Cost: 80g
mounts.desc: Trained using ancient dracthyr methods, these armored vorquin are the pinnacle of tactical mounted ground warfare.

mounts.name: Armored War-Bred Tauralus
mounts.srcText:
Covenant: Necrolord
Zone: Maldraxxus
mounts.desc: The tauralus that serve the armies of Maldraxxus have had all traits of compassion bred out of them, and are only adorned in armor when they show that no sword or spell can stop them from carrying their rider to victory.

mounts.name: Ascendant Skyrazor
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Queen Ansurek
Zone: Nerub-ar Palace (Mythic)
mounts.desc: Intended for the most devoted of the Sureki elite, these skyrazors were favored by Queen Ansurek for both their cunning and brutality.

mounts.name: Ascendant's Aquilon
mounts.srcText:
Covenant: Kyrian
Vendor: Adjutant Galos
Zone: Bastion
Cost: 7500 Reservoir Anima
mounts.desc: The aquilon can rapidly transport aspirants, stewards, and even ascended to a location. Hey, sometimes your wings get tired.

mounts.name: Ascended Skymane
mounts.srcText:
Treasure: Cache of the Ascended
Zone: Bastion
mounts.desc: Only those that have proven themselves against the combined might of the Ascended will be able to ride this mount.

mounts.name: Ash'adar, Harbinger of Dawn
mounts.srcText: Trading Post / Shop
mounts.desc: Kaldorei legends whisper of a relentless hunter prowling amongst the deepest shadows of Kalimdor, never sleeping. By the light of the sun or the moon, Ash'adar now hunts with you.

mounts.name: Ashen Pandaren Phoenix
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: World Vendors
Cost: 1 Ancestral Phoenix Egg
mounts.desc: Both the name and color of this majestic phoenix are believed to symbolize rebirth.

mounts.name: Ashenvale Chimaera
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Alash'anir
Zone: Darkshore
mounts.desc: Ashenvale chimaeras were used frequently by the Kaldorei to decimate structures in battles against the humans, orcs, and undead.

mounts.name: Ashes of Al'ar
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Kael'thas Sunstrider
Location: The Eye, Tempest Keep
mounts.desc: Al'ar was the beloved pet of Kael'thas Sunstrider, who often boasted that death would never claim it. Perhaps he was right.

mounts.name: Ashes of Belo'ren
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Midnight Falls
Location: March on Quel'Danas (Mythic)
mounts.desc: One of Al'ar's last clutch, Belo'ren was taken to the Isle of Quel'Danas and raised to defend the Sunwell from any who would threaten it with his very life. It is said that death will never claim him.

mounts.name: Ashhide Mushan Beast
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Speaker Gulan
Zone: Timeless Isle
Cost: 500 Bloody Coin
mounts.desc: Some people say that riding an ashhide mushan will result in favorable health and increased prosperity. These people are called "mount vendors."

mounts.name: Ashplague Fel Bat
mounts.srcText: World Event: WoW Remix: Legion
mounts.desc: Only the mightiest of heroes ride into battle atop this monstrosity borne of fel and undeath.

mounts.name: Asset Advocator
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Skedgit Cinderbangs
Zone: Undermine
Cost: 25 Miscellaneous Mechanica
mounts.desc: Assuring others that your assets are exactly where they should be.

mounts.name: Astral Aurochs
mounts.srcText: In-Game Shop
mounts.desc: Victory is not a simple matter of strength, but having the wisdom and ability to deliver the strength where it is needed most.

mounts.name: Astral Cloud Serpent
mounts.srcText: Drop: Cache of Pure Energy
mounts.desc: It is believed that Astral Cloud Serpents possess answers to some of life's greatest mysteries. Pity they can't talk.

mounts.name: Astral Emperor's Serpent
mounts.srcText: World Event: WoW Remix: Mists of Pandaria
mounts.desc: After the unburdened Emperor Shaohao gave his final breath to protect his people, a golden serpent descended from the heavens to alight the emperor's spirit to the peaks of Kun-Lai Summit.

mounts.name: Augmented Stormray
mounts.srcText: Drop: Voidstorm Rare Creatures
mounts.desc: Captured from K'aresh and mutated by Charonus, this stormray escaped from Voidscar Arena and has wandered the Voidstorm.

mounts.name: August Phoenix
mounts.srcText: World Event: Mists of Pandaria: Remix
mounts.desc: The magnificent August Phoenixes are blessed by Chi-Ji to fill the hearts of riders with wonder and hope for the future.

mounts.name: Auriferous Venomfang
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Treasures of the Coiled Isle
Category: Midnight
mounts.desc: Its stealth foiled by bright scales, this venomfang lurks among hidden treasure for the next meal.

mounts.name: Auspicious Arborwyrm
mounts.srcText: In-Game Shop
mounts.desc: Sprouting to life only once every sixty years, this living wooden dragon combines the patience of a tree and the grace of a dragon in flight.

mounts.name: Autumn Harvesthog
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: Autumn Harvesthogs excel in snuffling for food in the cooler months. Their keen sense of smell makes them excellent companions for a forrest forage, but difficult to control in aromatic settings.

mounts.name: Autumnal Wilderling
mounts.srcText:
Covenant: Night Fae
Vendor: Elwyn
Zone: Ardenweald
Cost: 7500 Reservoir Anima
mounts.desc: The wilderlings are benevolent, magical creatures of Ardenweald, and are drawn to souls that are strong and pure.

mounts.name: Autumnal Witchwick's Rider
mounts.srcText: In-Game Shop
mounts.desc: Sleek, stylish, and spooky, the Witchwick Rider offers a smooth and surprisingly comfortable ride, thanks to the ergonomic saddle requested by many a spellcaster seeking cushioned support.

mounts.name: Avenging Felcrusher
mounts.srcText: Drop: Gleaming Footlocker
mounts.desc: After Alleria and Turalyon explained the usefulness of the Draenei's long-time companion animal, the Army of the Light brought several into the fold for training.

mounts.name: Awakened Mindborer
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Battle for Azeroth Keystone Master: Season Four
Category: Dungeons
mounts.desc: It may look menacing right now, but it's actually kind of cute when it's asleep.

mounts.name: Azshari Bloatray
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Glory of the Eternal Raider
Category: Dungeons & Raids
mounts.desc: The naga raised these rays in captivity, harvesting their gas organs to craft alchemy which allowed them to breathe air more easily.

mounts.name: Azure Cloud Serpent
mounts.srcText:
Quest: Riding the Skies
Zone: The Jade Forest
mounts.desc: Azure Cloud Serpents are believed by the Pandaren to be harbingers of good fortune.

mounts.name: Azure Drake
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Alexstrasza's Gift
Location: Eye of Eternity
mounts.desc: Always speak politely to an enraged dragon.

mounts.name: Azure Netherwing Drake
mounts.srcText:
Quest: Suraku the Azure Netherwing Drake
Zone: Shattrath City, Outland
mounts.desc: After promising to fly you to the ends of Outland, the netherwing drake was eventually drawn to the blue skies of Azeroth as well.

mounts.name: Azure Riding Crane
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Jaluu the Generous
Zone: Vale of Eternal Blossoms
Faction: Golden Lotus - Exalted
Cost: 500g
mounts.desc: The majestic crane is a treasured friend of the pandaren.

mounts.name: Azure Skitterfly
mounts.srcText:
Faction: Dragonscale Expedition
Renown: 25
Vendor: Granpap Whiskers
Location: Dragonscale Basecamp
Cost: 5 Iridescent Plume 20 Contoured Fowlfeather 750 Dragon Isles Supplies
mounts.desc: Once Granpap Whiskers finally taught them how to take riders, the azure skitterflies proved to bond closely and loyally to their riders.

mounts.name: Azure Void Flyer
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: The War Within Keystone Master: Season Three
Category: Dungeons
mounts.desc: Twisted by the void, these winged creatures now rule the skies of K'aresh.

mounts.name: Azure Water Strider
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Nat Pagle
Zone: Krasarang Wilds
Faction: The Anglers - Exalted
Cost: 1000g
mounts.desc: "Normally bugs are for bait, but how could you look into its eyes and even think that?" -Nat Pagle

mounts.name: Azure Worldchiller

Drop: Doomwalker
Zone: Tanaris
mounts.desc: In the corners of Azeroth, stories are told of a dreaded dragon who swept a pall of torment over the land. In some versions of this story, his fiery presence brought cataclysmic death and destruction worldwide. In other versions, he is blue.

mounts.name: Azureshell Krolusk
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Provisioner Stoutforge
Zone: Tiragarde Sound
Cost: 200 7th Legion Service Medal
mounts.desc: Captured from the desolate sands of Vol'dun, this mount is surprisingly docile in captivity.

mounts.name: Badlands Buzzard
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: The white buzzards are some of the rarest in all the Badlands. Rumor has it that one may even be caught and tamed to fight alongside hunters.

mounts.name: Ballistic Bronco
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Ulaani
Zone: Bizmo's Brawlpub
Vendor: Tiana Nevermorn
Zone: Brawl'gar Arena
Faction: Brawler's Guild (Rank 8)
Cost: 10000g
mounts.desc: Ideal transportation for a Brawler that always hits their mark.

mounts.name: Ban-Lu, Grandmaster's Companion
mounts.srcText: Quest: The Trial of Ban-Lu
mounts.desc: The child of Xuen, Ban-Lu has served each Grandmaster faithfully for many years.

mounts.name: Banshee's Chilling Charger
mounts.srcText: Trading Post

mounts.name: Banshee's Sickening Charger
mounts.srcText: Trading Post

mounts.name: Battle Gargon Silessa
mounts.srcText:
Covenant: Venthyr
Zone: Revendreth
mounts.desc: Silessa fought valiantly alongside her master in the great incursion by the Light, following the battle her master set her to guard over a vault room of great value.

mounts.name: Battle Gargon Vrednic
mounts.srcText:
Covenant: Venthyr
Zone: Revendreth
mounts.desc: Prince Renathal's loyal gargon, Vrednic has been by his side for millennia. Adorned in his Sinvyr armor, Vrednic's mere presence instills terror to all those who lay eyes on him as he ushers his rider into battle.

mounts.name: Battle-Bound Warhound
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Theater of Pain
Zone: Maldraxxus
mounts.desc: Warhounds find comfort in conflict, and the Contest of Conquest is the perfect place to find these beasts honing their abilities.

mounts.name: Battle-Hardened Aquilon
mounts.srcText:
Covenant: Kyrian
Vendor: Duchess Mynx
Zone: Korthia
Cost: 1000 Stygia
Achievement: On the Offensive
mounts.desc: The aquilon can be a valuable ally in combat, with capabilities exceeding those of the phalynx.

mounts.name: Battlefield Swarmer
mounts.srcText:
Covenant: Necrolord
Vendor: Duchess Mynx
Zone: Korthia
Cost: 1000 Stygia
Achievement: On the Offensive
mounts.desc: Corpseflies are strongly attracted to the smell of dead bodies and will swarm an active battlefield as soon as the first corpse falls.

mounts.name: Battlelord's Bloodthirsty War Wyrm
mounts.srcText: Quest: The Trial of Rage
mounts.desc: Also responds to "Mister Bitey."

mounts.name: Beastlord's Irontusk
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Kronnus
Zone: Warspear
Cost: 5000 Timewarped Badge
Vendor: Tempra
Zone: Stormshield
Cost: 5000 Timewarped Badge
mounts.desc: One of Darmac's trained beasts, its tusks can pierce even the hardest Iron Horde steel.

mounts.name: Beastlord's Warwolf
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Kronnus
Zone: Warspear
Cost: 5000 Timewarped Badge
Vendor: Tempra
Zone: Stormshield
Cost: 5000 Timewarped Badge
mounts.desc: One of Darmac's trained beasts, it was raised in a crucible of molten fire and shows no fear.

mounts.name: Beledar's Spawn
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Beledar's Spawn
Zone: Hallowfall
mounts.desc: Through the Sacred Flame, whispers of dark carry you to battle.

mounts.name: Beryl Ruinstrider
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Toraan the Revered
Zone: Argus
Faction: Argussian Reach - Exalted
Cost: 10000g
mounts.desc: Talbuks, native to Argus, have evolved chitinous plates to survive the decades of ceaseless war that ravages the landscape.

mounts.name: Beryl Shardhide
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Death's Advance Supplies
Zone: Korthia
mounts.desc: These shardhides find it easy to hide in the underbrush, and it is rare to find one that is tamed.

mounts.name: Bestowed Ohuna Spotter
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Wake Me Up
Category: Exploration
mounts.desc: A gift from the Ohn'ir, these ohuna are invaluable companions when scouting new horizons for the Dragonscale Expedition.

mounts.name: Bestowed Ottuk Vanguard
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Flight Club
Category: Exploration
mounts.desc: A gift from Brena, the Iskaara sent their most loyal (and adorable) companions to watch over Kalecgos and his reuinited family in Valdrakken

mounts.name: Bestowed Sandskimmer
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Closing Time
Category: Exploration
mounts.desc: A gift from Granpap Whiskers, these capricious skitterflies help the Timewalkers clean up present (and future) sand-related temporal calamities.

mounts.name: Bestowed Thunderspine Packleader
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Centaur of Attention
Category: Exploration
mounts.desc: A gift from Merithra, who blessed these thunderspines to ensure that no matter where the Maruuk clans roam, they will always be under the green dragonflight's protection.

mounts.name: Bestowed Trawling Mammoth
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Army of the Fed
Category: Exploration
mounts.desc: A gift from Scout Tomul, so that the feasts of Iskaara will always have enough fish to feed those in need.

mounts.name: Big Battle Bear
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Landro Longshot
Location: Booty Bay
mounts.desc: He's big, he's ready for battle, and he's a bear. What more could you want in a mount?

mounts.name: Big Blizzard Bear
mounts.srcText: Promotion: BlizzCon
mounts.desc: Whenever you ride this mount, you feel the urge to shout, "Cry havoc and let slip the murlocs of war!"

mounts.name: Big Slick in the City
mounts.srcText:
Quest: Snailed It
Zone: Zaralek Cavern
mounts.desc: Big heart, big dreams, Big Slick.

mounts.name: Bilebound Ur'zul
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: This demonic amalgamation was the result of a warlock's experiments in curse-infused alchemy. Whether the experiment was a success or failure depends on who you ask.

mounts.name: Biletooth Gnasher
mounts.srcText: Drop: Argus
mounts.desc: Its bite is definitely worse than its bark-like gurgling sound.

mounts.name: Bilgewater Bombardier
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Bilgewater Trove
Zone: Undermine
mounts.desc: For rapid transport of Cartel trade goods and other highly volatile substances.

mounts.name: Bilgewater X-TREME Firework Rocket
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: The engineers of Undermine were so preoccupied with whether or not they COULD make a faster rocket, they didn't stop to think if they should.

mounts.name: Black Battlestrider
mounts.srcText:

Zone: Stormwind City

mounts.desc: A properly accelerated gnome in battle is a thing of terrible beauty. - High Tinker Mekkatorque

mounts.name: Black Primal Raptor
mounts.srcText: Drop: Cracked Primal Egg
mounts.desc: Speed, cunning, and ferocity are the things trolls and raptors admire about each other.

mounts.name: Black Qiraji Battle Tank
mounts.srcText:
Drop: World Drop
Location: Temple of Ahn'Qiraj
mounts.desc: Although many varieties of Qiraji Battle Tank can still be found in the ruins of Ahn'Qiraj today, the darkest of the species were only seen on the day the Scarab gong was rung.

mounts.name: Black Riding Goat

mounts.name: Black Riding Yak
mounts.srcText: World Event: WoW Remix: Mists of Pandaria
mounts.desc: Grummles traveling Kun-Lai Summit by night prefer to ride this dark-haired yak to remain unseen, though they remove the bells from its caparison first.

mounts.name: Black Serpent of N'Zoth
mounts.srcText: Achievement: Through the Depths of Visions
mounts.desc: The black serpents of N'Zoth are the harbingers of his ultimate vision becoming reality. Only those servants or enemies that can tread this space have any chance of wrangling them.

mounts.name: Black Skeletal Horse
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Zachariah Post
Zone: Tirisfal Glades
Cost: 1g
mounts.desc: The Forsaken believe that without a purpose, even beasts of burden suffer in undeath.

mounts.name: Black Stallion
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Katie Stokx
Zone: Stormwind City
Cost: 1g
mounts.desc: Rumored to be favored by SI:7 for night missions due to its dark coat.

mounts.name: Black War Bear
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: For The Alliance!
Category: Player vs. Player
mounts.desc: Killing leaders of the Horde is its own reward, but this intimidating beast is an excellent memento.

mounts.name: Black War Bear
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: For The Horde!
Category: Player vs. Player
mounts.desc: This formidable mount is bought with the blood of Alliance leaders, but you would have killed them for free.

mounts.name: Black War Elekk
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Lieutenant Karter
Zone: Stormwind City
Cost: 15 Mark of Honor
mounts.desc: Uniquely aggressive and pugnacious elekk bulls are culled from the herd and sold to Ethereal traders. The traders then train the bulls for combat and sell them to owners unconcerned about safety.

mounts.name: Black War Kodo
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Raider Bork
Zone: Orgrimmar
Cost: 15 Mark of Honor
mounts.desc: Bred for their aggressive, unpredictable demeanor by the Kor'kron stablemasters, the Black War Kodos' trumpeting call signifies that blood will soon be shed.

mounts.name: Black War Mammoth
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Knight Dameron
Zone: Wintergrasp
Cost: 15 Mark of Honor
mounts.desc: Normally placid beasts, these intelligent animals form a strong bond with their riders, making them loyal and fearless in battle.

mounts.name: Black War Mammoth
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Stone Guard Mukar
Zone: Wintergrasp
Cost: 15 Mark of Honor
mounts.desc: Sure-footed and unflappable, these dark-furred mammoths are prized for their steady temperament going into battle.

mounts.name: Black War Ram
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Lieutenant Karter
Zone: Stormwind City
Cost: 15 Mark of Honor
mounts.desc: The dwarves value their ram companions for their fearlessness charging into battle.

mounts.name: Black War Raptor
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Raider Bork
Zone: Orgrimmar
Cost: 15 Mark of Honor
mounts.desc: Bred from the same vicious line of raptors which sired Ohgan and brought victory to the Gurubashi Empire.

mounts.name: Black War Steed
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Lieutenant Karter
Zone: Stormwind City
Cost: 15 Mark of Honor
mounts.desc: Trained to withstand brutal hand-to-hand combat in the fiercest battlefields.

mounts.name: Black War Tiger
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Lieutenant Karter
Zone: Stormwind City
Cost: 15 Mark of Honor
mounts.desc: Like their distant nightsaber cousins, tigers are renowned for their razor-sharp claws, incredible agility, and love of being scratched behind the ears.

mounts.name: Black War Wolf
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Raider Bork
Zone: Orgrimmar
Cost: 15 Mark of Honor
mounts.desc: Prized by Orgrimmar guards for their keen sense of smell.

mounts.name: Black Wolf

mounts.name: Black Wolf

Drop: Blackpaw
Zone: Darkshore
mounts.desc: Blackpaw was just hibernating, minding his own business, and then suddenly there was a warfront.

mounts.name: Blackrock Warsaber
mounts.srcText: Promotion
mounts.desc: Finding a litter of nightsaber kittens, a squad of Blackrock Outriders trained them into a formidable pack of deadly mounts.

mounts.name: Blacksteel Battleboar
mounts.srcText: Achievement: Guild Glory of the Draenor Raider
mounts.desc: Refuses to run unless its head is covered in heavy, spiked metal. It's an ego thing.

mounts.name: Blackwater Bonecrusher
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Blackwater Trove

mounts.desc: Best keep those bones to yourself if you don't want them crushed.

mounts.name: Blackwater Shredder Deluxe Mk 2
mounts.srcText:

mounts.name: Blackwater X-TREME Firework Rocket
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc:
"There is no guarantee this rocket will get you where you want to go in one piece.
Warning: Rockets explode!"

mounts.name: Blazing Drake
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Elementium Fragment
Location: Dragon Soul
mounts.desc: Blazing Drakes exhibit a boundless passion for life, and are considered by many to be among the most loyal mounts on Azeroth.

mounts.name: Blazing Hippogryph
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Landro Longshot
Location: Booty Bay
Trading Post
mounts.desc: Hippogryphs are highly intelligent, sentient beings; far more than mere "mounts."

mounts.name: Blazing Royal Fire Hawk
mounts.srcText: Promotion
mounts.desc: Only the most passionate of souls and fiercest of hearts can claim the Blazing Royal Fire Hawk as a mount.

mounts.name: Bleakhoof Ruinstrider
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: ...And Chew Mana Buns
Category: Legion
mounts.desc: The Army of the Light could only save so many of Argus' native species; countless numbers were lost to chaos.

mounts.name: Blessed Amani Burrower
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Chel the Chip
Feature: Abundance
Cost: 1600 Unalloyed Abundance
mounts.desc: A creature blessed by the wilds, it moves with the steadfast spirit and gentle strength the Amani hold sacred.

mounts.name: Blessed Felcrusher
mounts.srcText: Drop: Gleaming Footlocker
mounts.desc: After Alleria and Turalyon explained the usefulness of the Draenei's long-time companion animal, the Army of the Light brought several into the fold for training.

mounts.name: Blisterback Bloodtusk
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Warbringer Mal'korak
Zone: Maldraxxus
mounts.desc: The House of the Chosen train their mounts in all manner of difficult circumstances, so that no matter the battle, they will never falter.

mounts.name: Blonde Riding Yak
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Uncle Bigpocket
Zone: Kun-Lai Summit
Cost: 3000g
mounts.desc: Riding Yaks are bred to be slimmer and more agile than their kin.

mounts.name: Bloodbathed Frostbrood Vanquisher
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Glory of the Icecrown Raider (10 player)
Category: Dungeons & Raids
mounts.desc: Bloodbathed Vanquishers are so named when it is determined that a reanimated frost wyrm died a particularly gruesome and bloody death.

mounts.name: Blooded Snapvine
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: The Snapvines have always been dangerous, but we never realized that the deep variants were independent, and could fly. The distinct, bold coloring means the creature has eaten recently.

mounts.name: Bloodfang Widow
mounts.srcText: Vendor: The Mad Merchant
mounts.desc: Its long, serrated limbs drip with the blood of its enemies and/or mate.

mounts.name: Bloodflank Charger
mounts.srcText: Achievement: Two Sides to Every Tale
mounts.desc: Stolen from the Arathi Basin stables, this fire-hearted charger now steeds for the Horde.

mounts.name: Bloodgorged Crawg
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Glory of the Uldir Raider
Category: Dungeons & Raids
mounts.desc: This crawg was left alone to feast on G'huun's corrupted blood and rot. He was so happy.

mounts.name: Bloodgorged Hunter
mounts.srcText: Drop: Island Expeditions
mounts.desc: If he wasn't so full, you wouldn't have caught him.

mounts.name: Bloodhoof Bull
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Nakk the Thunderer
Location: Nagrand
mounts.desc: Members of the Warsong clan have long hunted these clefthoof to use their crimson-hued skin for battle standards.

mounts.name: Bloodhunter Fel Bat
mounts.srcText: World Event: WoW Remix: Legion
mounts.desc: A beast from an unknown world within the Twisting Nether, tamed through brutal and relentless will.

mounts.name: Bloodthirsty Dreadwing
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Provisioner Mukra
Zone: Zuldazar
Cost: 750 Honorbound Service Medal
mounts.desc: The forsaken prefer the use of these bloodthirsty hunters, both for their speed as a mount, and the psychological effect they have on their enemies.

mounts.name: Bloodtooth Mana Ray
mounts.srcText: World Event: WoW Remix: Legion
mounts.desc: The shattering of Argus drove this breed of mana ray to bloodthirst. It now subsists on the corrupted blood of any creatures it can sink its many teeth into.

mounts.name: Bloody Skyscreamer
mounts.srcText: World Event: WoW Remix: Mists of Pandaria
mounts.desc: This dinosaur still harbors the rage of its ancestors from the Zandalari Invasion.

mounts.name: Blossomback Arboon
mounts.srcText: In-Game Shop
mounts.desc: Once a common sight in the mountains surrounding the Jade Forest, the arboon's return signals the forest may be healing.

mounts.name: Blossombranch Groveglider
mounts.srcText: In-Game Shop
mounts.desc: These enchanting grovegliders are known for their coloring, reminiscent of some of Pandaria's treasured blossoming trees.

mounts.name: Blossoming Dreamstag
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Talisa Whisperbloom
Zone: Emerald Dream
Cost: 1 Seedbloom
mounts.desc: The pelts of young dreamstags flower with the vibrant colors of the dream.

mounts.name: Blue Barry
mounts.srcText:
Quest: A Blue for You
Zone: K'aresh
mounts.desc: A particularly rare variant of slateback, "Blue Barry" was previously used as a beast of burden.

mounts.name: Blue Dragon Turtle

mounts.name: Blue Drake
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Alexstrasza's Gift
Location: Eye of Eternity
mounts.desc: Come not between the dragon and his wrath.

mounts.name: Blue Hawkstrider
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Winaestra

Cost: 1g
mounts.desc: Some of our brethren prefer horses, but the hawkstrider will always be the true symbol of Silvermoon. -Winaestra

mounts.name: Blue Qiraji War Tank

mounts.name: Blue Riding Nether Ray

mounts.name: Blue Shado-Pan Riding Tiger

Faction: Shado-Pan - Exalted

mounts.desc: "When waking a tiger, use a long stick. Better yet, tell your friend to wake the tiger instead." -Pandaren Proverb

mounts.name: Blue Skeletal Horse
mounts.srcText:

Zone: Tirisfal Glades
Cost: 1g
mounts.desc: The Forsaken believe that without a purpose, even beasts of burden suffer in undeath.

mounts.name: Blue Wind Rider
mounts.srcText:

Zone: Orgrimmar
Cost: 50g
mounts.desc: After being freed from vicious harpies by Cairne and Thrall, many of these creatures became valuable companions of the Horde.

mounts.name: Blue-Chip Shreddertank
mounts.srcText: Vendor: Lindormi
mounts.desc: It may not be exciting, but it makes money every time.

mounts.name: Blushing Witchwick's Rider
mounts.srcText: In-Game Shop
mounts.desc: Sleek, stylish, and spooky, the Witchwick Rider offers a smooth and surprisingly comfortable ride, thanks to the ergonomic saddle requested by many a spellcaster seeking cushioned support.

mounts.name: Bone-White Primal Raptor
mounts.srcText:
Quest: A Mountain of Giant Dinosaur Bones
Zone: Isle of Giants
mounts.desc: "They are lethal at eight months, very lethal." -Hemet Nesingwary Jr.

mounts.name: Bonecleaver's Skullboar
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Collector Ta'Steld
Zone: Oribos
Cost: 5000 Timewarped Badge
mounts.desc: Sabreil was known for the ruthless efficiency with which she dismembered foes, feeding their bones to her loyal skullboar.

mounts.name: Bonehoof Tauralus
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Tahonta
Covenant: Necrolord
Zone: Maldraxxus
mounts.desc: There are quite a few reasons that you do not want to stand behind a tauralus, the hooves and whip-like tails being the least of them.

mounts.name: Bonesewn Fleshroc
mounts.srcText:
Profession: Abominable Stitching
Zone: Maldraxxus
mounts.desc: Only expert flesh-stitchers who have demonstrated mastery over the magics of Maldraxxus are powerful enough to construct a deathroc of this size.

mounts.name: Bonesteed of Bloodshed
mounts.srcText: World Event: WoW Remix: Legion
mounts.desc: A good warhorse is loyal to its bones. Having shed its mortal coil, this steed is an omen of eternal strife.

mounts.name: Bonesteed of Oblivion
mounts.srcText: World Event: WoW Remix: Legion
mounts.desc: A good warhorse is loyal to its bones. Having shed its mortal coil, this steed is an omen of scarcity and death.

mounts.name: Bonesteed of Plague
mounts.srcText: World Event: WoW Remix: Legion
mounts.desc: A good warhorse is loyal to its bones. Having shed its mortal coil, this steed is an omen of sickness and suffering.

mounts.name: Bonesteed of Triumph
mounts.srcText: World Event: WoW Remix: Legion
mounts.desc: A good warhorse is loyal to its bones. Having shed its mortal coil, this steed is an omen of bold conquest.

mounts.name: Boulder Hauler
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Ponzo
Zone: Zaralek Cavern
Cost: 85 Barter Boulder
mounts.desc: These shalewings have been specially trained to carry large amounts of Barter Boulders for the niffen's bartering activities.

mounts.name: Bound Blizzard
mounts.srcText: Promotion:
mounts.desc: A flurrious, fridgid friend, frost-flecked for frozen fun.

mounts.name: Bound Shadehound
mounts.srcText:
Quest: Feral Shadehound

mounts.desc: Created by deciphering and performing powerful runic magic, this Shadehound is bound to its creator.

Zone: Brawl'gar Arena
Cost: 1500g
mounts.desc: For years pandaren believed these creatures to be untamable. Just ask the first pandaren to do so, Henshi "Limp Along" Homebrew.

mounts.name: Brawlin' Bruno
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Ulaani
Zone: Bizmo's Brawlpub
Vendor: Tiana Nevermorn
Zone: Brawl'gar Arena
Faction: Brawler's Guild (Rank 6)
Cost: 4000g
mounts.desc: Said to be leaner and potentially even meaner than the venerable Bruce. Bruno's legacy is yet to be written.

mounts.name: Breath of Blight
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Midnight Keystone Master: Season Two
Category: Dungeons
mounts.desc: A sickly haze trails in its wake, poisoning earth, air, and anything foolish enough to pursue it.

mounts.name: Breath of Ruin
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Midnight Keystone Legend: Season Two
Category: Dungeons
mounts.desc: Where its shadow falls, even the bravest hear the echo of forgotten wars.

mounts.name: Breezestrider Stallion
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Dazzerian
Faction: Vol'jin's Spear - Exalted
Location: Warspear
Cost: 5,000g + 5,000 Apexis Crystal
mounts.desc: These breezestriders' red coloration reflects their temperament: sanguine, fierce, and courageous.

mounts.name: Brewfest Bomber
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Coren Direbrew
Holiday: Brewfest
mounts.desc: Careful not to consume the ammunition.

mounts.name: Brilliant Direbeak
mounts.srcText: Quest: Direbeak Reunion
mounts.desc: The shimmering hides of these deceptively fierce and coordinated beasts are intended to confuse and disorient prey.

mounts.name: Brilliant Petalwing
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Light Up the Night
Category: Midnight
mounts.desc: This beast glows with a radiance no void could suppress.

mounts.name: Brilliant Sunburst Peafowl
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: With this bird, feathers will never be out of style.

mounts.name: Brimstone Courser
mounts.srcText: World Event: WoW Remix: Legion
mounts.desc: The flames of a courser's hooves express their affinity for a particular school of magic.

mounts.name: Brinedeep Bottom-Feeder
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Conjurer Margoss
Zone: Dalaran
Faction: Conjurer Margoss - Honored
Cost: 100 Drowned Mana
mounts.desc: These elusive fish prefer to skulk in the deepest reaches of the Great Sea, searching the darkness for food.

mounts.name: Bristling Hellboar
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Z'tenga the Walker
Zone: Tanaan Jungle
Faction: The Saberstalkers - Exalted
Cost: 5000 Blackfang Claw
mounts.desc: The one and only source for the rare culinary ingredient: cursed bacon.

mounts.name: Broken Highland Mustang
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Knight-Captain Aldrin
Zone: Arathi Highlands
mounts.desc: One of the Arathi horses, taken and broken by the Horde conquerors of Stromgarde.

mounts.name: Bronze Aquilon
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Any Timewalking Vendor
Cost: 5000 Timewarped Badge
mounts.desc: The reliable steeds of Bastion are designed to mirror the proud and noble warriors of the Ascended.

mounts.name: Bronze Corpsefly
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Any Timewalking Vendor
Cost: 5000 Timewarped Badge
mounts.desc: It takes a great deal of effort to decorate a corpsefly, but some would say the efforts are worth it.

mounts.name: Bronze Drake
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Infinite Corruptor
Zone: The Culling of Stratholme
mounts.desc: Lost time is never found again. Oh, never mind I found it. -Chronormu

mounts.name: Bronze Goblin Waveshredder
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Darkfuse Trove
Zone: Undermine
mounts.desc: Even cartel employees deserve to have some R&R on occassion.

mounts.name: Bronze Gravewing
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Any Timewalking Vendor
Cost: 5000 Timewarped Badge
mounts.desc: While dark and ominous is the preferred aesthetic of those who reside in Revendreth, there are some who still favor gleaming luster.

mounts.name: Bronze Helicid
mounts.srcText: Profession: Protoform Synthesis
mounts.desc: Some helicids of Zereth Mortis have strangely metallic shells. The ones who do are generally a bronze color, indistinct from the metal any novice miner could work, save that this creature's construction far surpasses the skill of any novice.

mounts.name: Bronze Vorquin
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Treysh
Zone: The Forbidden Reach
Cost: 40g
Vendor: Tethalash
Zone: Valdrakken
Cost: 40g
mounts.desc: Respected for their resilience in battle, even against dragonfire, these noble beasts are the prized mounts of the dracthyr cavalry.

mounts.name: Bronze Wilderling
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Any Timewalking Vendor
Cost: 5000 Timewarped Badge
mounts.desc: The regal wilderlings twist through the sky, free as the unbound magic that sustains their flight.

mounts.name: Bronzewing Vespoid
mounts.srcText: Profession: Protoform Synthesis
mounts.desc: Bronzewing vespoids are the result of attempting to synthesize a vespoid queen with no other members of a new hive. While no mortal has yet discovered how to synthesize a hive, the bronzewings are reliable mounts just as they are.

mounts.name: Broodling of Sinestra
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Kiatke
Zone: Stormwind City
Zone: Orgrimmar
Cost: 5000 Timewarped Badge
mounts.desc: After the fall of the Bastion of Twilight, a few scattered twilight whelps escaped Vexiona's sway. Some of these whelps have allied with mortals and are willing to bear them as riders.

mounts.name: Brown Dragon Turtle
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Turtlemaster Odai
Zone: Orgrimmar
Cost: 1g
Vendor: Old Whitenose
Zone: Stormwind City
Cost: 1g
mounts.desc: Cherished for their heavy carrying capacity and steady gait, these stalwart beasts are the mount of choice for most native Pandaren.

mounts.name: Brown Elekk
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Torallius the Pack Handler
Zone: Azuremyst Isle
Cost: 1g
mounts.desc: Patient and strong, the Elekk exemplify the Draenei attitude towards the hardships of life.

mounts.name: Brown Horse
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Unger Statforth
Zone: Wetlands
Cost: 1g
mounts.desc: A favorite among Stormwind's guards thanks to its patience and stamina.

mounts.name: Brown Kodo
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Harb Clawhoof
Zone: Mulgore
Cost: 1g
mounts.desc: "The kodo is the backbone of our people. Wherever the Horde goes - in trade, settlement, or war - there you will find the mighty kodo." - Harb Clawhoof

mounts.name: Brown Ram
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Veron Amberstill
Zone: Dun Morogh
Cost: 1g
mounts.desc: Male rams will often smash their thick skulls against each other for hours to impress a female. In that way, they're very similar to dwarves.

mounts.name: Brown Riding Camel
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Blacksmith Abasi
Zone: Uldum
Faction: Ramkahen - Exalted
Cost: 100g
mounts.desc: Fennimore Quigley is credited with milking the first camel and breaking the record for "longest unintentional flight," all in the same afternoon.

mounts.name: Brown Riding Goat
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Gina Mudclaw
Zone: Valley of the Four Winds
Faction: The Tillers - Exalted
Cost: 500g
mounts.desc: It takes unflagging patience and a gentle touch to train obstinate mountain goats for riding.

mounts.name: Brown Scouting Ottuk
mounts.srcText:
Faction: Iskaara Tuskarr
Renown: 25
Vendor: Tatto
Location: Iskaara
Cost: 2 Mastodon Tusk 2 Aquatic Maw 750 Dragon Isles Supplies
mounts.desc: Wily and playful in their natural habitat, ottuks possess keen eyes that can scout far afield as ably as they watch for predators.

mounts.name: Brown Skeletal Horse
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Zachariah Post
Zone: Tirisfal Glades
Cost: 1g
mounts.desc: The Forsaken believe that without a purpose, even beasts of burden suffer in undeath.

mounts.name: Brown War Ottuk
mounts.srcText:
Faction: Iskaara Tuskarr
Renown: 30
Vendor: Tatto
Location: Iskaara
Cost: 5 Mastodon Tusk 5 Aquatic Maw 1000 Dragon Isles Supplies
mounts.desc: The tuskarr of Iskaara are loathe to war against anyone, but many tuskarr and their allies have nonetheless taken up the spear with a war ottuk beside them.

mounts.name: Brown Wolf
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Ogunaro Wolfrunner
Zone: Orgrimmar
Cost: 1g
mounts.desc: Can howl loudly enough to be heard for miles.

mounts.name: Brown-Furred Spiky Bakar
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: Such a good boy. Or girl. It's hard to tell sometimes. Always good though.

mounts.name: Bruce
mounts.srcText: Quest: Complete the Brawler's Guild Questline
mounts.desc: BRUCE!

mounts.name: Bulbous Necroray
mounts.srcText: Drop: Oozing Necroray Egg
mounts.desc: The necrorays of Maldraxxus prefer to congregate around the enormous decaying mushrooms of the region.

mounts.name: Buzz
mounts.srcText: Profession: Protoform Synthesis
mounts.desc: Buzz buzz buzz, buzz buzz! Buzz buzz buzz buzz buzz. Buzz buzz buzz, buzz buzz buzz.

mounts.name: Cabbage Pseudoshell
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: The plants of the deep lands often emulate the creatures of of Azeroth. The purpose of the mimicry is unknown, but can be quite disturbing when the terrestrial mollusks are on the wrong end of an arboreal meal.

mounts.name: Calamitous Carrion
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Midnight Keystone Master: Season One
Category: Dungeons
mounts.desc: Bearing Zul'Aman's fiercest riders, its shadowed wings strike down any who dare resist.

mounts.name: Calescent Shalewing
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Que Zara(lek), Zara(lek)
Category: Quests
mounts.desc: A shalewing born in the wake of Fyrakk's destructive breach. Cursed by his primal flame, its temperature slowly but constantly rises. It must immerse itself in water to cool off periodically, lest its own heat smother it.

mounts.name: Callow Flayedwing
mounts.srcText: Zone: Maldraxxus
mounts.desc: Flayedwings are a necessary force in the cycle of life for the Shadowlands, acting as both prey and predator for the harsh environment of Maldraxxus.

mounts.name: Captured Swampstalker
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Provisioner Lija
Zone: Nazmir
Faction: Talanji's Expedition - Exalted
Cost: 90000g
mounts.desc: A swamp-dwelling subspecies of pterrordax known to feast on young bloodfeasters.

mounts.name: Caravan Hyena
mounts.srcText: Achievement: Allied Races: Vulpera
mounts.desc: The canopy atop this dune-wanderer can be stored at your campsite, should you desire to feel the wind in your fur.

mounts.name: Carcinized Zerethsteed
mounts.srcText: Quest: Leading Motives
mounts.desc: The few of these mysterious creatures that remain appear to be impossibly old, almost timeless. Perhaps they were created by the First Ones, because no schematic to synthesize these has yet been discovered.

mounts.name: Carmine Witchwick's Rider
mounts.srcText: In-Game Shop
mounts.desc: Sleek, stylish, and spooky, the Witchwick Rider offers a smooth and surprisingly comfortable ride, thanks to the ergonomic saddle requested by many a spellcaster seeking cushioned support.

mounts.name: Cartel Master's Gearglider
mounts.srcText:
Drop: So'leah
Zone: Tazavesh, the Veiled Market
mounts.desc: Only the richest cartel leaders are able to afford the metals required to craft the Cartel Master's Gearglider.

mounts.name: Cataloged Shalewing
mounts.srcText:
Zone: Zaralek Cavern
Public Event: Researchers Under Fire
mounts.desc: The first instance of a flaming shalewing ever discovered. Nine out of ten researchers agree: it's hot!

mounts.name: Caustic Venomfang
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Skull of Er'inye
Zone: Vaults of Atal'Utek
Cost: 10000 Corrosive Coin
mounts.desc: This venomfang's toxins are potent enough to liquidate its prey in seconds.

mounts.name: Celestial Steed
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: A beacon of hope; a guiding light in the darkness.

mounts.name: Cenarion War Hippogryph
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Fedryen Swiftspear
Zone: Zangarmarsh, Outland
Faction: Cenarion Expedition - Exalted
Cost: 2000g
mounts.desc: Members of the Cenarion Circle have shared a long and prosperous partnership with their hippogryph allies. When conflict is unavoidable, the Cenarion War Hippogryph is called into service.

mounts.name: Cerulean Deathwalker
mounts.srcText: Vendor: Lindormi
mounts.desc: A frozen tide of wailing souls, locked in cerulean ice, grinds onward under the weight of eternal suffering.

mounts.name: Cerulean Hawkstrider
mounts.srcText: Drop: Eversong Woods Rare Creatures
mounts.desc: A brilliant-plumed hawkstrider that escaped from the Silvermoon stables, who knows where in Eversong it may be hiding?

mounts.name: Cerulean Marsh Hopper
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: Gottum's expansion into export markets was inevitable with news of the Trading Post reaching even into the depths of the Frogmarsh.

mounts.name: Cerulean Ruinstrider
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Toraan the Revered
Zone: Argus
Faction: Argussian Reach - Exalted
Cost: 10000g
mounts.desc: Talbuks, native to Argus, have evolved chitinous plates to survive the decades of ceaseless war that ravages the landscape.

mounts.name: Cerulean Sporeglider
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Naynar
Zone: Harandar
Cost: 8000 Voidlight Marl
mounts.desc: This sporeglider likes to gently nuzzle its riders.

mounts.name: Champion's Treadblade
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Paulie
Zone: Stormwind, Old Town
Cost: 100000g
mounts.desc: Forged by human, gnome, and dwarf, this armored masterpiece is designed to slice a tauren into a tri-tip dinner with a flick of the handlebars.

mounts.name: Chaos-Forged Dreadwing
mounts.srcText: In-Game Shop
mounts.desc: Born and raised during a time of great chaos, this mount has survived hardships known by few.

mounts.name: Chaos-Forged Gryphon
mounts.srcText: In-Game Shop
mounts.desc: Born and raised during a time of great chaos, this mount has survived hardships known by few.

mounts.name: Chaos-Forged Hippogryph
mounts.srcText: In-Game Shop
mounts.desc: Born and raised during a time of great chaos, this mount has survived hardships known by few.

mounts.name: Chaos-Forged Wind Rider
mounts.srcText: In-Game Shop
mounts.desc: Born and raised during a time of great chaos, this mount has survived hardships known by few.

mounts.name: Charger
mounts.srcText: Paladin
mounts.desc: Redeemed by the Light. Devoted to your cause.

mounts.name: Charming Courier
mounts.srcText: In-Game Shop
mounts.desc: Neither snow nor rain nor heat nor gloom of night stays these charming couriers from the swift completion of their appointed rounds.

mounts.name: Chauffeured Mechano-Hog
mounts.srcText: Achievement: Heirloom Hoarder
mounts.desc: Why drive yourself around when you can hire someone to do it for you?

mounts.name: Chauffeured Mekgineer's Chopper
mounts.srcText: Achievement: Heirloom Hoarder
mounts.desc: Transportation is a precise business.

mounts.name: Chestnut Courser
mounts.srcText: World Event: WoW Remix: Legion
mounts.desc: Coursers make for excellent steeds. Just don't try to dismount from their front.

mounts.name: Chestnut Mare
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Katie Stokx
Zone: Stormwind City
Cost: 1g
mounts.desc: Sturdy and steady; "the horse that built Stormwind."

mounts.name: Child of Torcali
mounts.srcText:
Quest: Wander Not Alone
Zone: Zuldazar
mounts.desc: This daughter of the great direhorn loa, Torcali, never lost faith that her keeper would help her grow to her full potential.

mounts.name: Chittering Animite
mounts.srcText: Adventures: Shadowlands
mounts.desc: These exceptionally agile fliers make excellent mounts once they've been trained not to sap every ounce of anima from their rider.

mounts.name: Chosen Tauralus
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: The Gang's All Here
Category: Covenant Sanctums
mounts.desc: Even an unarmored tauralus is a valuable ally in battle, its enormous horns capable of piercing even plate armor.

mounts.name: Chrono Corsair
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Any Timewalking Vendor
Cost: 5000 Timewarped Badge
mounts.desc: Always on the lookout for the next golden opportunity, this Infinite Dragonflight pirate has soared through the timeways to find a crew for the perfect heist.

mounts.name: Cinder-Plumed Highland Gryphon
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: According to Wildhammer legend, the orange plumage found on gryphons is believed to be a hereditary trait passed down from their elemental ancestry.

mounts.name: Cinder-Seared Elekk
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: The Burning Legion sought to destroy, steal or corrupt anything that brought joy to the draenei, and the elekks of Draneor were no exception.

mounts.name: Cindermane Charger
mounts.srcText: Recruit-a-Friend
mounts.desc: Formed by Ragnaros himself as a gift for the daughter he never had.

mounts.name: Cindertuft Groveglider
mounts.srcText: In-Game Shop
mounts.desc: Native to Hyjal, these mischievous tree-dwellers underwent a startling transformation when the Firelands made its appearance in the region.

mounts.name: Clayscale Hornstrider
mounts.srcText: Drop: Azerothian Archives
mounts.desc: Named for their dusty-red appearance, clayscale hornstriders can be found tearing across the muddy hills of the Ohn'ahran Plains.

mounts.name: Cliffside Wylderdrake
mounts.srcText: Achievement: Dragon Isles: Cliffside Wylderdrake
mounts.desc: Often roosting along the steep cliff faces of Thaldraszus, they're swift to the skies in times of danger.

mounts.name: Cliffside Wylderdrake
mounts.srcText: Achievement: Dragon Isles: Cliffside Wylderdrake
mounts.desc: Often roosting along the steep cliff faces of Thaldraszus, they're swift to the skies in times of danger.

mounts.name: Cloudborn Razorwing
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: A very rare Korthian creature, due to limited cloud cover.

mounts.name: Cloudwing Hippogryph
mounts.srcText: Drop: Farondis Chest
mounts.desc: Moreso than normal hippogryphs, the cloudwings of Azsuna prefer to nest high up in mountain caves far above the cloud line.

mounts.name: Clutch of Ha-Li
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Ha-Li
Zone: Vale of Eternal Blossoms
mounts.desc: The brood of Ha-Li are comfortable in the blue skies of Pandaria, hunting unsuspecting prey.

mounts.name: Clutch of Ji-Kun
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Ji-Kun
Zone: Throne of Thunder
mounts.desc: Although Ji-Kun feasted on the failed creations of mogu flesh-shapers, her progeny is willing to eat more pedestrian carcasses.

mounts.name: Coalfist Gronnling
mounts.srcText: Garrison Mission: Breaker Two
mounts.desc: This little gronnling is well-known for smashing his way into garrison inns and making a mess of the pots and pans.

mounts.name: Cobalt Dragonhawk
mounts.srcText: Drop: Eversong Woods Rare Creatures
mounts.desc: A rare breed of Dragonhawk that soars the Thalassian skies on azure wings after having escaped from the Sunwing Rookery.

mounts.name: Cobalt Juggernaut
mounts.srcText: World Event: WoW Remix: Mists of Pandaria
mounts.desc: What started as a rideable mining and logging machine devolved quickly into chaos when engineers asked themselves if they could make it any cooler.

mounts.name: Cobalt Netherwing Drake
mounts.srcText:
Quest: Jorus the Cobalt Netherwing Drake
Zone: Shattrath City, Outland
mounts.desc: After promising to fly you to the ends of Outland, the netherwing drake was eventually drawn to the blue skies of Azeroth as well.

mounts.name: Cobalt Phase-Hunter
mounts.srcText: Promotion: Burning Crusade Classic
mounts.desc: Due to the otherworldly energies that irradiated Draenor, these creatures can shift through space at will. As such, they are rarely seen... until it is too late.

mounts.name: Cobalt Primordial Direhorn
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Oondasta
Location: Isle of Giants
mounts.desc: "When ya fight alongside raptors, ya want a mount dey can't eat." -Unknown dinomancer

mounts.name: Cobalt Pterrordax
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Natal'hakata
Zone: Zuldazar
Faction: Zandalari Empire - Exalted
Cost: 10000g
mounts.desc: These pterrordax keep vigil for enemy fleets soaring above the coasts of Zandalar.

mounts.name: Cobalt Riding Talbuk
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Provisioner Nasela
Zone: Nagrand, Outland
Faction: The Mag'har - Exalted
Cost: 70g
Vendor: Trader Narasu
Zone: Nagrand, Outland
Faction: The Kurenai - Exalted
Cost: 70g
mounts.desc: The orcs once hunted these graceful herd animals as part of the om'riggor rite of passage ceremony.

mounts.name: Cobalt Shalewing
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Karokta
Zone: Zaralek Cavern
mounts.desc: Brood of Karokta, raised in the underlight of Zaralek Cavern.

mounts.name: Cobalt War Talbuk
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Provisioner Nasela
Zone: Nagrand, Outland
Faction: The Mag'har - Exalted
Cost: 100g
Vendor: Trader Narasu
Zone: Nagrand, Outland
Faction: The Kurenai - Exalted
Cost: 100g
mounts.desc: Despite their docile nature, talbuks have been known to gore seasoned warriors to death when threatened.

mounts.name: Coldflame Cormaera
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: During the war of the elemental lords, Cormaera were often used as beasts of burden for the Firelord's most loyal lieutenants.

mounts.name: Coldflame Infernal
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: The strange icy flames cause you to sweat and shiver at the same time.

mounts.name: Coldflame Tempest
mounts.srcText: World Event: 20th WoW Anniversary
mounts.desc: Emerging from the chaos of the early elemental wars on Azeroth, the Coldflame Tempest is a reminder that the chill of a blizzard is eternal.

mounts.name: Colossal Ebonclaw Mawrat
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: The Jailer's Gauntlet: Layer 4
Category: Torghast
mounts.desc: This vicious and cunning creature has grown to its astonishing size by not only feasting upon the weakened souls in the Jailer's Tower, but also vulnerable Mawsworn.

mounts.name: Colossal Plaguespew Mawrat
mounts.srcText: Drop: Rhuv, Gorger of Ruin
mounts.desc: These rodents became Iska's infamous sentries, scouting and carrying her plague across the Maw. Their presence is only followed by ruin.

mounts.name: Colossal Slaughterclaw
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Supplies of the Undying Army
Zone: Maldraxxus
mounts.desc: Only the most stalwart stable masters of Maldraxxus are able to break the will of the colossal slaughterclaws, giving all champions of the Undying Army a fearsome ally in the Shadowlands.

mounts.name: Colossal Soulshredder Mawrat
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Flawless Master (Layer 16)
Category: Torghast
mounts.desc: The incredible prowess you have demonstrated within the Jailer's Tower has instilled sufficient respect into this fearsome creature, enabling its use as a mount.

mounts.name: Colossal Umbrahide Mawrat
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Torghast Layers 13 or higher
Location: Torghast
mounts.desc: This disturbingly large Mawrat is an anomaly amongst its species. These Colossal Mawrats lurk only in the most distant and darkest reaches of Torghast.

mounts.name: Colossal Wraithbound Mawrat
mounts.srcText: Drop: Mawsworn Supply Chest
mounts.desc: Infused by the energies of tormented souls, these creatures have adopted ghostlike abilities that make them quite elusive.

mounts.name: Comfy Bel'ameth Flying Quilt
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: Ainderu Summerleaf's hand-woven quilts are popular among the children of Bel'ameth.

mounts.name: Comfy Silvermoon Flying Quilt
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: Sempstress Ambershine's enchanted quilts became a must-buy trend for the noble-borne children of Silvermoon City.

mounts.name: Compass Rose
mounts.srcText: World Event: Hearthstone Anniversary
mounts.desc: Pried from a giant Hearthstone game box.

mounts.name: Conqueror's Scythemaw
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Conqueror of Azeroth
Category: World
mounts.desc: The battle-hardened shell of this mighty beast can turn aside even the most hefty hammer or sharpened spear.

mounts.name: Contained Stormarion Defender
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Victorious Stormarion Cache
Zone: Voidstorm
mounts.desc: While often aggressive, some Harrowers can be tamed and taught to aid in defensive military techniques. This Harrower looks over the Stormarion Core to ensure none can breach it.

mounts.name: Convalescent Carrion
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Midnight Keystone Legend: Season One
Category: Dungeons
mounts.desc: Circling above the dying and the doomed, its wings herald plague, ruin, and the certainty that nothing left in its shadow will rise again.

mounts.name: Copper-Maned Quilen
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Mistweaver Xia
Zone: Timeless Isle
Cost: 5000 Timewarped Badge
mounts.desc: Raised in the stables of the Iron Qon, these mounts are ardently steadfast, never leaving their posts even when they sensed the demise of their masters.

mounts.name: Coral-Stalker Waveray
mounts.srcText: Promotion
mounts.desc: This species of ray seems to have evolved to stalk its prey amidst the brightly colored corals of the seas.

mounts.name: Coralscale Salamanther
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Into the Storm
Category: Exploration
mounts.desc: As Raszageth's storms abated, this aquatic breed of salamanther was among the many wonders to settle among the shores in their wake.

mounts.name: Core Hound
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Boldly, You Sought the Power of Ragnaros
Category: Feats of Strength
mounts.desc: Molten to the core!

mounts.name: Corridor Creeper
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Twisting Corridors: Layer 8
Category: Torghast
mounts.desc: The loyal hounds of the Jailer creep along the corridors in search of the scent of souls.

mounts.name: Corroded Soul Crusher
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Telemancer Astrandis
Zone: Silvermoon City
Cost: 10 Voidlight Marl
mounts.desc: Aeons passed without leaving a mark upon its arcane frame. It took the corrosive ichor of Ula'Tek to finally erode what eternity could not.

mounts.name: Corrupted Dreadwing
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Dawn-Seeker Krisek
Zone: Tanaan Jungle
Faction: Order of the Awakened - Friendly
Cost: 150,000 Apexis Crystal
mounts.desc: Bathed in the blood of demons, these corrupted Dread Ravens are significantly more aggressive, and will often kill one another if kept in confinement.

mounts.name: Corrupted Fire Hawk
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Glory of the Firelands Raider
Category: Dungeons & Raids
mounts.desc: Millagazor was a fire hawk loyal to Ragnaros. At this time it is unknown how many of Millagazor's eggs were corrupted.

mounts.name: Corrupted Hippogryph
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Landro Longshot
Location: Booty Bay
mounts.desc: It is a sad fact that even the wise and majestic hippogryph may fall prey to corruption.

mounts.name: Corruption of the Aspects
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Torie
Zone: Dornogal
Cost: 40000 Displaced Corrupted Mementos
mounts.desc: With N'Zoth's triumph, what started with Galakrond comes to fruition. With the Aspects gone, the corruption of their species is complete.

mounts.name: Court Sinrunner
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Mistress Mihaela
Zone: Revendreth
Faction: Court of Harvesters - Exalted
Cost: 30000g
mounts.desc: Sinrunners were once the steeds of dark souls, carried in the wake of either their sins or their masters' sins to Revendreth. While some chose to run free, many continue to serve darkness in death as they did in life.

mounts.name: Craghorn Chasm-Leaper
mounts.srcText: Drop: Island Expeditions
mounts.desc: These mighty leapers have adapted to island life by learning to catch seagulls swooping through crags and fissures.

mounts.name: Cragstepper Crest-Horn
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: Tuskaar aren't often found on Highmountain, but the crest-horns often come down to the shores to seek rare delicacies in the coastal waters.

mounts.name: Creeping Carpet
mounts.srcText: Profession: Tailoring
mounts.desc: Can't fly, but can creep very quickly.

mounts.name: Crested Aqua Leafmimic
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: The aqua leafmimic is a rare sight indeed. Found only in the forests of Ashenvale, its darkened scales allow it to hide among the trees and groves undetected.

mounts.name: Crested Ember Leafmimic
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: This sturdy leafmimic can be found only in the warmest of areas. Its red scales allow it to hide undiscovered in the heated alcoves it prefers.

mounts.name: Crested Verdant Leafmimic
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: Found primarily in areas with dense vegetation, this leafmimic is rarely spotted due to the natural hues of its scales, allowing it to blend in with its surroundings.

mounts.name: Crested Violet Leafmimic
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: The violet leafmimic can be found in most dense jungles -- but only if your eyesight is keen. The patterns on their scales allow them to blend in with the vibrant foliage and shadows.

mounts.name: Crimson Armored Growler
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Rocco Razzboom
Zone: Undermine
Cost: 8125 Resonance Crystals
mounts.desc: Some Goblins affectionately refer to trained hyenas as 'Growlers.' This one is fond of digging.

mounts.name: Crimson Cloud Serpent
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Glory of the Pandaria Hero
Category: Dungeons & Raids
mounts.desc: Crimson Cloud Serpents are given to flights of fancy, striking out on a whim for seemingly random journeys, sometimes for days at a time.

mounts.name: Crimson Deathcharger
mounts.srcText:
Quest: Mograine's Reunion
Zone: Icecrown Citadel
mounts.desc: Stabled in the Icecrown Citadel to serve the Lich King's most favored minions.

mounts.name: Crimson Dragonhawk
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Midnight Glyph Hunter
Category: Skyriding
mounts.desc: A strikingly colored Dragonhawk admired across Quel'Thalas, its vivid red wings cutting bright arcs through the skies as it glides with smooth, effortless grace.

mounts.name: Crimson Glimmerfur
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: Gilnean legend states this red-and-white fox only crosses the Winter Veil during one season.

mounts.name: Crimson Lupine
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Collector Ta'steld
Zone: Oribos
Cost: 5000 Timewarped Badge
mounts.desc: Once, the First Ones desired creations with fierce devotion they could mold to their purposes. The lupine of Zerith Mortis are one of their many creations, and those bearing crimson forms are said to be the most powerful of all.

mounts.name: Crimson Mudnose
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Waxmonger Squick
Zone: The Ringing Deeps
Cost: 8125 Resonance Crystals
mounts.desc: Frequently used by kobolds as mounts, the Assembly of the Deeps has decided to allow you access to one of their most loyal mudnoses.

mounts.name: Crimson Pandaren Phoenix
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Kai Featherfall
Location: Vale of Eternal Blossoms
Cost: 1 Ancestral Phoenix Egg
mounts.desc: The plumage of the Crimson Phoenix is said to represent prosperity and happiness.

mounts.name: Crimson Primal Direhorn
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Vasarin Redmorn
Zone: Isle of Thunder
Faction: Sunreaver Onslaught - Exalted
Cost: 3000g
mounts.desc: Leave it to the blood elves to pick the red one.

mounts.name: Crimson Shardhide
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Malbog
Zone: Korthia
mounts.desc: When Korthia was pulled into The Maw, only a few hardy species survived.

mounts.name: Crimson Shreddertank
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: The War Within Keystone Master: Season Two
Category: Dungeons
mounts.desc: Experimental shredder designed for killing rather than harvesting.

mounts.name: Crimson Silvermoon Hawkstrider
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Caeris Fairdawn
Zone: Eversong Woods
Cost: 6000 Voidlight Marl
mounts.desc: The pride of the Silvermoon Court, these hawkstriders are prized for their vibrant red plumage and purebred elegance.

mounts.name: Crimson Slavermaw
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Blistermaw
Zone: Antoran Wastes
mounts.desc: Answers to a series of noises that cannot be made by non-demonic creatures but roughly translates to "Deathslobber."

mounts.name: Crimson Tidestallion
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Mrrl
Zone: Nazjatar
Cost: 4 Cultist Pinky Finger 2 Pulsating Blood Stone 1 Hungry Herald's Tentacle Taco
mounts.desc: The blood-red coloration of these creatures is ideal for hiding in large coral formations.

mounts.name: Crimson Venomfang
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Glory of the Venomous Abyss Raider
Category: Dungeons & Raids
mounts.desc: A venomfang's most deadly weapon is its terrifying tail, which can mortally envenom its prey with a mere scratch.

mounts.name: Crimson Vorquin
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Treysh
Zone: The Forbidden Reach
Cost: 40g
Vendor: Tethalash
Zone: Valdrakken
Cost: 40g
mounts.desc: Respected for their resilience in battle, even against dragonfire, these noble beasts are the prized mounts of the dracthyr cavalry.

mounts.name: Crimson Water Strider
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Nat Pagle
Zone: Garrison: Fishing Shack
Faction: Nat Pagle - Honored
Cost: 100 Nat's Lucky Coin
mounts.desc: "Normally bugs are for bait, but how could you look into its eyes and even think that?" -Nat Pagle

mounts.name: Crowd Pummeler 2-30
mounts.srcText: Profession: Khaz Algar Engineering
mounts.desc: Guaranteed to knock the teeth out from your enemies with a single punch!

mounts.name: Crusader's Direhorn
mounts.srcText: Paladin
mounts.desc: A loyal steed to the holy crusaders of Zandalar.

mounts.name: Crusty Crawler
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: This rare giant crab has taken a break from its nautical nonsense deep under the sea to explore the surface.

mounts.name: Crypt Gargon
mounts.srcText:
Covenant: Venthyr
Zone: Revendreth
mounts.desc: Loyal hounds of the Curator, these gargon patrol the crypts and catacombs deterring both trespassing and escape.

mounts.name: Cryptic Aurelid
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: From A to Zereth
Category: Shadowlands
