mounts.desc: The Cyphers of the First Ones are beyond any mortal understanding. A curious effect of the language is that, for reasons unknown, some aurelids are drawn to mortals who aspire to unlock its mystery.

mounts.name: Curious Crystalsniffer
mounts.srcText: Profession: Protoform Synthesis
mounts.desc: Most vombata enjoy tunneling through the ground, but these sniffers seem to have an unerring ability to locate crystals buried deep underground and will congregate around large deposits.

mounts.name: Curious Slateback
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Wriggling Pinnacle Cache
Zone: K'aresh
mounts.desc: This curious slateback somehow managed to get itself stuck in a box. How it fit inside is still up in the air.

mounts.name: Cyan Glowmite
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Waxmonger Squick
Zone: The Ringing Deeps
Cost: 11375 Resonance Crystals
mounts.desc: Glowmites are well-known in the Ringing Deeps for making surprisingly sturdy mounts. This specimen produces a soft cyan glow that kobolds find especially relaxing.

mounts.name: Dapple Gray
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Sister Lilyana
Zone: Stormsong Valley
Faction: Storm's Wake - Exalted
Cost: 10000g
mounts.desc: A favored mount of the sea priests who call Stormsong home.

mounts.name: Dark Iron Core Hound
mounts.srcText: Achievement: Allied Races: Dark Iron Dwarf
mounts.desc: You don't get dogs hotter than this.

mounts.name: Dark Phoenix
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Guild Vendors
Cost: 3000g
mounts.desc: Despite their name, Dark Phoenixes are known to have a warm and cheerful disposition.

mounts.name: Dark Riding Talbuk
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Aldraan (Alliance)
Zone: Nagrand, Outland
Cost: 70 Halaa Battle Token15 Halaa Research Token
Vendor: Coreiel (Horde)
Zone: Nagrand, Outland
Cost: 70 Halaa Battle Token15 Halaa Research Token
mounts.desc: The orcs once hunted these graceful herd animals as part of the om'riggor rite of passage ceremony.

mounts.name: Dark War Talbuk
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Aldraan (Alliance)
Zone: Nagrand, Outland
Cost: 100 Halaa Battle Token20 Halaa Research Token
Vendor: Coreiel (Horde)
Zone: Nagrand, Outland
Cost: 100 Halaa Battle Token20 Halaa Research Token
mounts.desc: Despite their docile nature, talbuks have been known to gore seasoned warriors to death when threatened.

mounts.name: Darkened Vombata
mounts.srcText: Profession: Protoform Synthesis
mounts.desc: The schematic to synthesize these darkened vombata seem to have appeared as a reaction to the Mawsworn invasion. The resulting vombata look different--darker, much like the invaders--but behave normally.

mounts.name: Darkforge Ram
mounts.srcText: Paladin
mounts.desc: A loyal steed to the defenders of Ironforge.

mounts.name: Darkfuse Chompactor
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Ando the Gat
Zone: Liberation of Undermine
Cost: 500g
mounts.desc: Considered the Top Dog among Stix's Junkyard Hyenas, it boasts a bite force strong enough to crush whatever - or whoever - Gallywix wants disposed of.

mounts.name: Darkfuse Demolisher
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Sitch Lowdown
Zone: Undermine
Cost: 11375 Resonance Crystals
mounts.desc: Excellent at making a mess of things. Not so great at cleaning them up.

mounts.name: Darkfuse Spy-Eye
mounts.srcText:
World Quest: Darkfuse Precipitant
Zone: Undermine
mounts.desc: Perfect for the up-and-comer who wants to climb the ladder by making everyone else's business THEIR business.

mounts.name: Darkmaul
mounts.srcText: Zone: Korthia
mounts.desc: An older shardhide, Darkmaul was relatively tame and friendly around Korthians. He was thought lost to the calamity.

mounts.name: Darkmoon Dancing Bear
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Lhara
Zone: Darkmoon Island
Cost: 180 Darkmoon Prize Ticket
mounts.desc: These fearsome mounts have a habit of suddenly breaking out into dance amid battle, much to the annoyance of their riders.

mounts.name: Darkmoon Dirigible
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Lhara
Zone: Darkmoon Island
Cost: 1000 Darkmoon Prize Ticket
mounts.desc: Silas considered using his fleet of blimps for marketing, but decided that selling them directly was all the marketing he needed.

mounts.name: Darkspear Raptor
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Samamba
Zone: Icecrown
Cost: 100 Champion's Seal
mounts.desc: This raptor breed was originally cultivated by the Drakkari, but has since been adopted by the Darkspear tribe in Northrend.

mounts.name: Darkspore Mana Ray
mounts.srcText: Drop: Fel-Spotted Egg
mounts.desc: Some of the natural wildlife of Argus, like the mana ray, has survived and adapted to life on the shattered world.

mounts.name: Darkwarren Hardshell
mounts.srcText: Adventures: Shadowlands
mounts.desc: The Darkwarren Hardshell's chitin is sturdy enough to withstand mortar shells and dragon's fire. It will also conveniently consume anything lacking anima, if needed.

mounts.name: Darkwater Skate
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Galissa Sundew
Zone: Darkmoon Island
mounts.desc: Little is known about this elusive species of ray, found only in the dark waters surrounding Darkmoon Island.

mounts.name: Darnassian Nightsaber
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Rook Hawkfist
Zone: Icecrown
Cost: 100 Champion's Seal
mounts.desc: When a night elf's mount perishes, it is custom for the rider to keep one of the saber's great fangs as a token of remembrance.

mounts.name: Dashing Windsteed
mounts.srcText: World Event: WoW Remix: Mists of Pandaria
mounts.desc: Windsteeds are incredibly gentle and easy to train... if you can catch one.

mounts.name: Dauntless Duskrunner
mounts.srcText:
Covenant Feature: The Ember Court
Covenant: Venthyr
Covenant Feature: Queen's Conservatory
Covenant: Night Fae
Covenant Feature: Path of Ascension
Covenant: Kyrian
Covenant Feature: Abomination Factory
Covenant: Necrolord
mounts.desc: The Path of Ascension is a challenging trial, and those that display all of the facets the Kyrian hold dear will be duly rewarded.

mounts.name: Dauntless Imperial Lynx
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Spreading the Light
Zone: Hallowfall
mounts.desc: This lynx's barding has had most of its insignia ripped off. The one remaining tag reads, "Dauntless".

mounts.name: Dawnforge Ram
mounts.srcText: Paladin
mounts.desc: A loyal steed to the defenders of Ironforge.

mounts.name: Daystorm Windsteed
mounts.srcText: World Event: WoW Remix: Mists of Pandaria
mounts.desc: It is said that when lightning strikes the sun, a gleaming beast in red armor would emerge from the heavens. The Daystorm Windsteed has never heard of these legends and has been here the entire time.

mounts.name: Dazar'alor Windreaver
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Glory of the Dazar'alor Raider
Category: Dungeons & Raids
mounts.desc: Soaring high above the Battle of Dazar'alor, these beasts are drawn to the most cunning of victors.

mounts.name: Deathlord's Vilebrood Vanquisher
mounts.srcText: Quest: The Lost Glacier
mounts.desc: A powerful red dragon raised in undeath by its own life energies, a true mockery of life.

mounts.name: Deathrunner
mounts.srcText: Profession: Protoform Synthesis
mounts.desc: These wild cervids are only truly at peace when running through--or between--the lands of Death.

mounts.name: Deathtusk Felboar
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Shadow Hunter Denjai
Zone: Tanaan Jungle
Faction: Vol'jin's Headhunters - Exalted
Vendor: Vindicator Krethos
Zone: Tanaan Jungle
Faction: Hand of the Prophet - Exalted
mounts.desc: Veterans of the battle for Outland's Hellfire Peninsula are traumatized by thoughts of these beasts to this day.

mounts.name: Deepcoral Snapdragon
mounts.srcText:
Quest: Wild Tame
Zone: Nazjatar
mounts.desc: The snapdragon is a quiet hunter in the water, but is far less stealthy on land.

mounts.name: Deepstar Aurelid
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Hirukon
Zone: Zereth Mortis
mounts.desc: As one of the last remaining polyps of an elusive creature, this aurelid is at home in the water as much as the air.

mounts.name: Delugen
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Elianna
Zone: Emerald Dream
Cost: 1 Dream Infusion
mounts.desc: Imagine being so engrossed by a dream that it feels real; some might even call it a delusion.

mounts.name: Delver's Arcane Golem
mounts.srcText:
Treasure: Sturdy Chest
Zone: Gnarldor Isle
mounts.desc: Originally intended as a gift for Silvermoon, this construct was lost in transit near the shores of Gnarldor Isle.

mounts.name: Delver's Dirigible
mounts.srcText:
Quest: Ship It!
Zone: Isle of Dorn
mounts.desc: This aircraft will help you delve straight into adventure, wherever it may be!

mounts.name: Delver's Gob-Trotter
mounts.srcText:
World Quest: I Want My Hat Back
Zone: Isle of Dorn
Zone: Dornogal
mounts.desc: This aircraft will help you delve straight into adventure, if it doesn't explode!

mounts.name: Delver's Mana-Skimmer
mounts.srcText:
Quest: Repossessed!
Zone: Isle of Dorn
mounts.desc: This aircraft will help you delve straight into adventure, or maybe other dimensions!

mounts.name: Depleted-Kyparium Rocket
mounts.srcText: Profession: Engineering
mounts.desc: When Kyparite is depleted of its amber essence it becomes fairly resistant to the corrosion from rocket fuel.

mounts.name: Depthstalker
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: Poached from Zereth Mortis, a few of these jellyfish were lost when the poachers' ship sank. They found a new home in the Great Sea's depths.

mounts.name: Desertwing Hunter
mounts.srcText: Profession: Protoform Synthesis
mounts.desc: In service of the great Purpose, desertwing hunters were designed to fill distant skies of forgotten realms of the Shadowlands.

mounts.name: Desire's Battle Gargon
mounts.srcText:
Covenant: Venthyr
Zone: Revendreth
mounts.desc: The Countess maintains a small stable of elegantly adorned gargon mounts for her sole use. Many a rival has been taken in by the finery to their peril as she personally oversees their deadly training.

mounts.name: Diamond Mechsuit
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: The War Within Keystone Master: Season One
Category: Dungeons
mounts.desc: These crystal-powered mechsuits are the epitome of Earthen technology.

mounts.name: Dire Wolf
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Ogunaro Wolfrunner
Location: Orgrimmar
Cost: 1g
mounts.desc: Once thought to be extinct except in the far north. Highly sought by those preparing for winter.

mounts.name: Divine Kiss of Ohn'ahra
mounts.srcText:
Quest: A Whispering Breeze
Zone: Ohn'ahran Plains
mounts.desc: ...as though welcomed by the wind itself.

mounts.name: Domesticated Razorback
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Gazrix Gearlock / Mimi Wizzlebub
Faction: Steamwheedle "Preservation" Society - Exalted
Location: Stormshield / Warspear
Cost: 5,000g + 5,000 Apexis Crystal
mounts.desc: "Domesticated" does not mean "friendly." Bring some treats.

mounts.name: Drake of the East Wind
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Glory of the Cataclysm Raider
Category: Dungeons & Raids
mounts.desc: In Deathwing's mad quest to forge new dragons, he ignored amazing breeds never before seen on Azeroth. -Thrall

mounts.name: Drake of the Four Winds
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Ishak of the Four Winds
Zone: Uldum
mounts.desc: Rocks erode, fires sputter, but wind remains powerful regardless of the passage of time. -Phaoris

mounts.name: Drake of the North Wind
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Altairus
Zone: The Vortex Pinnacle
mounts.desc: They sicken of the calm who know the storm.

mounts.name: Drake of the South Wind
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Al'Akir
Zone: Throne of the Four Winds
mounts.desc: Gentle as a summer breeze, but that says little considering where it came from. -Itesh

mounts.name: Drake of the West Wind
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Quartermaster Brazie
Zone: Tol Barad Peninsula
Faction: Baradin's Wardens - Exalted
mounts.desc: Harnessing the elemental powers of the storm, these majestic beasts crackle like lightning and roar like thunder.

mounts.name: Dread Raven
mounts.srcText: Promotion: Warlords of Draenor Collector's Edition
mounts.desc: Filled with the hatred of an ancient god, the dread raven are the Arakkoa's most trusted guardians.

mounts.name: Dreadsteed
mounts.srcText: Class: Warlock
mounts.desc: WARNING: It craves only fel energy. Not apples. It hates the seeds.

mounts.name: Dreamlight Runestag
mounts.srcText:
Covenant: Night Fae
Zone: Ardenweald
mounts.desc: Runestags are granted to those who have pledged their service to the Winter Queen and the Court of Night.

mounts.name: Dune Scavenger
mounts.srcText: Zone: Vol'dun
mounts.desc: These resilient scavengers can survive for months in the wastes of Vol'dun with scarce access to food and water.

mounts.name: Dusk Grimlynx
mounts.srcText:
Quest: History Lesson
Zone: Harandar
mounts.desc: Famously adept at hunting at dusk as the light of dusk blends this grimlynx's foliage with its surroundings.

mounts.name: Dusk-Painted Sun Roc
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: Long ago, the dusk-painted silhouettes of these sun rocs inspired many fireside myths. Their return to Kalimdor has reignited lost stories of these heralds of An'she.

mounts.name: Duskbrute Harrower
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Slayer's Duellum Trove
Zone: Masters' Perch
mounts.desc: These harrowers are attracted to the constant battle cries and bloodshed across Slayer's Rise.

mounts.name: Duskflutter Ardenmoth
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Aithlyn
Zone: Ardenweald
Faction: The Wild Hunt - Exalted
Cost: 30000g
mounts.desc: These ardenmoths prefer the dark and damp forests of northwest Ardenweald, where fungal colonies are perpetually blooming.

mounts.name: Dusklight Razorwing
mounts.srcText: Zone: Korthia
mounts.desc: Razorwings can be seen throughout Korthia, making their nests on high hills and in trees.

mounts.name: Duskwing Ohuna
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Celestine of the Harvest
Zone: The Waking Shores
Zone: Ohn'ahran Plains
Zone: The Azure Span
Zone: Thaldraszus
Cost: 1000 Dreamsurge Coalescence
mounts.desc: If you look to the night sky and see the clouds whisk by don't panic. It may just be the illusive Duskwing Ohuna.

mounts.name: Dusky Waycrest Gryphon
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Quartermaster Alcorn
Zone: Drustvar
Faction: Order of Embers - Exalted
Cost: 90000g
mounts.desc: Common to the dark forests of Drustvar, these gryphon are silent and swift. Their prowess at operating on their own or as mounts lends them to be used for ambush and shock tactics.

mounts.name: Dustmane Direwolf
mounts.srcText: Profession: Leatherworking
mounts.desc: Cautious by direwolf standards, the dustmane can only be coaxed to ride with something it considers special.

mounts.name: Dusty Rockhide
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Vindicator Nuurem
Faction: Council of Exarchs - Exalted
Location: Stormshield
Cost: 5,000g + 5,000 Apexis Crystal
mounts.desc: Ever since acquiring this mount, you have been plagued by strange fever dreams of hippety-hoppety clippety-cloppety elekk on parade.

mounts.name: Earthen Ordinant's Ramolith
mounts.srcText: Paladin
mounts.desc: Beneath the stone surface beats a heart emboldened by order to set this world free from darkness.

mounts.name: Ebon Gryphon
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Tannec Stonebeak
Zone: Stormwind City
Cost: 50g
mounts.desc: They love lions in Stormwind, and the gryphon is half lion. Of course they might not like which half. -Gryphon Master Talonaxe

mounts.name: Echo of Aln'sharan
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Aln'Sharan
Zone: Harandar
mounts.desc: Heed well the song of the Goddess.

mounts.name: Eclipse Dragonhawk
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Cupri
Zone: Shattrath City
Cost: 5000 Timewarped Badge
mounts.desc: Captured from the renegade blood elves at Eclipse Point, these purple dragonhawks were often sought after by Scryers posted to the Sanctum of the Stars.

mounts.name: Elder Glowmite
mounts.srcText:
Quest: Elder Glowmite
Zone: Harandar
mounts.desc: Glowmites slowly grow larger as they age. This one has lived a long, full life.

mounts.name: Elusive Emerald Hawkstrider
mounts.srcText:
Quest: Blood Knight
Zone: Ghostlands
Quest: Victory for the Sin'dorei
Zone: Ghostlands
mounts.desc: Unseen for many years, this brightly hued hawkstrider emerged from hiding to help defend the Ghostlands from the Scourge. Its prowess shines as brilliantly as its feathers.

mounts.name: Elusive Quickhoof
mounts.srcText: Zone: Vol'dun
mounts.desc: The kind nature of alpacas makes them perfect as companions for the intrepid adventurer.

mounts.name: Elven Arcane Guardian
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Naleidea Rivergleam
Zone: Silvermoon City
Cost: 10000 Undercoin
mounts.desc: Sworn defender of the Elven people, animated by arcane power and an unyielding will to protect.

mounts.name: Elysian Aquilon
mounts.srcText:
Covenant: Kyrian
Zone: Bastion
mounts.desc: With anima once again flowing to the Eternal Forge in Bastion, the plans for the aquilon centurion could be crafted once more.

mounts.name: Emberwing Sky Guide
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: "From the foothills of Khaz Modan, we followed its ember-lit wings--a northbound torch across the dark summer sky." - The Pilgrimage of the First Wildsage

mounts.name: Emerald Drake
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Drake Collector
Category: Mounts
mounts.desc: "Is the emerald drake rare? You have no idea. If I had a silver for every time someone asked me about one, I could have retired years ago." -Mei Francis

mounts.name: Emerald Hawkstrider
mounts.srcText:
Quest: The Battle of the Bridge
Zone: Silvermoon City
mounts.desc: Its rider died during battle, and so the saddle is passed to you.

mounts.name: Emerald Hippogryph
mounts.srcText: Recruit-a-Friend
mounts.desc: These majestic animals come in various colorings, but the emerald variety can only be tamed by the magic of friendship.

mounts.name: Emerald Pandaren Phoenix
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: World Vendors
Cost: 1 Ancestral Phoenix Egg
mounts.desc: The colors of this rare phoenix's plumage are said to bring great fortune.

mounts.name: Emerald Raptor
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Zjolnir
Zone: Durotar
Cost: 1g
mounts.desc: Bred from the fiercest stock anywhere and guaranteed not to bite (much).

mounts.name: Emerald Skyfang
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Pro Poison Patroller
Category: Midnight
mounts.desc: Found patrolling the skies of Atal'Utek, maintaining the peace and a full stomach.

mounts.name: Emerald Snail
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: This snail protects its treasures with the ferocity of a dragon, but perhaps not the speed.

mounts.name: Enchanted Dreamlight Runestag
mounts.srcText:
Covenant: Night Fae
Zone: Ardenweald
mounts.desc: The majestic runestags are capable of siphoning anima from the ambient light of Ardenweald with their elaborate antlers. The anima is used as nourishment and to power the runestag's speed and magic.

mounts.name: Enchanted Fey Dragon
mounts.srcText: In-Game Shop
mounts.desc: This majestic creature is Brightwing's older brother. He affirms that she was, in fact, adopted.

mounts.name: Enchanted Shadeleaf Runestag
mounts.srcText:
Covenant: Night Fae
Zone: Ardenweald
mounts.desc: A shadeleaf runestag is capable of goring creatures as powerful as a gorm matriarch in defense of its herd. The Wild Hunt ride these mounts into dangerous corners of the Shadowlands, when their domain must be defended from those who would threaten the wilds.

mounts.name: Enchanted Spellweave Carpet
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Auzin
Zone: Dalaran
Cost: 5000 Timewarped Badge
mounts.desc: Dalaran mages have created an elegant spellweave and self-stitch aura to accompany this flying carpet. Allowing anyone to handle any loose threads and fly in style.

mounts.name: Enchanted Wakener's Runestag
mounts.srcText:
Covenant: Night Fae
Zone: Ardenweald
mounts.desc: Wakener runestags fiercely protect their wildseed groves. When the groves starting to fail, many runestags went berserk.

mounts.name: Enchanted Winterborn Runestag
mounts.srcText:
Covenant: Night Fae
Zone: Ardenweald
mounts.desc: Winterborn runestags are the favored mount of the Winter Queen herself, and she only bestows such a creature on her most favored subjects.

mounts.name: Endmire Flyer
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Famu the Infinite
Zone: Revendreth
mounts.desc: Attracted through portals through which little is known these flying devourers have found a home in the Endmire of Revendreth feeding on the latent anima.

mounts.name: Ensorcelled Everwyrm
mounts.srcText: Promotion: Shadowlands Heroic Edition
mounts.desc: Anima is a fundamental force that infuses the Shadowlands. It flows through many creatures, but is also traded, bartered for, and fought over.

mounts.name: Enterprising Shreddertank
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: The War Within Keystone Legend: Season Two
Category: Dungeons
mounts.desc: Optimized shredder designed for maximum shredding efficiency.

mounts.name: Eternal Phalynx of Courage
mounts.srcText:
Covenant: Kyrian
Zone: Bastion
mounts.desc: Many bars of gildenite are required to forge one of these sparkling mounts, but the sight of them alone is worth the gathering time.

mounts.name: Eternal Phalynx of Humility
mounts.srcText:
Covenant: Kyrian
Zone: Bastion
mounts.desc: When an armored phalynx is forged, stewards clap their hammers together in reverence of the skill required in its creation.

mounts.name: Eternal Phalynx of Loyalty
mounts.srcText:
Covenant: Kyrian
Zone: Bastion
mounts.desc: A marvel of steward engineering, the armored phalynx is a rare and awe-inspiring sight.

mounts.name: Eternal Phalynx of Purity
mounts.srcText:
Covenant: Kyrian
Zone: Bastion
mounts.desc: The armored phalynx is a favorite companion of the mightiest warriors of the Ascended as it is both fearless and vicious in battle.

mounts.name: Eve's Ghastly Rider
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: The preferred transportation of the Fenlow family (especially during Hallow's End).

mounts.name: Evening Sun Dreamsaber
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Talisa Whisperbloom
Zone: Emerald Dream
Cost: 1 Seedbloom
mounts.desc: These dreamsabers are ferocious in battle, yet lethargic and often found lazily outstretched upon open fields. After soaking in the warmth of daylight, their flame flares that much brighter.

mounts.name: Exodar Elekk
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Irisee
Zone: Icecrown
Cost: 100 Champion's Seal
mounts.desc: Exodar Elekk are elekk which have been anointed by O'ros, the Naaru who journeyed from Draenor to Azeroth with Velen and his followers.

mounts.name: Expedition Bloodswarmer
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Provisioner Lija
Zone: Nazmir
Faction: Talanji's Expedition - Exalted
Cost: 10000g
mounts.desc: Orphaned during the rout of the Blood Trolls, this bloodswarmer has been retrained by Talanji's handlers.

mounts.name: Experiment 12-B
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Lesser Cache of the Aspects
Location: Dragon Soul
mounts.desc: Some believe Experiment 12-B is the result of a covert SI-7 initiative, others consider it the outcome of embyronic tinkering by goblin scientists. No matter the case, this much is certain: given its strength, speed and agility, Experiment 12-B was a success!

mounts.name: Explorer's Dunetrekker
mounts.srcText: Recruit-a-Friend
mounts.desc: The surly dunetrekker can easily carry a set of explorers to the nearest ruins and back without the need to rest.

mounts.name: Explorer's Jungle Hopper
mounts.srcText: Recruit-a-Friend
mounts.desc: For when you're making a crash landing in the middle of an uncharted swamp because it's the only way to access that ancient temple.

mounts.name: Explorer's Stonehide Packbeast
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Provisioner Aristta
Zone: Thaldraszus
Cost: 20000 Mysterious Fragment
mounts.desc: A true explorer never stays in one place for long. Having a reliable packbeast with a strong back and sturdy legs is essential for travel.

mounts.name: Fabious
mounts.srcText: Drop: Fabious
mounts.desc: He emerges from the water, fins swaying lazily in the breeze, sun-kissed scales glittering. He is... Fabious.

mounts.name: Fallen Charger
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Fallen Charger
Zone: The Maw
mounts.desc: The charger's screams echo across the Maw as it continues a never-ending ride across the land, forever looking for escape from the endless torments it has been forced to endure.

mounts.name: Fantastical Goblin Waveshredder
mounts.srcText: Promotion
mounts.desc:
When you're ready for fun you're ready for the Fantastical Goblin Waveshredder. Guaranteed to bring the fun.
*Disclaimer: Fun not guaranteed

mounts.name: Farseer's Felscorned Tempest
mounts.srcText: World Event: WoW Remix: Legion
mounts.desc: Fel flavored fury.

mounts.name: Farseer's Raging Tempest
mounts.srcText: Quest: Gathering of the Storms
mounts.desc: Windfury. Overload: (2).

mounts.name: Fathom Dweller
mounts.srcText: Drop: Kosumoth the Hungering
mounts.desc: Deep within the hungering chasms of the Great Sea, swarms of Fathom Dwellers sway like a great floating carpet, sightlessly in the dark.

mounts.name: Feathered Windsurfer
mounts.srcText: World Event: WoW Remix: Mists of Pandaria
mounts.desc: "Check the current windspeed and elevation before mounting. Avoid trees and other tall objects. Damaged kites are ineligible for return or refund." - Windsurfer's Instruction Manual

mounts.name: Fel Iron Juggernaut
mounts.srcText: World Event: WoW Remix: Mists of Pandaria
mounts.desc: This war machine was stolen from a timeline in which Garrosh Hellscream joined the Burning Legion. Suffice it to say, there is not much left of that timeline.

mounts.name: Fel Spirehawk
mounts.srcText: Promotion
mounts.desc: Looking into the eyes of this mystical beast is like peering into the heart of a fel corrupted sun. Goggles are recommended when you're riding.

mounts.name: Fel-Scarred Mana Ray
mounts.srcText: World Event: WoW Remix: Legion
mounts.desc: Surviving on Argus is not an easy task. Its leathery hide scarred by fel corruption, this mana ray is prone to fits of aggression, moreso than usual.

mounts.name: Felblaze Infernal
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Gul'dan
Zone: The Nighthold
mounts.desc: The Illidari were able to break one of these fiery beasts for use as an unstoppable, fearless mount against the Legion.

mounts.name: Felborn Cormaera
mounts.srcText: Promotion
mounts.desc: Cormaera were an early species on Azeroth that were claimed by elemental lords.

mounts.name: Felcrystal Scorpion
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: The results of a fel infusion experiment with one of Skorpyron's offspring.

mounts.name: Feldrake
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Landro Longshot
Location: Booty Bay
mounts.desc: Fighting the Burning Legion millennia ago, this valiant drake fell to corruption after its body was infused with raw demonic magic.

mounts.name: Felfire Hawk
mounts.srcText: Achievement: Mountacular
mounts.desc: Felfire is deadly to the touch. Luckily, the hawk can suppress the flames, choosing not to incinerate its rider in an emerald effigy.

mounts.name: Felglow Mana Ray
mounts.srcText: Drop: Fel-Spotted Egg
mounts.desc: The Army of the Light could only save so many of Argus' native species; countless numbers were lost to chaos.

mounts.name: Felsaber
mounts.srcText: Class: Demon Hunter
mounts.desc: A special creation of Lord Illidan gifted to his most trusted demon hunters.

mounts.name: Felscorned Grandmaster's Companion
mounts.srcText: World Event: WoW Remix: Legion
mounts.desc: A twisted visage of a beloved companion.

mounts.name: Felscorned Highlord's Charger
mounts.srcText: World Event: WoW Remix: Legion
mounts.desc: This horse has been irreversibly scarred by the Legion's corrupt magics.

mounts.name: Felscorned Netherlord's Dreadsteed
mounts.srcText: World Event: WoW Remix: Legion
mounts.desc: Simply oozing with potential.

mounts.name: Felscorned Vilebrood Vanquisher
mounts.srcText: World Event: WoW Remix: Legion
mounts.desc: This flying amalgamation of the forces of death and fel pierces the skies with a bone-chilling screech.

mounts.name: Felscorned War Wyrm
mounts.srcText: World Event: WoW Remix: Legion
mounts.desc: The heavens tremble in anticipation of your arrival.

mounts.name: Felscorned Wolfhawk
mounts.srcText: World Event: WoW Remix: Legion
mounts.desc: Scarred by the war across the Broken Isles, this Wolfhawk deserves a good home.

mounts.name: Felslate Basilisk
mounts.srcText: World Event: WoW Remix: Legion
mounts.desc: Once common on the Broken Isles, felslate basilisks have been hunted heavily by miners seeking their precious skins.

mounts.name: Felsteed
mounts.srcText: Class: Warlock
mounts.desc: Corrupted by demonic power and once forced to serve the Shadow Council.

mounts.name: Felsteel Annihilator
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Archimonde
Location: Hellfire Citadel
Difficulty: Mythic
mounts.desc: Forged deep within Hellfire Citadel by a mad blacksmith, the Felsteel Annihilator combines the metalworking knowledge of the Iron Horde with the chaotic fel energies of the Burning Legion into an unholy union of steel and flame.

mounts.name: Felstorm Dragon
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Time Rifts
Vendor: Falara Nightsong
Zone: Tyrhold Reservoir
Cost: 3000 Paracausal Flakes
mounts.desc: The Burning Legion defeated dragons in a distant timeway. These foul fel wyrms chose corruption and servitude over destruction.

mounts.name: Ferocious Jawcrawler
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Lady Vinazian
Zone: Azj-Kahet
Cost: 2815 Kej
Vendor: Y'tekhi
Zone: Azj-Kahet
Cost: 2815 Kej
mounts.desc: This particularly large jawcrawler is the perfect size to make a mount... just keep your hands and feet clear of its mouth.

mounts.name: Ferocious Snapvine
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: The Snapvines have always been dangerous, but we never realized that the deep variants were independent, and could fly. The fruit from this beast is especially delicious when baked in a pie.

mounts.name: Fierce Grimlynx
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Naynar
Zone: Harandar
Cost: 6000 Voidlight Marl
mounts.desc: This grimlynx has seen many battles against the creatures in the Rift of Aln.

mounts.name: Fierce Razorwing
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Death's Advance Supplies
Zone: Korthia
mounts.desc: Razorwings generally stay away from other Korthian species, but with time and patience, they can be tamed as well.

mounts.name: Fiery Dragonhawk
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Caeris Fairdawn
Zone: Eversong Woods
Cost: 8000 Voidlight Marl
mounts.desc: A dragonhawk whose wings shine as brightly as the leaves of its Eversong home.

mounts.name: Fiery Hearthsteed
mounts.srcText: Promotion: Hearthstone Anniversary
mounts.desc: These flying creatures thunder unseen across the heavens. How fortunate that this one has shown itself to you!

mounts.name: Fiery Warhorse
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Attumen the Huntsman
Location: Karazhan
mounts.desc: Was one of the most vicious steeds stabled in Karazhan.

mounts.name: Flame-Painted Sun Roc
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: In ages past, the sun rocs of Kalimdor were believed to be the messengers of An'she, carrying with them the first flame before dawn and the final light of evenfall.

mounts.name: Flametalon of Alysrazor
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Alysrazor
Zone: Firelands
mounts.desc: As with their matriarch, Alysrazor, the fury and fervor of these elemental avians are unquenchable.

mounts.name: Flameward Hippogryph
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: The Molten Front Offensive
Category: Cataclysm
mounts.desc: Flameward Hippogryphs revel in the defeat of Ragnaros, Lord of Fire.

mounts.name: Flarecore Infernal
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: The Legion has conquered thousands of other planets, devising fiendish alterations to their war machines when faced with extreme conditions.

mounts.name: Flarendo the Furious
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Ando the Gat
Zone: Liberation of Undermine
Cost: 777g
mounts.desc: Being the VIP of VIPs at the Gallagio has its perks, including the keys to this former King of Carnage. Cutting-edge goblin technology allows him to achieve over 100 yards per gallon!

mounts.name: Floestrider Crest-Horn
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: The seldom seen native of the Azure Span is considered blessed by the tuskaar of the region.

mounts.name: Flourishing Whimsydrake
mounts.srcText:
Quest: Emerald Welcome
Zone: Emerald Dream
mounts.desc: These playful protectors of the Emerald Dream may be larger than their faerie dragon relatives, but they are no less mischievous.

mounts.name: Flourishing Whimsydrake
mounts.srcText:
Quest: Emerald Welcome
Zone: Emerald Dream
mounts.desc: These playful protectors of the Emerald Dream may be larger than their faerie dragon relatives, but they are no less mischievous.

mounts.name: Fluffy Comfy Flying Quilt
mounts.srcText: Promotion
mounts.desc: Woven together by some of the finest Dalaran mages, this flying quilt is known for its comfort and fluffy pillows.

mounts.name: Flying Carpet
mounts.srcText: Profession: Tailoring
mounts.desc: Hop aboard this flying carpet to see the shining, shimmering, and splendid world of Azeroth, wonder by wonder.

mounts.name: Flying Machine
mounts.srcText: Profession: Engineering
mounts.desc: The backbone of the Alliance air force is comprised predominantly of gnomish flying machines due to their maneuverability and speed.

mounts.name: Forest Windsteed
mounts.srcText: World Event: WoW Remix: Mists of Pandaria
mounts.desc: The fur of this Windsteed is not only colored to match its woodland home, but also usually contains bits of bark and leaves.

mounts.name: Forged Spiteflyer
mounts.srcText: Profession: Protoform Synthesis
mounts.desc: There's nothing that can make you feel as alive quite like riding through the realm of Death while atop a being that hates you.

mounts.name: Forsaken Warhorse
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Eliza Killian
Zone: Icecrown
Cost: 100 Champion's Seal
mounts.desc: When fallen heroes are raised into undeath, so too are their horses.

mounts.name: Forsaken's Grotesque Charger
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: A corpse is a corpse, of course of course.

mounts.name: Forsworn Aquilon
mounts.srcText:
Covenant: Kyrian
Drop: Wild Worldcracker
Zone: Korthia
mounts.desc: Originally produced by the Forsworn with stolen blueprints, these powerful centurion are now earning a reputation across the Shadowlands.

mounts.name: Fossilized Raptor
mounts.srcText: Profession: Archaeology
mounts.desc: Legends tell of a spell placed upon a hunting raptor who dared to snarl at young Tyrande Whisperwind as she bathed in a jungle pool. The beast is cursed to wander Azeroth - until it apologizes.

mounts.name: Frayfeather Hippogryph
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Bobadormu
Zone: Tanaris
Cost: 5000 Timewarped Badge
Vendor: Grannadormu
Zone: Tanaris
Cost: 5000 Timewarped Badge
mounts.desc: This majestic hippogryph hails from the Frayfeather Highlands of Feralas. Though it previously protected its hatchlings, now it chooses to serve a greater cause.

mounts.name: Frenzied Feltalon
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: A Horde of Hoofbeats
Category: Mounts
mounts.desc: The Legion experimented with the corruption of many different types of wildlife, such as this fiery bird species from a molten world.

mounts.name: Frenzied Shredclaw
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Thraxadar
Zone: Masters' Perch
Faction: Slayer's Duellum - Exalted
Cost: 6000 Voidlight Marl
mounts.desc: Once a pack member dies, these shredclaws enter a frenzy of rage that not even a hulking ultradon can stop.

mounts.name: Frightened Kodo
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Frightened Kodo
Zone: Darkshore
mounts.desc: Nothing frightens a kodo like seeing a bear with antlers.

mounts.name: Frostbrood Proto-Wyrm
mounts.srcText: Promotion: Wrath of the Lich King Classic
mounts.desc: The same magic of undeath that raised the Frostbrood into the Lich King's service has infused this primal wyrm. Its loyalty and ferocity now serve those who defend Azeroth.

mounts.name: Frostfall Groveglider
mounts.srcText: In-Game Shop
mounts.desc: These high-flying denizens of Azeroth's tallest trees have developed a thick, silky coat to adapt to even the coldest climates.

mounts.name: Frostplains Battleboar
mounts.srcText: Achievement: Glory of the Draenor Hero
mounts.desc: If it didn't have the cool tusk ring, it would feel so silly in that outfit.

mounts.name: Frostshard Infernal
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: No Stable Big Enough
Category: Mounts
mounts.desc: These icy minions come from an unknown plane far from this one.

mounts.name: Frostwolf Howler
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Jorek Ironside
Zone: Hillsbrad Foothills
Cost: 2000 Honor
mounts.desc: Raised in the Alterac Mountains by the Frostwolf Clan.

mounts.name: Frostwolf Snarler
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Alterac Valley of Olde
Category: Alterac Valley
mounts.desc: Raised in the Alterac Mountains by the Frostwolf Clan, trained to bite dwarves.

mounts.name: Frosty Flying Carpet
mounts.srcText: Profession: Tailoring
mounts.desc: "I remember my first flying carpet... yeti hair and burlap. Not nearly as nice as this one here." - Frozo the Renowned

mounts.name: Fur-endship Fox
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: These magical creatures thrive on love and friendship.

mounts.name: G.M.O.D.
mounts.srcText:
Drop: High Tinker Mekkatorque
Zone: Battle of Dazar'alor
mounts.desc: Garishly sporting extreme amounts of goblin flair, Gallywix commissioned his Mech of Death to one up Mekkatorque in combat and more importantly in style.

mounts.name: Gargantuan Grrloc
mounts.srcText: In-Game Shop
mounts.desc: It's the biggest murloc you've ever seen!

mounts.name: Garn Nighthowl
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Nok-Karosh
Location: Frostfire Ridge
mounts.desc: The garn are the most fierce predators on Draenor, and always hunt in packs.

mounts.name: Garn Steelmaw
mounts.srcText: Drop: Invader's Forgotten Treasure
mounts.desc: A trainer once tried to put decorative metal in his steelmaw wolf's mouth. He had to wait three days to get it back.

mounts.name: Garnet Razorwing
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Reliwik the Defiant
Zone: Korthia
mounts.desc: Korthia was once known for its bright red flowers. Several species were known for consuming or rolling in them, and taking on bright red coloration as a result.

mounts.name: Garnet Ruinstrider
mounts.srcText: World Event: WoW Remix: Legion
mounts.desc: Outfitted with sturdy barding, Argussian ruinstriders fearlessly carry their riders across the broken wastes of Argus and beyond.

mounts.name: Geargrinder Mk. 11
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Worldsoul-Searching
Category: Expansion Features
mounts.desc: Undergoes a new iteration each time it explodes!

mounts.name: Genesis Crawler
mounts.srcText: Profession: Protoform Synthesis
mounts.desc: The Enlightened who have observed tarachnids believe that this variety may be some of the first beings to ever walk the land of Zereth Mortis.

mounts.name: Geosynchronous World Spinner
mounts.srcText: Profession: Engineering
mounts.desc: This rocket was originally designed to speed up the rotation of the world making for shorter nights. Gnomes with insomnia can have lofty goals.

mounts.name: Ghastly Charger
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Landro Longshot
Location: Booty Bay
mounts.desc: Not all of Medivh's victims are gone for good.

mounts.name: Ghastly Ur'zul
mounts.srcText: World Event: WoW Remix: Legion
mounts.desc: A ravenous breed of demon, the ghastly ur'zul tears through withered flesh and bone the way one would graze a salad.

mounts.name: Ghastropod
mounts.srcText: Promotion
mounts.desc: This snail make a deliberate decision to plunge itself into the slime canals of Undercity. It emerged bigger, stronger but not faster than before.

mounts.name: Giant Coldsnout
mounts.srcText: Drop: Invader's Forgotten Treasure
mounts.desc: Its snout is not just cold but wet. Not a pleasant way to wake up.

mounts.name: Gigantic Grrloc
mounts.srcText: In-Game Shop
mounts.desc: It's the third biggest murloc you've ever seen!

mounts.name: Giganto Manis
mounts.srcText: Achievement: Glory of the Midnight Delver
mounts.desc: Whispers tell of the Giganto Manis, a titanic creature said to dwell within Azeroth's very veins. Those who claim to have seen it speak of claws vast enough to pierce a dragon's heart, and sharp enough to carve through the finest armor forged by mortal hands.

mounts.name: Gilded Prowler
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Adjutant Nikos
Zone: Bastion
Cost: 30000g
mounts.desc: The mighty larion is an apex predator of Bastion, but that does not stop it from enjoying a nice nap in the sunny fields.

mounts.name: Gilded Ravasaur
mounts.srcText: Promotion: Battle for Azeroth Collector's Edition
mounts.desc: A mount fit for Zandalari high priests and councilers, gilded with only the finest decoration and blessed by Rezan, the great devilsaur loa.

mounts.name: Gilded Riding Crane
mounts.srcText: World Event: WoW Remix: Mists of Pandaria
mounts.desc: It is said that an emperor once paid a large sum for a golden crane. Upon discovering that the crane was only colored like that of the precious metal, he hid with shame in his bedchambers for a week.

mounts.name: Gilnean Copper Charger
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: Carve through the night on this loyal, stalwart steed.

mounts.name: Gilnean Iron Charger
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: This noble horse has seen some battles during the curse uprising.

mounts.name: Gilnean Prowler
mounts.srcText:
Quest: Beginning a New Dawn
Zone: Gilneas
mounts.desc: A scrupulous breed of prowlers whose ferocity can only be matched by that of the worgen. These decisive creatures embody discipline and a controlled viciousness that even the worgen have come to admire.

mounts.name: Gilneas Loyalist's Rouncey
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: Steadfast and proud, this steed carries its rider with quiet dignity and unyielding resolve.

mounts.name: Ginormous Grrloc
mounts.srcText: In-Game Shop
mounts.desc: It's the second biggest murloc you've ever seen!

mounts.name: Glacial Tidestorm
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Jaina Proudmoore (Mythic)
Zone: Battle of Dazar'alor
mounts.desc: Though she commands a variety of magical powers, Jaina has always been most proficient at summoning powerful elementals of water and ice.

mounts.name: Gleaming Moonbeast
mounts.srcText: Promotion
mounts.desc: Armored in glistening silver, these devoted mounts are said to be a blessing from Elune herself.

mounts.name: Gloombough Groveglider
mounts.srcText: In-Game Shop
mounts.desc: The Gloombough not only have uniquely dark coloring, but are entirely nocturnal, making them one of the rarest tree-dwellers to spot in person.

mounts.name: Gloomdark Nightmare
mounts.srcText: World Event: WoW Remix: Legion
mounts.desc: Touched by the Emerald Nightmare, this creature's presence in one's dreams is an omen of misfortune. To see one while awake portends absolute catastrophe.

mounts.name: Glorious Felcrusher
mounts.srcText: Drop: Gleaming Footlocker
mounts.desc: After Alleria and Turalyon explained the usefulness of the Draenei's long-time companion animal, the Army of the Light brought several into the fold for training.

mounts.name: Gnomeregan Mechanostrider
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Rillie Spindlenut
Zone: Icecrown
Cost: 100 Champion's Seal
mounts.desc: When you absolutely, positively have to be there right now. -Rillie Spindlenut

mounts.name: Goblin Trike
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Kall Worthaton
Zone: Orgrimmar
Cost: 1g
mounts.desc: A compilation of nuts, bolts, gears, and treated wood paneling make for an unusually smooth ride.

mounts.name: Goblin Turbo-Trike
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Kall Worthaton
Zone: Orgrimmar
Cost: 10g
mounts.desc: The turbo trike's tri-wheel design adds superior stability and a smaller turn radius over its two wheeled cousins.

mounts.name: Gold-Toed Albatross
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Time Rifts
Vendor: Sorotis
Zone: Tyrhold Reservoir
Cost: 3000 Paracausal Flakes
mounts.desc: Soaring from a distant timeway, this never-before-seen avian variant was born in a world of order.

mounts.name: Golden Ashened Cataclysm
mounts.srcText: In-Game Shop
mounts.desc: In the corners of Azeroth, stories are told of a dreaded dragon who swept a pall of torment over the land. In some versions of this story, his fiery presence brought cataclysmic death and destruction worldwide. In other versions, he is blue. Still in other versions, he is gold.

mounts.name: Golden Ashes of Al'ar
mounts.srcText: Promotion
mounts.desc: The golden Al'ar, beloved pet of Kael'thas Sunstrider, proves that death is merely a setback.

mounts.name: Golden Cloud Serpent
mounts.srcText:
Quest: Riding the Skies
Zone: The Jade Forest
mounts.desc: Golden Cloud Serpents are a treasure to be enjoyed by all who visit the continent of Pandaria.

mounts.name: Golden Discus
mounts.srcText: World Event: WoW Remix: Mists of Pandaria
mounts.desc: An ancient mogu artifact awarded to those who are deeply committed to forms of currency.

mounts.name: Golden Gryphon
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Tannec Stonebeak
Zone: Stormwind City
Cost: 50g
mounts.desc: They love lions in Stormwind, and the gryphon is half lion. Of course they might not like which half. -Gryphon Master Talonaxe

mounts.name: Golden King
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: World Vendors
Cost: 1500g
mounts.desc: Don't let the saddle fool you, he's wild, not a tame lion.

mounts.name: Golden Primal Direhorn
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Hiren Loresong
Zone: Isle of Thunder
Faction: Kirin Tor Offensive - Exalted
Cost: 3000g
mounts.desc: Sharp at both ends and crafty in the middle. Leave it to the trolls to think this was a good idea.

mounts.name: Golden Regal Scarab
mounts.srcText: Black Market
mounts.desc: Plated with gold and socketed with emeralds, this scarab is fit to fly royalty in style.

mounts.name: Golden Riding Crane
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Jaluu the Generous
Zone: Vale of Eternal Blossoms
Faction: Golden Lotus - Exalted
Cost: 2500g
mounts.desc: The crane is a symbol of wisdom and nobility, their ability to carry us into the skies is nothing short of miraculous. - Jaluu the Generous

mounts.name: Golden Sunrunner
mounts.srcText: World Event: WoW Remix: Legion
mounts.desc: This free spirit enjoys long trots on the beach and frolicking through varicolored floral fields.

mounts.name: Goldenmane
mounts.srcText: Zone: Stormsong
mounts.desc: Lord Stormsong ordered his cronies to steal this horse from the Norwington Estate in Tiragarde, as he was covetous of its luscious golden mane.

mounts.name: Goldplate Bufonid
mounts.srcText: Profession: Protoform Synthesis
mounts.desc: This armored bufonid is always ready to leap into battle... as long as that battle is really, really close. In a pinch, it can leap multiple times and eventually reach the battle.

mounts.name: Gooey Snailemental
mounts.srcText: Drop: The Forbidden Reach
mounts.desc: Formed from the leftover elemental energies of the Primal Storms, this magical mollusk is faster than it appears.

mounts.name: Gorespine
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Nerissa Heartless
Zone: Maldraxxus
mounts.desc: Nerissa trampled over countless bodies on the back of Gorespine as she rose to prominence as the commander of the Lichsworn forces for the House of Rituals.

mounts.name: Gorestrider Gronnling
mounts.srcText: Achievement: Glory of the Draenor Raider
mounts.desc: Once "befriended", a gronnling will happily carry its rider to their death.

mounts.name: Grand Armored Gryphon
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Agent Malley
Zone: Krasarang Wilds
Faction: Operation: Shieldwall - Exalted
Cost: 2000g
mounts.desc: This noble gryphon is as staunch a battle companion as any member of the Alliance could ask for.

mounts.name: Grand Armored Wyvern
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Tuskripper Grukna
Zone: Krasarang Wilds
Faction: Dominance Offensive - Exalted
Cost: 2000g
mounts.desc: This ferocious beast, renowned among wyvern handlers, was one of the first mounts chosen to take part in the Horde's Dominance Offensive.

mounts.name: Grand Black War Mammoth
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Boss Drop
Location: Vault of Archavon
mounts.desc: Rarely, a war mammoth is born stronger and more tractable than its peers. These mammoths are dubbed "grand" and carry more than one rider to the front lines.

mounts.name: Grand Black War Mammoth
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Boss Drop
Location: Vault of Archavon
mounts.desc: Once used by giants to carry heavily armored warriors, these grand war mammoths can easily bear more than one rider of less-than-giant stature.

mounts.name: Grand Expedition Yak
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Uncle Bigpocket
Zone: Kun-Lai Summit
Cost: 120000g
mounts.desc: These beasts of burden are known to carry over five times their own weight and to be capable of lasting several days without food or water.

mounts.name: Grand Gryphon
mounts.srcText:
Quest: The Silence
Zone: Kun-Lai Summit
mounts.desc: Gryphons' keen eyesight allows them to see over vast distances and warn their riders of any dangers that lie ahead.

mounts.name: Grand Ice Mammoth
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Lillehoff
Zone: The Storm Peaks
Faction: The Sons of Hodir - Exalted
Cost: 10000g
mounts.desc: At home on the narrow, icy trails of the Storm Peaks, these mammoths are the only mounts the ice giants trust to carry large loads and multiple riders.

mounts.name: Grand Ice Mammoth
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Lillehoff
Zone: The Storm Peaks
Faction: The Sons of Hodir - Exalted
Cost: 10000g
mounts.desc: Due to high winds and avalanches, the Sons of Hodir recommend bringing at least two companions if venturing into the dangerous Storm Peaks.

mounts.name: Grand Wyvern
mounts.srcText:
Quest: Breath of Darkest Shadow
Zone: Kun-Lai Summit
mounts.desc: Wyverns hail from some of the most inhospitable regions of Kalimdor, making them masters of adapting to any environment.

mounts.name: Grandiose Grrloc
mounts.srcText: In-Game Shop
mounts.desc: It's the fourth biggest murloc you've ever seen!

mounts.name: Grandmaster's Deep Board
mounts.srcText: Trading Post

mounts.name: Grandmaster's Prophetic Board
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: The chess event was not to be contained. So Medivh fashioned this conveyance to take it on trips.

mounts.name: Grandmaster's Royal Board
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: Always moving forward to position yourself above the pawns below.

mounts.name: Grandmaster's Smokey Board
mounts.srcText: Trading Post

mounts.name: Gravestone Battle Gargon
mounts.srcText:
Covenant: Venthyr
Zone: Revendreth
mounts.desc: Representative of a new loyal batch of gargon, these battle ready beasts will take Renathal's most loyal compatriots into the final battles against the Jailer.

mounts.name: Gray Elekk
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Torallius the Pack Handler
Zone: Azuremyst Isle
Cost: 1g
mounts.desc: Patient and strong, the Elekk exemplify the Draenei attitude towards the hardships of life.

mounts.name: Gray Kodo
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Harb Clawhoof
Zone: Mulgore
Cost: 1g
mounts.desc: "The kodo is the backbone of our people. Wherever the Horde goes - in trade, settlement, or war - there you will find the mighty kodo." - Harb Clawhoof

mounts.name: Gray Ram
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Veron Amberstill
Zone: Dun Morogh
Cost: 1g
mounts.desc: Male rams will often smash their thick skulls against each other for hours to impress a female. In that way, they're very similar to dwarves.

mounts.name: Gray Wolf
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Ogunaro Wolfrunner
Zone: Orgrimmar
Cost: 1g
mounts.desc: This breed of wolf prefers hunting in the fog, relying on its smoky hide to camouflage it from unsuspecting prey.

mounts.name: Great Black Dragon Turtle
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Turtlemaster Odai
Zone: Orgrimmar
Cost: 10g
Vendor: Old Whitenose
Zone: Stormwind City
Cost: 10g
mounts.desc: "Packaged upgrades include; dual-lantern fog lights, emergency brew keg, and genuine Tanji leather seat." - Turtlemaster Odai

mounts.name: Great Blue Dragon Turtle
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Turtlemaster Odai
Zone: Orgrimmar
Cost: 10g
Vendor: Old Whitenose
Zone: Stormwind City
Cost: 10g
mounts.desc: "Packaged upgrades include; dual-lantern fog lights, emergency brew keg, and genuine Tanji leather seat." - Turtlemaster Odai

mounts.name: Great Blue Elekk
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Torallius the Pack Handler
Zone: Azuremyst Isle
Cost: 10g
mounts.desc: An alpha member of the herd, this elekk is a prime example of the mighty creatures which thunder through Northern Nagrand.

mounts.name: Great Brewfest Kodo
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Keg-Shaped Treasure Chest
Holiday: Brewfest
mounts.desc: Coren Direbrew won this prize after drinking a Tauren druid under the table - and the druid was in bear form. It was one of Direbrew's proudest moments.

mounts.name: Great Brown Dragon Turtle
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Turtlemaster Odai
Zone: Orgrimmar
Cost: 10g
Vendor: Old Whitenose
Zone: Stormwind City
Cost: 10g
mounts.desc: "Packaged upgrades include; dual-lantern fog lights, emergency brew keg, and genuine Tanji leather seat." - Turtlemaster Odai

mounts.name: Great Brown Kodo
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Harb Clawhoof
Location: Mulgore
Cost: 10g
mounts.desc: An alpha member of the herd, this kodo is a prime example of the mighty creatures which thunder through the Northern Barrens.

mounts.name: Great Exarch's Elekk
mounts.srcText: Quest
mounts.desc: Only the most distinguished paladins are given the honor of riding this elekk. Its plated armor and purple adornments have been blessed by Prophet Velen himself.

mounts.name: Great Golden Kodo
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Doru Thunderhorn
Zone: Icecrown
Cost: 500g
mounts.desc: An alpha member of the herd, this kodo is a prime example of the mighty creatures which thunder through the Southern Barrens.

mounts.name: Great Gray Kodo
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Harb Clawhoof
Zone: Mulgore
Cost: 10g
mounts.desc: An alpha member of the herd, this kodo is a prime example of the mighty creatures which thunder through Desolace.

mounts.name: Great Green Dragon Turtle
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Turtlemaster Odai
Zone: Orgrimmar
Cost: 10g
Vendor: Old Whitenose
Zone: Stormwind City
Cost: 10g
mounts.desc: "Packaged upgrades include; dual-lantern fog lights, emergency brew keg, and genuine Tanji leather seat." - Turtlemaster Odai

mounts.name: Great Green Elekk
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Torallius the Pack Handler
Zone: Azuremyst Isle
Cost: 10g
mounts.desc: An alpha member of the herd, this elekk is a prime example of the mighty creatures which thunder through Northern Nagrand.

mounts.name: Great Greytusk
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Gorok
Zone: Frostfire Ridge
mounts.desc: Sheds its tusks once a year. Is extremely shy until they grow back.

mounts.name: Great Northern Elderhorn
mounts.srcText: Profession: Leatherworking
mounts.desc: One of the heartiest of species that inhabit the slopes of Highmountain, they can survive for months in freezing blizzards.

mounts.name: Great Purple Dragon Turtle
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Turtlemaster Odai
Zone: Orgrimmar
Cost: 10g
Vendor: Old Whitenose
Zone: Stormwind City
Cost: 10g
mounts.desc: "Packaged upgrades include; dual-lantern fog lights, emergency brew keg, and genuine Tanji leather seat." - Turtlemaster Odai

mounts.name: Great Purple Elekk
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Torallius the Pack Handler
Zone: Azuremyst Isle
Cost: 10g
mounts.desc: An alpha member of the herd, this elekk is a prime example of the mighty creatures which thunder through Northern Nagrand.

mounts.name: Great Red Dragon Turtle
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Turtlemaster Odai
Zone: Orgrimmar
Cost: 10g
Vendor: Old Whitenose
Zone: Stormwind City
Cost: 10g
mounts.desc: "Packaged upgrades include; dual-lantern fog lights, emergency brew keg, and genuine Tanji leather seat." - Turtlemaster Odai

mounts.name: Great Red Elekk
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Irisee
Zone: Icecrown
Cost: 500g
mounts.desc: Never seen in Nagrand, the first red elekk calves were born in Azeroth after the Exodar's arrival. Some breeders theorize that the unique coloration is somehow caused by the same radiation which ravaged Bloodmyst Isle.

mounts.name: Great Sea Ray
mounts.srcText: Profession: Fishing
mounts.desc: The rays of the great sea can travel for many miles in great migratory patterns.

mounts.name: Great Sunwalker Kodo
mounts.srcText: Paladin
mounts.desc: At daybreak, the noble Sunwalkers often perform rituals to bless their mounts, imbuing them with holy magic.

mounts.name: Great White Kodo
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Harb Clawhoof
Zone: Mulgore
Cost: 10g
mounts.desc: A rare albino of the species first spotted in Desolace. The centaur claim that a white kodo is a harbinger of doom.

mounts.name: Green Dragon Turtle
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Turtlemaster Odai
Zone: Orgrimmar
Cost: 1g
Vendor: Old Whitenose
Zone: Stormwind City
Cost: 1g
mounts.desc: Cherished for their heavy carrying capacity and steady gait, these stalwart beasts are the mount of choice for most native Pandaren.

mounts.name: Green Marsh Hopper
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Gottum
Zone: Nazmir
Cost: 333333g
mounts.desc: Gottum collects spawns of Krag'wa from all around the Frogmarsh, but only the most bulbous are used as mounts.

mounts.name: Green Mechanostrider
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Milli Featherwhistle
Zone: Dun Morogh
Cost: 1g
mounts.desc: "The terradynamic exo-plotters are conjoined by hydraulic imaging to the equilibrium enhancers..." -Binjy Featherwhistle

mounts.name: Green Mechanostrider
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Milli Featherwhistle
Zone: Dun Morogh
Cost: 1g
mounts.desc: "The terradynamic exo-plotters are conjoined by hydraulic imaging to the equilibrium enhancers..." -Binjy Featherwhistle

mounts.name: Green Primal Raptor
mounts.srcText: Drop: Cracked Primal Egg
mounts.desc: "Raptors are as loyal as they are vicious. If you ain't friend, you are food." -Kijara

mounts.name: Green Proto-Drake
mounts.srcText: Drop: Cracked Egg
mounts.desc: The vrykul were the first to recognize their potential. Or maybe the second, depending on how you look at it.

mounts.name: Green Qiraji Battle Tank
mounts.srcText:
Drop: World Drop
Location: Temple of Ahn'Qiraj
mounts.desc: This (relatively) domesticated silithid is at home only in the desert sands of Ahn'Qiraj.

mounts.name: Green Riding Nether Ray
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Grella
Zone: Terokkar Forest, Outland
Faction: Sha'tari Skyguard - Exalted
Cost: 200g
mounts.desc: Nether Rays are among the most trusted, versatile mounts in all of Outland and beyond.

mounts.name: Green Shado-Pan Riding Tiger
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Rushi the Fox
Zone: Townlong Steppes
Faction: Shado-Pan - Exalted
Cost: 1500g
mounts.desc: "When waking a tiger, use a long stick. Better yet, tell your friend to wake the tiger instead." -Pandaren Proverb

mounts.name: Green Skeletal Warhorse
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Zachariah Post
Zone: Tirisfal Glades
Cost: 10g
mounts.desc: When fallen heroes are raised into undeath, so too are their horses.

mounts.name: Green Wind Rider
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Drakma
Zone: Orgrimmar
Cost: 50g
mounts.desc: After being freed from vicious harpies by Cairne and Thrall, many of these creatures became valuable companions of the Horde.

mounts.name: Grey Riding Camel
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Dormus the Camel-Hoarder
Zone: Feralas
mounts.desc: Fennimore Quigley is credited with milking the first camel and breaking the record for "longest unintentional flight," all in the same afternoon.

mounts.name: Grey Riding Yak
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Uncle Bigpocket
Zone: Kun-Lai Summit
Cost: 3000g
mounts.desc: Riding Yaks are bred to be slimmer and more agile than their kin.

mounts.name: Grimhowl
mounts.srcText:
Quest: Good Fiery Boy
Zone: Blackrock Depths
mounts.desc: Otherwise known as The Flame Woof, the Fetcher of the Igneous, Molten Core's Best Friend, Forgehound Maximus, the Best Fiery Boy, and "oh no is that an AXE on his face!?"

mounts.name: Grinning Reaver
mounts.srcText: In-Game Shop
mounts.desc: The difference between a smile and a grin is the difference between a kiss and tasting.

mounts.name: Grizzly Hills Packmaster
mounts.srcText: In-Game Shop
mounts.desc: Traders quickly found them a very capable ally when facing the dangers of Northrend and beyond. They also learned that the bears of the Grizzly Hills were fiercely loyal. Especially to those who keep Emperor salmon at hand.

mounts.name: Grotto Netherwing Drake
mounts.srcText:
Quest: Dragon Keeping
Zone: Emerald Dream
mounts.desc: After traveling to Outland and back, it's only natural these drakes seek out new skies.

mounts.name: Grotto Netherwing Drake
mounts.srcText:
Quest: Dragon Keeping
Zone: Emerald Dream
mounts.desc: After traveling to Outland and back, it's only natural these drakes seek out new skies.

mounts.name: Grove Defiler
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Glory of the Legion Raider
Category: Dungeons & Raids
mounts.desc: The Grove Wardens of the Emerald Dream were some of the first to fall to the corrupting influence of the Nightmare.

mounts.name: Grove Warden
mounts.srcText:
Quest: Dark Waters
Zone: Moonglade
mounts.desc: These magical companions are the wardens of peaceful, primordial groves within the Emerald Dream.

mounts.name: Gruesome Flayedwing
mounts.srcText:
Covenant Feature: The Ember Court
Covenant: Venthyr
Covenant Feature: Queen's Conservatory
Covenant: Night Fae
Covenant Feature: Path of Ascension
Covenant: Kyrian
Covenant Feature: Abomination Factory
Covenant: Necrolord
mounts.desc: The flayedwings of Maldraxxus are prized for their ability to soar effortlessly through the skies of the Shadowlands, allowing their rider a surprise opportunity to strike at their foes or support their allies.

mounts.name: Gruffy Comfy Flying Quilt
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: Woven together by some of the grumpiest Dalaran mages, this flying quilt is known for its comfort and fluffy pillows.

mounts.name: Guardian Quilen
mounts.srcText: World Event: WoW Remix: Mists of Pandaria
mounts.desc: When Quan the Relentless fell in battle, his loyal hounds waited for his return. Millenia later, they remain patient.

mounts.name: Guardian Vorquin
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Treysh
Zone: The Forbidden Reach
Cost: 80g
Vendor: Tethalash
Zone: Valdrakken
Cost: 80g
mounts.desc: Trained using ancient dracthyr methods, these armored vorquin are the pinnacle of tactical mounted ground warfare.

mounts.name: Hailstorm Armoredon
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Dragonflight Keystone Master: Season One
Category: Dungeons
mounts.desc: Born in the middle of an ice storm, this armoredon prefers its meals partially frozen.

mounts.name: Hand of Bahmethra
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Tormentors of Torghast
Zone: The Maw
mounts.desc: The most wicked and cruel of her kin, Bahmethra endured the full measure of the Banished One's punishments before her fall.

mounts.name: Hand of Hrestimorak
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Glory of the Dominant Raider
Zone: Sanctum of Domination
mounts.desc: The treachery of Hrestimorak was infamous, betraying his people to claim power. Facing damnation in the Maw, he tried to subvert the Jailer... a foolish act that would earn him an eternity of torment.

mounts.name: Hand of Nilganihmaht
mounts.srcText: Zone: The Maw
mounts.desc: Of all the giants who dared defy the Jailer, Nilganihmaht was the most arrogant. For this transgression, the giant's severed hand was hidden within a veil of torments, and the rings that could summon it back were scattered across the Maw.

mounts.name: Hand of Reshkigaal
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: Reshkigaal bided her time as her kin each tried their hand at usurping the Banished One. She sought to attack when he was distracted, but the Jailer's spies had been tracking her. With their warning and aid, the Jailer prevailed.

mounts.name: Hand of Salaranga
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Breaking the Chains
Zone: Korthia and The Maw
mounts.desc: Salaranga was the most cunning of her kin and hid amongst the Beastwarrens. She struck at the Banished One with a horde of bestial allies. It did not matter.

mounts.name: Harbor Gryphon
mounts.srcText: Quest: Time to Fly
mounts.desc: This gryphon was the runt of its pride, left behind when its brethren were sent for training. Today, however, it is ready to prove its worth.

mounts.name: Harmonious Salutations Bear
mounts.srcText: Promotion
mounts.desc: Riding this mount fills you with a stillness and peace that is not frequently known to accompany murlocs or bears.

mounts.name: Harvester's Dredwing
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Harvester's War Chest
Zone: The Maw
mounts.desc: The dredwings of the Harvesters fear no mawsworn, and will gleefully sink their teeth into anything that threatens Sinfall.

mounts.name: Hateforged Blazecycle
mounts.srcText: Promotion
mounts.desc: This sweet deathcycle lets you go on your very own burning rubber crusade!

mounts.name: Headless Horseman's Mount
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Loot-Filled Pumpkin
Holiday: Hallow's End
mounts.desc: Be it into the flood, or into the fire, this one will go where you require.

mounts.name: Heart of the Aspects
mounts.srcText: In-Game Shop
mounts.desc: You are Azeroth's true guardians and the future of this world is in your hands, for the dawning of the age of mortals has begun. - Alexstrasza

mounts.name: Heartbond Lupine
mounts.srcText: Profession: Protoform Synthesis
mounts.desc: From the moment of its creation, this packless lupine has held nothing more than deepest affection and loyalty towards you.

mounts.name: Hearthkeeper's Wandering Caravan
mounts.srcText: In-Game Shop
mounts.desc: Comfortable as your own home and adventurous as a tortollan trader, the Hearthkeeper's Wandering Caravan will carry you in luxurious style anywhere your travels on Azeroth take you.

mounts.name: Hearthsteed
mounts.srcText: Promotion: Hearthstone
mounts.desc: Each step echoes with the rage of your three opponents.

mounts.name: Heartlight Vombata
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Vilo
Zone: Zereth Mortis
Faction: The Enlightened - Exalted
Cost: 5000 Reservoir Anima
mounts.desc: The Enlightened revere all creations of the First Ones, yet for many, the vombata of Zereth Mortis are the most beloved. These creatures are equal parts trusted beast of burden and beloved companion.

mounts.name: Heartseeker Mana Ray
mounts.srcText:
World Event: Love is in the Air
Cost: 270 Love Token
mounts.desc: Someone once told this mana ray it was adorable. It has been pursuing that positive feeling ever since.

mounts.name: Heavenly Azure Cloud Serpent
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Lord of the Reins
Category: Mounts
mounts.desc: Warmth and serenity emanate from this great creature, which glows like the cloudless sky of a summer afternoon.

mounts.name: Heavenly Crimson Cloud Serpent
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Glory of the Pandaria Raider
Category: Dungeons & Raids
mounts.desc: Heavenly Crimson Cloud Serpents are considered to be among the noblest of dragons.

mounts.name: Heavenly Golden Cloud Serpent
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Mistweaver Ku
Zone: Timeless Isle
Faction: Emperor Shaohao - Exalted
mounts.desc: Warmth and hope emanate from this great creature, which glows like a sunrise over the mountains.

mounts.name: Heavenly Onyx Cloud Serpent
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Sha of Anger
Location: Kun-Lai Summit
mounts.desc: Heavenly Onyx Cloud Serpents are born with violet scales covering the entirety of their body. Over time, these scales darken to the color of onyx.

mounts.name: Hellfire Infernal
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Gul'dan (Mythic)
Zone: The Nighthold
mounts.desc: From the bowels of the nether is summoned a creature of pure hatred, bent on burning down any life in its way.

mounts.name: Herald of Sa'bak
mounts.srcText: In-Game Shop
mounts.desc: The Tol'vir tell of the legendary Sa'bak, a great crocolisk believed to have emerged from the sacred valley of Un'Goro crater. Although few have ever seen Sa'bak in the flesh, many believe he was blessed by the Titan Keepers to safeguard the vast waterways of Uldum.

mounts.name: Heritage Undercrawler
mounts.srcText:
Vendors: Yamas the Provider, Anub'okki, Aspirake Kiipka
Zone: Azj-Kahet
Cost: 2020 Kej
mounts.desc: Arachnid husbandry is a time-honored tradition amongst the Heritage Forces. Though most specimens are used for transport labor or raised to serve as shock troops, the finest examples of their brood are occasionally trained as parade mounts.

mounts.name: Hexed Vilefeather Eagle
mounts.srcText:
Treasure: Abandoned Ritual Skull
Zone: Zul'Aman
mounts.desc: Once a proud sky-hunter, she now soars on withered wings, her spirit twisted by lingering necromantic curses that seep through every rotting plume and ghostlit eye.

mounts.name: Hexflame Reaver
mounts.srcText: Drop: Ral'kala
mounts.desc: Its glow is a warning: the hunt is already over.

mounts.name: High Priest's Felscorned Seeker
mounts.srcText: World Event: WoW Remix: Legion
mounts.desc: This fel-infused feathered friend flaps its wings at a frenetic pace to remain far above the frenzy below.

mounts.name: High Priest's Lightsworn Seeker
mounts.srcText: Quest: The Sunken Vault
mounts.desc: Once plentiful, only three seekers remain on Azeroth after generations of battling the corruption of the cosmos.

mounts.name: High Shaman's Aerie Gryphon
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: The ancient Wildhammer shamans who first encountered gryphons believed them to be elemental spirits in mortal form. This encounter would forever imprint on the Wildhammer clan for generations to come.

mounts.name: High-Yield Shreddertank
mounts.srcText: Vendor: Lindormi
mounts.desc: High return. High risk. Non-refundable.

mounts.name: Highland Drake
mounts.srcText: Achievement: Dragon Isles: Highland Drake
mounts.desc: The drakes of Azure Span follow a strict personal code of honor as they explore the isles anew.

mounts.name: Highland Drake
mounts.srcText: Achievement: Dragon Isles: Highland Drake
mounts.desc: The drakes of Azure Span follow a strict personal code of honor as they explore the isles anew.

mounts.name: Highland Elderhorn
mounts.srcText: World Event: WoW Remix: Legion
mounts.desc: The hide of a highland elderhorn is incredibly thick. Never in recorded history has a highland elderhorn even blinked in response to insults thrown at them.

mounts.name: Highland Mustang
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Doomrider Helgrim
Zone: Arathi Highlands
mounts.desc: A valiant steed on the Arathi Highlands, it knows no fear.

mounts.name: Highlands Gobbler
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: Fierce and very large turkeys are now occasionally seen roaming the deep forests of Tirisfal after the blighting during the Fourth War.

mounts.name: Highlord's Golden Charger
mounts.srcText: Quest: Stirring in the Shadows
mounts.desc: The fanciest of all of the horses.

mounts.name: Highlord's Valorous Charger
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Crusader Lord Dalfors
Zone: Sanctum of Light
mounts.desc: Has many valorous points.

mounts.name: Highlord's Vengeful Charger
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Crusader Lord Dalfors
Zone: Sanctum of Light
mounts.desc: What's he so mad about?

mounts.name: Highlord's Vigilant Charger
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Crusader Lord Dalfors
Zone: Sanctum of Light
mounts.desc: His blank horse stare is "vigilance," actually.

mounts.name: Highmountain Elderhorn
mounts.srcText: Drop: Highmountain Supplies
mounts.desc: The favored mount of Highmountain hunters, they can easily leap across the rushing rivers of Pinerock Basin even when saddled with a full-sized Tauren.

mounts.name: Highmountain Thunderhoof
mounts.srcText: Achievement: Allied Races: Highmountain Tauren
mounts.desc: A gift from the tauren who trained this sure-footed highland moose to safely traverse the paths and peaks of Highmountain.

mounts.name: Highwind Darkmane
mounts.srcText: Adventures: Shadowlands
mounts.desc: The Forsworn and their mounts take on a darker aspect upon renouncing the path laid forth by the Archon. While tame enough to ride, the Highwind Darkmane has a fiercely independent streak.

mounts.name: Hogrus, Swine of Good Fortune
mounts.srcText: In-Game Shop
mounts.desc: Hogrus was first seen by Emperor Shaohao on the third day of his meditation, and is considered by the Pandaren to be a sign of good fortune to come to those who take action.

mounts.name: Honeyback Harvester
mounts.srcText:
Quest: Leaving the Hive: Harvester
Zone: Stormsong Valley
mounts.desc: While most Harvesters dream only of honey and flowers, this adventurous specimen looks to the wide world beyond Stormsong Valley.

mounts.name: Honeyback Hivemother
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: I'm On Island Time
Category: Exploration
mounts.desc: Destined to become queen of her hive, she scouts Kul Tiras and Zandalar in search of a suitable home for a new colony to flourish.

mounts.name: Hooktalon
mounts.srcText: Special Event: Plunderstorm
mounts.desc: Hooktalon once sailed with the Bloodsail Buccaneers, and later with the Blackwater Raiders, but he left to see what plunder he could find beyond the high seas.

mounts.name: Hopecrusher Gargon
mounts.srcText:
Covenant: Venthyr
Zone: Revendreth
mounts.desc: Once the loyal mount of a House Briarbane lord, it turned on the lord and his retinue. Members of House Briarbane now whisper of a dark Gargon lying in wait even baiting venthyr who venture through the darker parts of the Chalice District of Revendreth.

mounts.name: Horrid Dredwing
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Harika the Horrid
Covenant: Venthyr
Zone: Revendreth
mounts.desc: Harika the Horrid terrorized the denizens of the Forest Ward, and with her demise her broodlings can now take this horror to denizens farther afield.

mounts.name: Hulking Deathroc
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Violet Mistake
Zone: Maldraxxus
mounts.desc: Deathrocs are stitched monstrosities from the discarded viscera, bone, and organs that were not required to construct soldiers for the House of Constructs.

mounts.name: Huntmaster's Dire Wolfhawk
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Pan the Kind Hand
Zone: Trueshot Lodge
mounts.desc: If asked to fetch, will most likely bring you back the head of a small mammal or humanoid.

mounts.name: Huntmaster's Fierce Wolfhawk
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Pan the Kind Hand
Zone: Trueshot Lodge
mounts.desc: A jumble of talons and claws that can fly and swim. No one is safe.

mounts.name: Huntmaster's Loyal Wolfhawk
mounts.srcText: Quest: Night of the Wilds
mounts.desc: The spirit of the Great Hunter found you worthy, and now its children will answer your call forevermore.

mounts.name: Hypo-Speed X6000
mounts.srcText: Promotion
mounts.desc: A compilation of nuts, bolts, gears, and treated wood paneling make for an unusually speedy ride.

mounts.name: Ice Mammoth
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Lillehoff
Zone: The Storm Peaks
Faction: The Sons of Hodir - Revered
Cost: 1000g
mounts.desc: Many ice giants claim that they have trained their favored white mammoths to trigger avalanches with their trumpeting calls.

mounts.name: Ice Mammoth
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Lillehoff
Zone: The Storm Peaks
Faction: The Sons of Hodir - Revered
Cost: 1000g
mounts.desc: The Sons of Hodir believe that riding an ice-white mammoth will protect the rider from frostbite and snow blindness.

mounts.name: Icebound Frostbrood Vanquisher
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Glory of the Icecrown Raider (25 player)
Category: Dungeons & Raids
mounts.desc: Raised from the chilling depths of Icecrown, Frostbrood Vanquishers are considered among the fiercest and most relentless of all frost wyrms.

mounts.name: Igneous Shalewing
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Saccratros
Zone: Zaralek Cavern
Cost: 400 Coveted Bauble
mounts.desc: You'd be forgiven for mistaking this creature for a flying volcanic rock. Because to some extent, it is.

mounts.name: Illidari Blightstalker
mounts.srcText: World Event: WoW Remix: Legion
mounts.desc: These demons devour plague and relish in decay. Who thought it would be a good idea to ride them?

mounts.name: Illidari Doomhawk
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Doomwalker
Zone: Tanaris
mounts.desc: Once a year, a rift in time appears, and strange things occur. The Illidari scouts and Doomwalker were quite surprised to find themselves in Tanaris.

mounts.name: Illidari Dreadstalker
mounts.srcText: World Event: WoW Remix: Legion
mounts.desc: Despite their taste for flesh and unnatural ability to smell fear, these lesser demons have been dominated by the Illidari as one would tame a hunting companion.

mounts.name: Illidari Felstalker
mounts.srcText: Promotion: Legion Collector's Edition
mounts.desc: The Illidari have broken some lesser demons for use against their Legion masters.

mounts.name: Imagiwing
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Elianna
Zone: Emerald Dream
Cost: 1 Dream Infusion
mounts.desc: There's nothing more beautiful than watching your imagination take flight.

mounts.name: Imperial Quilen
mounts.srcText: Promotion: Mists of Pandaria Collector's Edition
mounts.desc: Favorite pets of the ancient Mogu princes, Quilen make loyal and fearless companions and mounts.

mounts.name: Inarius' Charger
mounts.srcText: Drop: Greedy Emissaries
mounts.desc: A symbol of vengeance throughout all known realms.

mounts.name: Incognitro, the Indecipherable Felcycle
mounts.srcText: World Event: WoW's 20th Anniversary?
mounts.desc: This demonic machine was designed by Chief Engineer Ulzik as an experiment in cross-dimensional traversal. Despite many deaths during testing, Ulzik remained confident that this vehicle would reveal secrets of the universe previously unknowable.

mounts.name: Indigo Coiled Horror
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Jan'sari the Watchful
Zone: The Coiled Isle
Cost: 6000 Voidlight Marl
mounts.desc: Writhes have three distinct temperaments, making them three times as difficult to tame.

mounts.name: Ineffable Skitterer
mounts.srcText: Profession: Protoform Synthesis
mounts.desc: These tarachnids move with a purpose unknown to others, answering only to a higher calling. Whatever that may be, it appears to include routine assistance to mortals who need a ride. For now.

mounts.name: Infernal Direwolf
mounts.srcText: Achievement: Glory of the Hellfire Raider
mounts.desc: A mighty wolf of Draenor, touched by the fel energies unleashed by Gul'dan in Tanaan Jungle. It has not gone completely mad... yet.

mounts.name: Inferno Armoredon
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Dragonflight Keystone Master: Season Two
Category: Dungeons
mounts.desc: Its tail smells like campfire but its breath smells like brimstone.

mounts.name: Infested Necroray
mounts.srcText: Drop: Oozing Necroray Egg
mounts.desc: Necrorays lay their eggs in small clusters within the frills and hollows of decaying fungal blooms.

mounts.name: Infinite Armoredon
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Dragonflight Keystone Master: Season Four
Category: Dungeons
mounts.desc: Even among the armoredon, the possibilities for the future are infinite.

mounts.name: Infinite Timereaver
mounts.srcText: World Event: Timewalking Dungeons
mounts.desc: Fickle and savage, these drakes slip in and out of time until they find a worthy rider.

mounts.name: Inkscale Deepseeker
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Crafticus Mindbender
Zone: Nazjatar
Cost: 150 Nazjatar Battle Commendation
Vendor: Dazzerian
Zone: Nazjatar
Cost: 150 Nazjatar Battle Commendation
mounts.desc: Schools of tidestallions will viciously slam their muscular chests into their prey to take them down.

mounts.name: Innovation Investigator
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Skedgit Cinderbangs
Zone: Undermine
Cost: 25 Miscellaneous Mechanica
mounts.desc: When the best path to a good idea is going really fast.

mounts.name: Inquisition Gargon
mounts.srcText:
Covenant: Venthyr
Zone: Revendreth
mounts.desc: The gargon of the Inquisitors are some of the most vicious ever carved. The Avowed seek to recapture these beasts and return them to the righteous duty of assisting in the purifying of souls rather than the perversions performed at the hands of the Inquisitors.

mounts.name: Insatiable Shredclaw
mounts.srcText:
Treasure: Final Clutch of Predaxas
Zone: Voidstorm
mounts.desc: The shredclaw has fully embraced the way of the Void: never satisfied, constantly seeking out new strength to dominate and new prey to devour.

mounts.name: Invincible
mounts.srcText:
Drop: The Lich King
Zone: Icecrown Citadel
mounts.desc: The famous steed of Arthas Menethil, who serves its master in life and in death. Riding him is truly a feat of strength.

mounts.name: Iron Skyreaver
mounts.srcText: In-Game Shop
mounts.desc: Iron Horde beastmasters bred this rylak for war and then girded it for battle in black steel and smoldering flame.

mounts.name: Ironbound Proto-Drake
mounts.srcText:
