Achievement: Glory of the Ulduar Raider
Category: Dungeons & Raids
mounts.desc: His skin more hard than brass was found, that sword nor spear could pierce nor wound.

mounts.name: Ironbound Wraithcharger
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Auzin
Zone: Dalaran
Cost: 5000 Timewarped Badge
mounts.desc: Its ethereal spirit is barely contained by its iron shell. The penultimate creation of Salanar the Horseman, these powerful steeds were once thought to have all been destroyed.

mounts.name: Ironclad Frostclaw
mounts.srcText: Achievement: Two Sides to Every Tale
mounts.desc: Captured in the snows of Alterac Valley, this bloodthirsty hunter now roars for the Alliance.

mounts.name: Ironforge Ram
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Derrick Brindlebeard
Zone: Icecrown
Cost: 100 Champion's Seal
mounts.desc: Wildhammer Fact Checker claims that this specific breed was the first type of ram domesticated by the dwarves when they settled in Dun Morogh.

mounts.name: Ironhoof Destroyer
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Blackhand
Location: Blackrock Foundry (Mythic)
mounts.desc: Blackhand is said to have personally designed the fiery armaments used on the Iron Horde's clefthoof battle mounts.

mounts.name: Ironside Warwolf
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Kil'rip
Faction: Laughing Skull - Exalted
Location: Horde Garrison Trading Post
Cost: 5,000g + 5,000 Apexis Crystal
mounts.desc: It has an armored spike on its tail. Scratch its belly at your own risk.

mounts.name: Iskaara Trader's Ottuk
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Tattukiaka
Zone: The Azure Span
Cost: 1 Terros's Captive Core 1 Eye of the Vengeful Hurricane
mounts.desc: There are no guarantees when you purchase an ottuk from Tattukiaka. At least they're cute.

mounts.name: Island Thunderscale
mounts.srcText: Drop: Island Expeditions
mounts.desc: One of the larger native dragon species on Azeroth, this subspecies subsists almost entirely on fish. And fishermen.

mounts.name: Ivory Cloud Serpent
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Ivory Cloud Serpent
Zone: Vale of Eternal Blossoms
mounts.desc: Ivory Cloud Serpents are often mistaken for roaring thunder as they tear through the skies with blistering speed.

mounts.name: Ivory Goliathus
mounts.srcText: Achievement: Glory of the War Within Delver
mounts.desc: These giant beetles spend their lives in the darkest tunnels of Khaz Algar. Though they are deprived even of the faintest glimmer of artificial sunlight, they still thrive.

mounts.name: Ivory Grimlynx
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Allied Race: Haranir
Category: Midnight
mounts.desc: Ivory grimlynxes have a strong independent streak. It takes an especially brave Haranir to ride them.

mounts.name: Ivory Hawkstrider
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Trinket
Zone: Highmountain
Cost: 10000g
mounts.desc:
"My winged children fill the skies. Not this one though."
-Aviana

mounts.name: Ivory Savagemane
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Churbro
Zone: Boralus Harbor
Cost: 5000 Timewarped Badge
Vendor: Churbro
Zone: Zuldazar
Cost: 5000 Timewarped Badge
mounts.desc: According to Raptari legend, during Dazar's first ascent up the slopes of Zandalar, the soon-to-be-King was guided through the darkness by the shimmer of ivory scales and gleaming red eyes.

mounts.name: Ivory Trader's Ottuk
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Tattukiaka
Zone: The Azure Span
Cost: 1 Thunderous Downburst Ring 1 Unstable Arcane Loop 1 Platinum Star Band
mounts.desc: No adult knows why some ottuks are white, but any tuskarr child can tell you: it's because they eat too much snow.

mounts.name: Jade Cloud Serpent
mounts.srcText:
Quest: Riding the Skies
Zone: The Jade Forest
mounts.desc: Jade Cloud Serpents are light and agile; quick and deadly.

mounts.name: Jade Pandaren Kite
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: We're Going to Need More Saddles
Category: General
mounts.desc: The residents of Pandaria salute your enthusiasm for wildlife preservation. They do have concerns about housing 150 animals per visit, though.

mounts.name: Jade Panther
mounts.srcText: Profession: Jewelcrafting
mounts.desc: Legends say that an ancient pandaren emperor crafted the first jeweled panther for his son after the boy's twin brother died of an illness.

mounts.name: Jade Primordial Direhorn
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Zandalari Warbringer
Zone: Dread Wastes, Kun-Lai Summit, Townlong Steppes, Valley of the Four Winds
mounts.desc: The festive coloring belies deadly intent.

mounts.name: Jade Pterrordax
mounts.srcText: World Event: WoW Remix: Mists of Pandaria
mounts.desc: This favored mount of the Zandalari is a great singer, or so it thinks.

mounts.name: Jade, Bright Foreseer
mounts.srcText: In-Game Shop
mounts.desc: The presence of this majestic Pandaren rabbit spirit brings joy and happiness and is heralded as a wonderful omen. Legend says that in its eyes, you can glimpse the greatest happiness of your life, even if it is yet to come.

mounts.name: Jani's Trashpile
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: A Farewell to Arms
Category: Expansion Features
mounts.desc: One mon's trash be another mon's loa! Hek hek hek...

mounts.name: Jeweled Copper Scarab
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: The rulers of desert kingdoms would attune crystals to their personal mounts for quick summoning.

mounts.name: Jeweled Jade Scarab
mounts.srcText: Promotion
mounts.desc: The razor-thin wings of this scarab are well-protected by a gleaming, yet indestructible jade-carved carapace.

mounts.name: Jeweled Onyx Panther
mounts.srcText: Profession: Jewelcrafting
mounts.desc: Trade Prince Gallywix recently ordered dozens of these glittering jewel-encrusted mounts to roam the grounds of his pleasure palace.

mounts.name: Jeweled Sapphire Scarab
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: Begifted to a young Tol'vir Princess, this ornate jeweled statue was brought to life by the Gemseers of Ramkahen.

mounts.name: Jigglesworth Sr.
mounts.srcText: Achievement: Fates of the Shadowlands Raids
mounts.desc: It's unclear how the saddle stays atop this formerly feline friend, but somehow the House of Plagues made it work. Science.

mounts.name: Jungle Riding Crane
mounts.srcText: World Event: WoW Remix: Mists of Pandaria
mounts.desc: A beloved mount in southern Pandaria, the jungle crane is known for its speed and agility honed over a lifetime of avoiding Krasari tigers.

mounts.name: Junkheap Drifter
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Rustfeather
Zone: Mechagon
mounts.desc: When you really want to be noticed... and don't mind strapping yourself to a giant, barely-held-together wheel.

mounts.name: Junkmaestro's Magnetomech
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Glory of the Liberation of Undermine Raider
Category: Dungeons & Raids
mounts.desc: Well-suited for compacting trash into rollable balls. Junkmaestro apocrypha claims these might become worlds of their own if only they could get big enough.

mounts.name: K'arroc Swiftwing
mounts.srcText:
Quest: Off to Tazavesh, Again
Zone: K'aresh
mounts.desc: A gift for services rendered, this K'arroc has seen its share of hazardous flights.

mounts.name: Kafa Yak
mounts.srcText: World Event: WoW Remix: Mists of Pandaria
mounts.desc: It's unclear whether grummles named this yak after its color or purpose.

mounts.name: Kah, Legend of the Deep
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: The Derby Dash
Category: Fishing

mounts.name: Kaldorei Nightsaber
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Croz Bloodrage
Zone: Darkshore
Drop: Shadowclaw
Zone: Darkshore
mounts.desc: The connection between a nightsaber and its hunter or huntress is nearly inseparable.

mounts.name: Kaldorei War Wolf
mounts.srcText: Promotion
mounts.desc: Captured in a Kaldorei raid, the loyalty of the wolf favors the strongest.

mounts.name: Kalu'ak Crest-Horn
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: The tuskarr do not call these Crest-Horn "Kalu'ak" to claim them, but as a warning they will not tolerate any more lost to poachers seeking their unique antlers.

mounts.name: Keg Leg's Radiant Crocolisk
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: The pirate captain later known as Keg Leg knew the risks when he rode a hungry crocolisk into battle.

mounts.name: Kickin' Kezan Waveshredder
mounts.srcText: In-Game Shop
mounts.desc:
If everybody had an ocean, they'd go surfing with this sweet waveshredder. But in the case of not having an ocean, you can surf the skies!
Hang 8!

mounts.name: Kor'kron Annihilator
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Goram
Zone: Orgrimmar
Cost: 1500g
mounts.desc: Vicious in battle and surprisingly loyal, this battle scorpion serves only those who show true commitment to a powerful guild.

mounts.name: Kor'kron Juggernaut
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Garrosh Hellscream
Location: Siege of Orgrimmar
mounts.desc: The Kor'kron Juggernaut is a weapon of unbridled destruction, born from the mind of Garrosh Hellscream and made real by his engineers.

mounts.name: Kor'kron War Wolf
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Ahead of the Curve: Garrosh Hellscream (10/25 player)
Category: Feats of Strength
mounts.desc: The Kor'kron use only the mightiest wolves for their mounts, bedecking them in armor that would break the backs of lesser creatures.

mounts.name: Kor'kron Warsaber
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: Finding a litter of nightsaber kittens, a squad of Kor'kron Outriders trained them into a formidable pack of deadly mounts.

mounts.name: Kua'fon
mounts.srcText:
Quest: Down, But Not Out
Zone: Zuldazar
mounts.desc: Once a little hatchling, raised into a mighty pterrordax by a loving handler. He never did learn to fly.

mounts.name: Kul Tiran Charger
mounts.srcText: Achievement: Allied Races: Kul Tiran Human
mounts.desc: The Kul Tiran military prides itself on mastery of both sea, through a vast navy, and land, with armed cavalry.

mounts.name: Lab-Grown Stormray
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Staring Into The Void
Category: Midnight
mounts.desc: Through the intensive research in the Void, researchers were able to bring this stormray back to life completely tamed.

mounts.name: Lambent Mana Ray
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Venomtail Skyfin
Zone: Eredath
mounts.desc: Some of the natural wildlife of Argus, like the mana ray, has survived and adapted to life on the shattered world.

mounts.name: Lana'thel's Crimson Cascade
mounts.srcText: In-Game Shop
mounts.desc: The Blood Queen's mastery of the sanguine arts allowed her to conjure a fearsome servant to bear her into battle. Adorned in livery suited to her court, it is masked with a fearsome visage, and adorned with wings and claws to bring to mind its master's wrath.

mounts.name: Lavaborn Cormaera
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: Under the eye of the elemental lords, many cormaera were twisted by their forces and became loyal mounts and partners.

mounts.name: Lavender K'arroc
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Shad'anis
Zone: K'aresh
Cost: 10 Untethered Coin
mounts.desc: This particularly belligerent K'arroc's previous master died while investigating Untethered Space. Perhaps it will accept you instead... or maybe not.

mounts.name: Lavender Pseudoshell
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: The plants of the deep lands often emulate the creatures of of Azeroth. The purpose of the mimicry is unknown, but can be quite disturbing when the terrestrial mollusks are on the wrong end of an arboreal meal.

mounts.name: Leaping Veinseeker
mounts.srcText: Zone: Nazmir
mounts.desc: Bug spray and a hat with netting aren't going to do much in the swamps of Nazmir, bring a club.

mounts.name: Legion-Forged Elekk
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: The Burning Legion envied the draenei's bond with the elekks of Draenor. Many demonic beast-masters warped the breed to serve their needs, but none could control them.

mounts.name: Leyfeather Hippogryph
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Glory of the Legion Hero
Category: Dungeons & Raids
mounts.desc: Ancient mounts of the Highborne, now left to run wild in the Broken Isles, they can rarely be found due to their latent magical powers.

mounts.name: Leystone Basilisk
mounts.srcText: World Event: WoW Remix: Legion
mounts.desc: This beautiful basilisk is often hunted for the magical properties of its organs. Fortunately for the basilisk, its connection to ley lines gives it a prescient sense of approaching predators.

mounts.name: Leywoven Flying Carpet
mounts.srcText: Drop: Nightfallen Cache
mounts.desc: The threads are so thin and well-stitched, you can't imagine it wasn't made by magic, strand by strand.

mounts.name: Liberated Slyvern
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Breezebiter
Zone: The Azure Span
mounts.desc: It's difficult to tell because it's far too angry, but this slyvern is actually glad it's not owned by gnolls anymore.

mounts.name: Life-Binder's Handmaiden
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Elementium Fragment
Location: Dragon Soul
mounts.desc: Alexstrasza, the former dragon Aspect of Life, is known to be a kind and patient mentor. Under her tutelage, only the most dedicated pupils acquire the title of "Life-Binder's Handmaiden."

mounts.name: Light-Forged Mechsuit
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Two Minutes to Midnight
Category: Events
mounts.desc: Cooperation between the newly-awakened earthen Ordinants and the smiths of Hallowfall has resulted an improved, light-forged earthen mechsuit.

mounts.name: Lightforged Felcrusher
mounts.srcText: Achievement: Allied Races: Lightforged Draenei
mounts.desc: A gift of thanks from the Lightforged draenei, this stalwart elekk is conditioned to charge headlong into darkness without fear.

mounts.name: Lightforged Ruinstrider
mounts.srcText: Paladin
mounts.desc: A loyal steed to the Lightforged Draenei.

mounts.name: Lightforged Warframe
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Vindicator Jaelaana
Zone: Argus
Faction: Army of the Light - Exalted
Cost: 625000g
mounts.desc: The Army of the Light conducts quick, brutal hit-and-run attacks using these agile war machines.

mounts.name: Lightwing Dragonhawk
mounts.srcText: Promotion
mounts.desc: Radiating warmth and grace, it soars on wings of light.

mounts.name: Lil' Donkey
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Overseer Krix
Zone: Arathi Highlands
mounts.desc: Likely stolen from Newstead in the Arathi Highlands, this stalwart little donkey was destined to be eaten by kobolds.

mounts.name: Liquid Hot Magma Slug
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Xydan
Zone: Valdrakken
Cost: 5000 Timewarped Badge
mounts.desc: Also referred to as lava slugs once they breach Azeroth's crust.

mounts.name: Little Red Riding Goat
mounts.srcText: World Event: Mists of Pandaria: Remix
mounts.desc: What this goat lacks in size, it makes up for in stubbornness.

mounts.name: Lively Darkmoon Charger
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: Draped in tattered circus banners, this eerie mount is a perfect blend of shadow and spectacle.

mounts.name: Lizi, Thunderspine Tramper
mounts.srcText:
Quest: To Tame A Thunderspine
Zone: Ohn'ahran Plains
mounts.desc: Nothing will stop Lizi from her mission to eat all the world's fruit.

mounts.name: Llothien Prowler
mounts.srcText:
Quest: Volpin the Elusive
Zone: Suramar
mounts.desc: These sleek foxes can prowl amongst newly-fallen leaves without making a sound, even at this size.

mounts.name: Long-Forgotten Hippogryph
mounts.srcText: Zone: Azsuna
mounts.desc: You are the only one that remembered.

mounts.name: Longhorned Argussian Talbuk
mounts.srcText: World Event: WoW Remix: Legion
mounts.desc: Few talbuks managed to remain unscathed despite the Legion's exploitation of their homeworld. Their tenacity is befitting of a noble steed.

mounts.name: Longhorned Beryl Talbuk
mounts.srcText: World Event: WoW Remix: Legion
mounts.desc: This wild talbuk found among the ruins of Argus has survived and persevered through decades of strife.

mounts.name: Longhorned Bleakhoof Talbuk
mounts.srcText: World Event: WoW Remix: Legion
mounts.desc: Scarred by the chaos wrought by decades of conflict, this fel-infused steed is a perfect match for an intrepid adventurer.

mounts.name: Longhorned Sable Talbuk
mounts.srcText: World Event: WoW Remix: Legion
mounts.desc: The talbuks of Argus have grown long, coarse fur of brilliant colors that reflects the hues of their broken planet.

mounts.name: Lord of the Corpseflies
mounts.srcText:
Covenant: Necrolord
Drop: Fleshwing
Zone: Korthia
mounts.desc: To be the Lord of the Corpseflies, you've got to lay a LOT of eggs.

mounts.name: Love Witch's Sweeper
mounts.srcText:
World Event: Love is in the Air
Drop: Apothecary Hummel
mounts.desc: The original design of the feeling-fueled magic broom series "Motion By Emotion", this ride is sure to get you there in a swiffy!

mounts.name: Loyal Gorger
mounts.srcText: Quest: A New Pack
mounts.desc: Crawling forth from the cracks between the realms, the devourers have a voracious appetite for anima. Little is known of their origins, but all denizens of the Shadowlands see their recent boldness as a sign of the end times.

mounts.name: Loyal Magmammoth
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Yries Lightfingers
Zone: The Waking Shores
mounts.desc: Liberated from the Qalashi and harnessed by your ingenuity (and your harness), this magmammoth is ready to lava stomp wherever you want to go.

mounts.name: Lucent Hawkstrider
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Degentrius
Zone: Magister's Terrace (Mythic)
Drop: Challenger's Cache
Zone: Magister's Terrace
mounts.desc: A loyal creature of Thalassian nobility, it finds comfort holed up in the Magisters' Terrace.

mounts.name: Lucid Nightmare
mounts.srcText: Drop: Puzzler's Desire
mounts.desc: When riding this mount, your thoughts often wander to far-off places.

mounts.name: Lucky Yun
mounts.srcText: In-Game Shop
mounts.desc: The Pandaren believe that merely rubbing one's hands on the shiny hide of the ox will grant prosperity, the challenge is catching it.

mounts.name: Luminous Mana Ray
mounts.srcText: World Event: WoW Remix: Legion
mounts.desc: Mana rays can emit a bright glow to lure in prey.

mounts.name: Luminous Sporeglider
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Rotmire
Location: Sporefall
mounts.desc: This sporeglider's voracious appetite for luminescent spores has lent it an exquisite glow.

mounts.name: Luminous Starseeker
mounts.srcText: In-Game Shop
mounts.desc: Energetic apex hunters of Argus, the panthara hunt by sensing the energy within living things. A panthara approaching a powerful energy source will visibly change color and become more excited.

mounts.name: Lunar Dreamstag
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Moon Priestess Lasara
Zone: Emerald Dream
Cost: 1200 Dragon Isles Supplies
mounts.desc: The moon's pale light is reflected in the pelt of these elusive nocturnal creatures.

mounts.name: Lunar Launcher
mounts.srcText: Vendor: Lunar Festival
mounts.desc: It's always a festival when you are on the Lunar Launcher.

mounts.name: Lurid Bloodtusk
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Nalcorn Talsen
Zone: Maldraxxus
Faction: The Undying Army - Exalted
Cost: 30000g
mounts.desc: Only bloodtusks that survive the Contest of Conquest are deemed worthy enough to become a mount of the Undying Army.

mounts.name: Luxurious Riding Crane
mounts.srcText: World Event: WoW Remix: Mists of Pandaria
mounts.desc: A majestic bird, but a rather picky eater.

mounts.name: Machine Defense Unit 1-11
mounts.srcText:
Treasure: Awakened Cache
Zone: The Ringing Deeps
mounts.desc: One of many such mechsuits designed to guard the Machine. After years of faithful service it is no longer suited for combat. It does make for an impressive conveyance, though.

mounts.name: Maddened Chaosrunner
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Wrangler Kravos
Zone: Eredath
mounts.desc: The Army of the Light could only save so many of Argus' native species; countless numbers were lost to chaos.

mounts.name: Maelie, the Wanderer
mounts.srcText: Zone: Korthia
mounts.desc: A curious and inquisitive doe, she doesn't mean to worry her master, she just gets distracted easily. Especially with all of the new things to see on Korthia.

mounts.name: Mag'har Direwolf
mounts.srcText: Achievement: Allied Races: Mag'har Orc
mounts.desc: Native to Draenor, these wolves are preferred by the Mag'har for their ferocity, loyalty, and for something to snuggle on those cool winter nights.

mounts.name: Magenta Cloud Serpent
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: More affectionate than their cousins, Magenta Cloud Serpents are known to form close bonds with their riders.

mounts.name: Magic Rooster
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Landro Longshot
Location: Booty Bay
mounts.desc: Magic in the hands of a genius can do wonderful, miraculous things. Magic in the hands of an idiot can make a giant rooster.

mounts.name: Magic Rooster
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Landro Longshot
Location: Booty Bay
mounts.desc: Magic in the hands of a genius can do wonderful, miraculous things. Magic in the hands of an idiot can make a giant rooster.

mounts.name: Magic Rooster
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Landro Longshot
Location: Booty Bay
mounts.desc: Magic in the hands of a genius can do wonderful, miraculous things. Magic in the hands of an idiot can make a giant rooster.

mounts.name: Magic Rooster
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Landro Longshot
Location: Booty Bay
mounts.desc: Magic in the hands of a genius can do wonderful, miraculous things. Magic in the hands of an idiot can make a giant rooster.

mounts.name: Magister's Spell Bee
mounts.srcText: Vendor:Decor Duel
mounts.desc: A few Silvermoon Magisters once dedicated their arcane thesis to the study of infusing local flora with arcane-flecked pollen and the effects it had on pollinator species. To the Grand Magister, it was a success. To Silvermoon's Gardeners, it was not.

mounts.name: Magmashell
mounts.srcText:
Item: Empty Magma Shell
Zone: The Waking Shores
mounts.desc: Who's a good little new-forged snail made entirely of elemental lava? You are! Yes, you!

mounts.name: Magnificent Flying Carpet
mounts.srcText: Profession: Tailoring
mounts.desc: Standard features include a sturdy imbued frostweave frame and real iceweb spider silk threading. Spare head pillow sold separately.

mounts.name: Mail Muncher
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Mail Muncher
Zone: Horrific Visions
mounts.desc: Worming its way through the Postmaster's network, this serpent of N'Zoth deprived Azeroth of its primary magical correspondence.

mounts.name: Majestic Armored Vorquin
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Treysh
Zone: The Forbidden Reach
Cost: 80g
Vendor: Tethalash
Zone: Valdrakken
Cost: 80g
mounts.desc: Trained using ancient dracthyr methods, these armored vorquin are the pinnacle of tactical mounted ground warfare.

mounts.name: Majestic Azure Peafowl
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: The peafowl is renowned for its stunning colors and plumage.

mounts.name: Maldraxxian Corpsefly
mounts.srcText:
Covenant: Necrolord
Zone: Maldraxxus
mounts.desc: Corpseflies were once found throughout Maldraxxus, but many died out in the absence of anima. With anima flowing once again, they swarm.

mounts.name: Malevolent Drone
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Corpse Eater
Zone: Uldum
mounts.desc: The Aqir drones feast on heroes and cowards alike to grow their ranks.

mounts.name: Mammyth
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Elianna
Zone: Emerald Dream
Cost: 1 Dream Infusion
mounts.desc: In the Dream, sometimes the myth is more real than its basis.

mounts.name: Marble Quilen
mounts.srcText: World Event: WoW Remix: Mists of Pandaria
mounts.desc: Created by a mogu sorcerer who breathed life into their favorite pet rock.

mounts.name: Margin Manipulator
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Skedgit Cinderbangs
Zone: Undermine
Cost: 25 Miscellaneous Mechanica
mounts.desc: Ensuring there is always some marginal distance between you and rock bottom.

mounts.name: Marrowfang
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Nalthor the Rimebinder
Zone: The Necrotic Wake (Mythic)
Drop: Challenger's Cache
Zone: The Necrotic Wake
mounts.desc: Marrowfang, Bonefang's progeny, was respected by Amarth the Harvester for her insatiable appetite, even if it disrupted any experiments that the sadistic commander wanted to run.

mounts.name: Mastercraft Gravewing
mounts.srcText:
Covenant: Venthyr
Drop: Stygian Stonecrusher
Zone: Korthia
mounts.desc: Handcrafted by the Stonewright herself, this mastefully crafted stoneborn is entrusted only to those she deems worthy.

mounts.name: Mawdapted Raptora
mounts.srcText: Profession: Protoform Synthesis
mounts.desc: Since the Jailer's incursion, new raptora have been synthesized by Zereth Mortis that are capable of resisting the corrupting influence of the Maw.

mounts.name: Mawsworn Charger
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Flawless Master
Zone: Torghast, Tower of the Damned
mounts.desc: The fate of all horse mounts.

mounts.name: Mawsworn Soulhunter
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Gorged Shadehound
Zone: The Maw
mounts.desc: Soulhunters are used to track wayward souls across the wastes that flee from their dark fates, and are one of the only creatures that feel comfortable traversing the maw.

mounts.name: Mean Green Flying Machine
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Lab Assistant Laszly
Zone: Undermine
Cost: 11375 Resonance Crystals
mounts.desc: Steamwheedle's top engineers claim they invented this work of mechanical genius, while the other cartels copied their plans.

mounts.name: Meat Wagon
mounts.srcText: Promotion
mounts.desc: A favorite unit of the Lich King, both for its power as a siege weapon, and the satisfying sound of flung meat.

mounts.name: Mecha-Mogul Mk2
mounts.srcText: Profession: Engineering
mounts.desc: The Mk2 is an updated design with a focus on comfort and reliability over firepower.

mounts.name: Mechacycle Model W
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Mecha-Done
Category: Battle for Azeroth
mounts.desc: The rapid technological evolution of the descendants of Mimiron began with the introduction of a new gear, leading to such wonders as the tragically under-produced Model W.

mounts.name: Mechagon Mechanostrider
mounts.srcText: Achievement: Allied Races: Mechagnome
mounts.desc: The best mount, logically, serves multiple purposes -- sometimes you need to get places AND reach something high up once you get there.

mounts.name: Mechagon Peacekeeper
mounts.srcText:
Drop: HK-8 Aerial Oppression Unit
Zone: Operation: Mechagon (Mythic)
mounts.desc: Keeps the peace by turning you into pieces.

mounts.name: Mechanical Prototype Panther MK-0
mounts.srcText: In-Game Shop
mounts.desc: When Gadgetzan citizens pried open Gazlowe palace's underground lab, caged beasts' roars were suffocating. Undermine tech fused combat modules onto these panthers, granting superhuman strength and speed. Rustbolt engineers reprogrammed them exclusively for warriors campaigning in K'aresh. Remember to swap modules at the Morphing Forum before deployment.

mounts.name: Mechanized Lumber Extractor
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Remember to Share
Category: Toy Box
mounts.desc: Jepetto may have over done it a little...

mounts.name: Mechano-Hog
mounts.srcText: Profession: Engineering
mounts.desc: Difficult to build and to maintain, these hogs more than make up for their expense through sheer cool factor.

mounts.name: Meeksi Brewthief
mounts.srcText: In-Game Shop
mounts.desc: Despite their mischievous and playful nature, these creatures make for loyal and dependable travelling companions.

mounts.name: Meeksi Rollingpaw
mounts.srcText: In-Game Shop
mounts.desc: Rollingpaws are very proud of their tea bearing duties. They are always willing to provide a warm cup of tea to their travelling companions.

mounts.name: Meeksi Rufflefur
mounts.srcText: In-Game Shop
mounts.desc: Rufflefurs are playful, clumsy and obsessed with cleanliness. This is a dangerous combination of traits.

mounts.name: Meeksi Softpaw
mounts.srcText: In-Game Shop
mounts.desc: Softpaws provide a black tea that is ideal for an early morning jolt or staying awake late into the night.

mounts.name: Meeksi Teatuft
mounts.srcText: In-Game Shop
mounts.desc: Teatufts are known for their aromatic teas. However, their playful nature can result in an excess of spilled tea.

mounts.name: Mekgineer's Chopper
mounts.srcText: Profession: Engineering
mounts.desc: Sporting superb engineering craftsmanship, this chopper is one of the few personal vehicles on Azeroth built for two.

mounts.name: Midnight
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Attumen the Huntsman
Location: Return to Karazhan
mounts.desc: Still one of the most vicious steeds stabled in Karazhan.

mounts.name: Midnight Butterfly
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: PH

mounts.name: Midnight Darkmoon Charger
mounts.srcText: Trading Post

mounts.name: Mighty Caravan Brutosaur
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Talutu
Zone: Zuldazar
Cost: 5000000g
Vendor: Tricky Nick
Zone: Tiragarde Sound
Cost: 5000000g
mounts.desc: Brutosaurs are used by the Zandalari Empire as both weapons of war and enormous, mobile trading posts.

mounts.name: Mimiron's Head
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Yogg-Saron
Location: Ulduar
mounts.desc: A token of titan craftsmanship hoarded by the Old God, Yogg-Saron. Currently the single largest mechanical gnome head in Azeroth.

mounts.name: Mimiron's Jumpjets
mounts.srcText: World Event: Secrets of Azeroth
mounts.desc: Created as a prototype by Mimiron. The pieces were stolen from his workshop, sold, and lost to time. That is until now..

mounts.name: Minion of Grumpus
mounts.srcText: World Event: Feast of Winter Veil
mounts.desc: No one quite knows when the legend of Grumpus began in Draenor, but his toys are just the worst.

mounts.name: Modest Expedition Yak
mounts.srcText: World Event: WoW Remix: Mists of Pandaria
mounts.desc: Unlike its burden-bearing kin, this yak prefers to travel light and go no more than a mile at a time.

mounts.name: Mogu Hazeblazer
mounts.srcText: World Event: WoW Remix: Mists of Pandaria
mounts.desc: This ancient mogu artifact controls ambient fog to enable levitation.

mounts.name: Mollie
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Dunegorger Kraulok
Zone: Vol'dun
mounts.desc: The kind nature of alpacas makes them perfect as companions for the intrepid adventurer.

mounts.name: Molten Cormaera
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: In the earliest days of Azeroth, these elemental predators dominated the inferno-choked skies of Ragnaros's domain.

mounts.name: Moonlit Nightsaber
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Churbro
Zone: Boralus Harbor
Cost: 5000 Timewarped Badge
Vendor: Churbro
Zone: Zuldazar
Cost: 5000 Timewarped Badge
mounts.desc: "Her white glow upon their silvered fur, her bright-blue gaze in their moonlit eyes. Oh, how the moons smile on these creatures." -Mother Kalo'thera, High Priestess of Elune, A Blessing in Hajiri

mounts.name: Moonlit Witchwick's Rider
mounts.srcText: In-Game Shop
mounts.desc: Sleek, stylish, and spooky, the Witchwick Rider offers a smooth and surprisingly comfortable ride, thanks to the ergonomic saddle requested by many a spellcaster seeking cushioned support.

mounts.name: Morning Flourish Dreamsaber
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Talisa Whisperbloom
Zone: Emerald Dream
Cost: 1 Seedbloom
mounts.desc: Known for the lavish energy that emanates from them, these sabers are notorious tricksters. Their roar scatters the early birds that wake them.

mounts.name: Morsel Sniffer
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Harlowe Marl
Zone: Zaralek Cavern
Cost: 800 Dragon Isles Supplies
mounts.desc: A breed of shalewings trained by the niffen to find the deepest of morsels.

mounts.name: Mosshide Riverwallow
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Dawn-Seeker Krek / Dawn-Seeker Alkset
Location: Stormshield / Warspear
Cost: 50,000g + 5,000 Apexis Crystal
mounts.desc: Aggressive and territorial, the mosshide is known for hiding in river-shore scrub and ambushing unwary passersby.

mounts.name: Mossy Mammoth
mounts.srcText: Drop: Zskera Vaults
mounts.desc: Preserved for thousands of years in stone, bronze magic has nearly aged this mammoth back into a fossil.

mounts.name: Mossy Witchwick's Rider
mounts.srcText: In-Game Shop
mounts.desc: Sleek, stylish, and spooky, the Witchwick Rider offers a smooth and surprisingly comfortable ride, thanks to the ergonomic saddle requested by many a spellcaster seeking cushioned support.

mounts.name: Mottled Drake
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Landro Longshot
Location: Booty Bay
mounts.desc: I thought the thing was ill until it took to the air. It flies as true as any of my own. -Alexstrasza

mounts.name: Mottled Meadowstomper
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Luk'hok
Zone: Nagrand
mounts.desc: The elekk's long trunk allows it to sniff out sources of food, avoid danger, and steal snacks from your bags when you're not looking.

mounts.name: Mountain Horse
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Astrid Langstrump
Zone: Darnassus
Cost: 1g
mounts.desc: Images of this breed are often found on kegs of watered-down dwarven brew.

mounts.name: Mudback Riverbeast
mounts.srcText: Garrison Mission: It's a Boat, It's a Plane, It's... Just a Riverbeast.
mounts.desc: Special webbing that grows on the soles of the mudback's feet gives them extra traction in mud and slick terrain.

mounts.name: Murky Turkey
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: No one attempted to try and make a meal of this mount.

mounts.name: Mystic Runesaber
mounts.srcText: In-Game Shop
mounts.desc: Infused with arcane power, the Mystic Runesaber has long been hidden by chaotic nether energies. Recently they have emerged from the shadows in search of ley lines to sate their thirst for magic.

mounts.name: Nazjatar Blood Serpent
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Adherent of the Abyss
Zone: Stormsong Valley
mounts.desc: Monstrous serpents riddled with corruption serve as mounts for N'zoth's high-ranking lieutenants in the Great Sea.

mounts.name: Nesting Swarmite
mounts.srcText:
Zone: Vision of Stormwind (Revisited)
Zone: Vision of Orgrimmar (Revisited)
mounts.desc: Burrowers by nature they often lurk in small animal warrens when laying eggs or lying in wait to surprise larger prey.

mounts.name: Nether Drake
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Drake Dealer Hurlunk
Zone: Shadowmoon Valley, Outland
Cost: 200g
mounts.desc: The moods of these tempestuous mounts are known to shift as unpredictably and as violently as their physical forms.

mounts.name: Nether-Gorged Greatwyrm
mounts.srcText: In-Game Shop
mounts.desc: Few mana wyrms find sufficiently stable sources of arcane power to reach such a size. A greatwyrm's appetite for mana is unmatched.

mounts.name: Nether-Swept Drake
mounts.srcText: Profession: Voidstorm Fishing
mounts.desc: Lost in the nether, found by you.

mounts.name: Netherforged Nullframe
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: A Trip Through the Stars
Zone: Naigtal
Vendor: Kifaan
Cost: 15 Voidlight Marl
mounts.desc: Assembled by the Lightforged, sundered by the Hal'hadar, and restored by a Technomancer. A matrix of light, void, and arcane swirls within this renewed Warframe.

mounts.name: Netherlord's Accursed Wrathsteed
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Lord Hel'Nurath
Zone: Broken Shore
mounts.desc: Shadow plus fire, what could go wrong?

mounts.name: Netherlord's Brimstone Wrathsteed
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Calydus
Zone: Dreadscar Rift
mounts.desc: The smell isn't particularly pleasant, and it REALLY stays with you.

mounts.name: Netherlord's Chaotic Wrathsteed
mounts.srcText: Quest: The Wrathsteed of Xoroth
mounts.desc: A deadly combination of fel and horse.

mounts.name: Night Pterrorwing
mounts.srcText: World Event: WoW Remix: Mists of Pandaria
mounts.desc: Scholars interpret this creature's awful screeching as "fear me, I am the night!"

mounts.name: Nightborne Manasaber
mounts.srcText: Achievement: Allied Races: Nightborne
mounts.desc: Born capable of sniffing out concentrations of arcane energy, this noble cat was presented with thanks to a proven ally of the nightborne.

mounts.name: Nightfall Skyreaver
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Kronnus
Zone: Warspear
Cost: 5000 Timewarped Badge
Vendor: Tempra
Zone: Stormshield
Cost: 5000 Timewarped Badge
mounts.desc: Descending on their prey in the dead of night, the cries of these skyreavers once instilled terror in all the children of Draenor.

mounts.name: Noble Bruffalon
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Storykeeper Ashekh
Zone: The Forbidden Reach
Cost: 100000 Elemental Overflow
mounts.desc: It is a great honor to be trusted with one of the Maruuk's loyal hunting companions. This Bruffalon is reliable and steadfast through any hardship.

mounts.name: Noble Flying Carpet
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Daetan Swiftplume
Holiday: Noblegarden
mounts.desc: Mages celebrating Noblegarden turned their ordinary festive decor into floating spectacles, only to have them stolen by an angry druid.

mounts.name: Ny'alotha Allseer
mounts.srcText:
Drop: N'Zoth the Corruptor
Zone: Ny'alotha, the Waking City
Difficulty: Mythic
mounts.desc: To find him, drown yourself in the Circle of Stars.

mounts.name: Ny'alothan Shadow Worm
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Mastering the Visions
Category: Visions of N'Zoth Revisited
mounts.desc: A remnant of the Black Empire's past, these precursors of the abyss worms are once again resurging with the rise of Ny'alotha.

mounts.name: OC91 Chariot
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Sir Finley Mrrgglton
Zone: Dornogal
Cost: 15000 Undercoin
mounts.desc: The OC91 Chariot mechsuit is overcharged with the power of Titans. The enhanced power reportedly increases the reflexes and abilities of the pilot.

mounts.name: Obsidian Gravewing
mounts.srcText:
Covenant: Venthyr
Vendor: Chachi the Artiste
Zone: Revendreth
Cost: 7500 Reservoir Anima
mounts.desc: In the darkened skies of Revendreth, you cannot see these creatures coming until it is too late.

mounts.name: Obsidian Krolusk
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Glory of the Wartorn Hero
Category: Dungeons & Raids
mounts.desc: This krolusk is marked with proof of surviving scores of trials and hardships.

mounts.name: Obsidian Nightwing
mounts.srcText: Recruit-a-Friend
mounts.desc: When you can't run, you crawl, and when you can't crawl you find someone to carry you.

mounts.name: Obsidian Vorquin
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Treysh
Zone: The Forbidden Reach
Cost: 40g
Vendor: Tethalash
Zone: Valdrakken
Cost: 40g
mounts.desc: Respected for their resilience in battle, even against dragonfire, these noble beasts are the prized mounts of the dracthyr cavalry.

mounts.name: Obsidian Worldbreaker
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Memories of Fel, Frost and Fire
Category: Events
mounts.desc: "I have had many names throughout history, all of them spoken with dread: Neltharion, Xaxas, and many more. Yet you shall know me best as Deathwing, for so I am! I am the bane of life, the darkness within history, the lord of death, the master of destruction. And I tell you now, and so it is true, that this world is mine!" - Neltharion, the Earth-Warder

mounts.name: Ochre Delivery Rocket
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Shredz the Scrapper
Zone: Undermine
Cost: 11375 Resonance Crystals
mounts.desc: Get packages and passengers from point A to B in style!

mounts.name: Ochre Dreamtalon
mounts.srcText:
Quest: A Little Hope is Never Without Worth
Zone: Emerald Dream
mounts.desc: Playful dreamtalons often decorate themselves in a myriad of colors that only autumn offers.

mounts.name: Ochre Skeletal Warhorse
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Zachariah Post
Zone: Tirisfal Glades
Cost: 10g
mounts.desc: When fallen heroes are raised into undeath, so too are their horses.

mounts.name: Ol' Mole Rufus
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Lurker of the Deeps
Zone: The Ringing Deeps
mounts.desc: Wiser than words can say and still quick on his feet. He just gets a lil' tired sometimes.

mounts.name: Onyx Cloud Serpent
mounts.srcText:
Quest: Surprise Attack!
Location: Townlong Steppes
mounts.desc: Onyx Cloud serpents are known to be more aggressive and daring than their cousins, the Heavenly Onyx Cloud Serpents.

mounts.name: Onyx Netherwing Drake
mounts.srcText:
Quest: Onyxien the Onyx Netherwing Drake
Zone: Shattrath City, Outland
mounts.desc: After promising to fly you to the ends of Outland, the netherwing drake was eventually drawn to the blue skies of Azeroth as well.

mounts.name: Onyxian Drake
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Onyxia
Zone: Onyxia's Lair
mounts.desc: She has a lot in common with her mother, except for the being killed and reanimated. But she is young still. -Maloriak

mounts.name: Orgrimmar Interceptor
mounts.srcText: Blizzcon 2017
mounts.desc: A forward-mounted wolf's head cannon makes this air superiority fighter especially good at dogfighting.

mounts.name: Orgrimmar Wolf
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Freka Bloodaxe
Zone: Icecrown
Cost: 100 Champion's Seal
mounts.desc: For a brief time, many orcs would declare themselves "hungry like an Orgrimmar wolf." Some blood elves still use the phrase ironically.

mounts.name: Ornery Breezestrider
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: This talbuk is a stubborn, obstinate mount, even after getting to know its rider. Riders beware.

mounts.name: Otterworldly Ottuk Carrier
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Thanks for the Carry!
Category: Mounts
mounts.desc: Some ottuks get into the spirit of carrying people around more than others.

mounts.name: Otto
mounts.srcText: Quest: The Way to an Otto's Heart
mounts.desc: Relax. The future will unfold as it was meant to, one way or an otter.

mounts.name: Pale Acidmaw
mounts.srcText:
Covenant Feature: The Ember Court
Covenant: Venthyr
Covenant Feature: Queen's Conservatory
Covenant: Night Fae
Covenant Feature: Path of Ascension
Covenant: Kyrian
Covenant Feature: Abomination Factory
Covenant: Necrolord
mounts.desc: The acid present in the ichor of this creature sapped away the color from its shell, leaving it a striking shade of snowy white.

mounts.name: Pale Gravewing
mounts.srcText:
Covenant: Venthyr
Vendor: Duchess Mynx
Zone: Korthia
Cost: 1000 Stygia
Achievement: On the Offensive
mounts.desc: Gravewings know no fear and are nearly indestructible -- perfect for an assault on the Maw.

mounts.name: Pale Regal Cervid
mounts.srcText: Profession: Protoform Synthesis
mounts.desc: Looking at these majestic creatures, it's not difficult to see how the idea of cervids developed into the stags found on Azeroth and other mortal worlds.

mounts.name: Pale Riding Crane
mounts.srcText: World Event: WoW Remix: Mists of Pandaria
mounts.desc: I looked, and behold, a pale... crane?

mounts.name: Pale Thorngrazer
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Crafticus Mindbender
Faction: Wrynn's Vanguard - Exalted
Location: Stormshield
Cost: 5,000g + 5,000 Apexis Crystal
mounts.desc: This talbuk subsists completely on a diet of thistles and thorns, making its insides as tough as its outside.

mounts.name: Palehide Direhorn
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Talutu
Zone: Zuldazar
Cost: 500000g
Vendor: Tricky Nick
Zone: Tiragarde Sound
Cost: 500000g
mounts.desc: Pale-skinned direhorns are quite rare, justifying the expense.

mounts.name: Palehide Mushan Beast
mounts.srcText: World Event: WoW Remix: Mists of Pandaria
mounts.desc: The Palehide Mushan is the tastiest of Mushan beasts, but it hates being reminded of that fact.

mounts.name: Pandaren Kite
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Pandaren Ambassador
Category: Pandaria
mounts.desc: This "mount," awarded by the Lorewalkers of Pandaria, is a reward to the hero of their organization.

mounts.name: Pandaren Kite
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Pandaren Ambassador
Category: Pandaria
mounts.desc: This token of honor is a gift from the Lorewalkers of Pandaria. Flying manual seemingly not included, however.

mounts.name: Patient Bufonid
mounts.srcText:
Quest: The Patient Bufonid
Zone: Zereth Mortis
mounts.desc: Some bufonids will sit perfectly still for hours or days at a time if left to their own devices. Fortunately, they're also quite agreeable if a rider would like to move more often than that.

mounts.name: Pattie
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Whodunnit?
Event: Secrets of Azeroth
mounts.desc: Preservationist Kathos encountered Pattie on her first assignment to Vol'dun. Pattie developed an affinity to Preservationist work but is eager to delve deeper, helping adventurers in their sleuthing.

mounts.name: Pearlescent Butterfly
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: Take to the skies on a glittering, shimmering, pearlescent butterfly.

mounts.name: Pearlescent Goblin Wave Shredder
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: Surf the shores of Stranglethorn in style!

mounts.name: Pearlescent Krolusk
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Urmag
Zone: K'aresh
mounts.desc: Introduced as an invasive species to K'aresh, Krolusk have found some use as beasts of burden.

mounts.name: Perfected Juggernaut
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Time Rifts
Vendor: Gill the Drill
Zone: Tyrhold Reservoir
Cost: 3000 Paracausal Flakes
mounts.desc: Perfection, like beauty, is in the eye of the beholder. But eyesight can be surgically enhanced.

mounts.name: Peridot Dragonhawk
mounts.srcText:
World Quest: From Darkness, Light
Zone: Isle of Quel'Danas
mounts.desc: Peridot dragonhawks are only awarded to those who have performed great deeds in service of Silvermoon.

mounts.name: Personalized Goblin S.C.R.A.P.per
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Sifted Pile of Scrap
Zone: Undermine
mounts.desc: Goblin Shredders have proven time and again to be useful in many applications, such as in logging and transportation. This model has been repurposed for use by S.C.R.A.P..

mounts.name: Pestilent Necroray
mounts.srcText: Drop: Oozing Necroray Egg
mounts.desc: When a necroray hatches, spores fly everywhere, making a huge mess.

mounts.name: Phalynx of Courage
mounts.srcText:
Covenant: Kyrian
Zone: Bastion
mounts.desc: A phalynx is considered both a worthy companion and a lithe opponent to test one's reflexes against.

mounts.name: Phalynx of Humility
mounts.srcText:
Covenant: Kyrian
Zone: Bastion
mounts.desc: The phalynx does not fetch, though it is not known why this is.

mounts.name: Phalynx of Loyalty
mounts.srcText:
Covenant: Kyrian
Zone: Bastion
mounts.desc: Some within the Ascended keep a phalynx as a pet. While they may not be as furry as a larion, they are much less likely to eat your other pets.

mounts.name: Phalynx of Purity
mounts.srcText:
Covenant: Kyrian
Zone: Bastion
mounts.desc: Little is known about the origination of phalynx technology, the machinations of which are taught more akin to religion than engineering.

mounts.name: Phase-Lost Slateback
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Phase-Lost-and-Found
Category: War Within
mounts.desc: This Slateback got lost wandering into various phases as it followed some ethereals around.

mounts.name: Phosphorescent Stone Drake
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Aeonaxx
Location: Deepholm
mounts.desc: The Stonemother has shown little concern for the rebellious Aeonaxx, even allowing his spawn to be taken from her realm.

mounts.name: Pinto
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Katie Stokx
Zone: Stormwind City
Cost: 1g
mounts.desc: Its calm temperament makes it ideal to train young children in horseback riding.

mounts.name: Plaguerot Tauralus
mounts.srcText:
Covenant: Necrolord
Zone: Maldraxxus
mounts.desc: The tauralus is considered courageous, though scholars of Maldraxxus have long wondered if their lack of fear is simply due to the tiny size of their brains.

mounts.name: Plainswalker Bearer
mounts.srcText: World Event: Centaur Hunts (first hunt of each week)
mounts.desc: The mammoths of the Ohn'ahran Plains are unaccustomed to carrying people, as their centaur neighbors do not typically ride mounts. They can learn to bear riders, however. Some even do so enthusiastically.

mounts.name: Plunderlord's Golden Crocolisk
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: What is a Plunderlord without a proper display of plunder?

mounts.name: Plunderlord's Midnight Crocolisk
mounts.srcText: Special Event: Plunderstorm
mounts.desc: Any captain worth their salt knows to have a trustworthy navi-gator.

mounts.name: Plunderlord's Weathered Crocolisk
mounts.srcText: Trading Post

mounts.name: Polly Roger
mounts.srcText: Special Event: Plunderstorm
mounts.desc: The scourge of the slightly-northeastern seas, giant parrots like Polly can live for up to 2000 years. What a wonderful curse on your next of kin.

mounts.name: Pond Nettle
mounts.srcText: Profession: Fishing
mounts.desc: This miraculous aquatic species can survive in the harshest environments, perhaps even the void of space.

mounts.name: Predatory Bloodgazer
mounts.srcText: Quest: Bloodgazer Reunion
mounts.desc: The sheer amount of raw red berries these fierce omnivores consume gives them their distinctive eye color.

mounts.name: Predatory Plagueroc
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Gieger
Covenant: Necrolord
Zone: Maldraxxus
mounts.desc: Gieger's everlasting hunger is legendary amongst the House of Constructs, and no beast is too large or bony to fit inside its massive stomach.

mounts.name: Prestigious Azure Courser
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Honor Level 70
Category: Honor
mounts.desc: One of the bold equines of the Broken Isles, unmatched among the steeds of Azeroth in ferocity and strength.

mounts.name: Prestigious Bloodforged Courser
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Honor Level 500
Category: Honor
mounts.desc: Forged in a fiery hatred, the offspring of a nightmare and a dream, this steed feeds on grains grown with the tears of your enemies.

mounts.name: Prestigious Bronze Courser
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Honor Level 15
Category: Honor
mounts.desc: One of the bold equines of the Broken Isles, unmatched among the steeds of Azeroth in ferocity and strength.

mounts.name: Prestigious Forest Courser
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Honor Level 125
Category: Honor
mounts.desc: One of the bold equines of the Broken Isles, unmatched among the steeds of Azeroth in ferocity and strength.

mounts.name: Prestigious Ivory Courser
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Honor Level 40
Category: Honor
mounts.desc: One of the bold equines of the Broken Isles, unmatched among the steeds of Azeroth in ferocity and strength.

mounts.name: Prestigious Midnight Courser
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Honor Level 250
Category: Honor
mounts.desc: One of the bold equines of the Broken Isles, unmatched among the steeds of Azeroth in ferocity and strength.

mounts.name: Prestigious Royal Courser
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Honor Level 150
Category: Honor
mounts.desc: One of the bold equines of the Broken Isles, unmatched among the steeds of Azeroth in ferocity and strength.

mounts.name: Prestigious War Steed
mounts.srcText: Achievement: Free For All, More For Me
mounts.desc: Armored to withstand collisions in battle.

mounts.name: Prestigious War Wolf
mounts.srcText: Achievement: Free For All, More For Me
mounts.desc: At Warchief Hellscream's command, Horde trainers began raising wolves to thrive in the shock and ferocity of sustained combat.

mounts.name: Preyhunter's Fury
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Construct V'anore
Zone: Silvermoon City
Cost: 2250 Remnant of Anguish
mounts.desc: You don't follow tracks; you follow the fading green fire.

mounts.name: Preyseeker's Hubris
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Construct E'nui
Zone: Silvermoon City
Cost: 2000 Remnant of Anguish
mounts.desc: Larger mana wyrms are sometimes used as mounts by Blood Elves, but are more frequently kept as status symbols.

mounts.name: Preyseeker's Nightmare
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Prey: Nightmare Mode III
Category: Prey
mounts.desc: Golden mana wyrms are an uncommon mutation. Some of Astalor's side experiments have included efforts to increase their population..

mounts.name: Preyseeker's Wrath
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Construct E'nui
Zone: Silvermoon City
Cost: 2550 Remnant of Anguish
mounts.desc: Mana wyrms that are large and strong enough to support full barding and rider are quite rare and highly prized.

mounts.name: Priestess' Moonsaber
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Provisioner Stoutforge
Zone: Tiragarde Sound
Cost: 750 7th Legion Service Medal
mounts.desc: Once these elegant cats were only given to high-ranking priestesses of Elune, but now they ride into battle with all manner of champion, in the service of vengeance.

mounts.name: Primal Flamesaber
mounts.srcText: Promotion Heroes of the Storm
mounts.desc: The primal landscape of Azeroth was once swarming with elemental creatures of all types.

mounts.name: Primeval Skyfriend
mounts.srcText:
Drop: The Venomous Abyss
Location: Ula'tek (Mythic)
mounts.desc: The most vicious elder skyfiends lurk within the confines of the Venomous Abyss, surfacing only to stalk prey across the shores of Atal'Utek before returning to their fetid lairs. This one has become your sky-friend.

mounts.name: Prismatic Snapdragon
mounts.srcText:
Quest: A Loyal Friend
Zone: Siren Isle
mounts.desc: Chameleonic creatures can oftentimes adapt their cells to match the color of the outside world. This snapdragon adopted this ability, but only to match the contents of their stomach; taking the phrase 'you are what you eat' to a whole new level.

mounts.name: Prized Turkey
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: This extra-large turkey not only took first place due to its pristine feathers, but also for its larger-than-average size.

mounts.name: Profit-Green Shreddertank
mounts.srcText: Vendor: Lindormi
mounts.desc: If it's leaking, it's working.

mounts.name: Prophet's Great Raven
mounts.srcText: In-Game Shop
mounts.desc: As the Prophet, Medivh delivered his missives in the form of a black raven. Although not as impressive as shapeshifting, this bird still carries all the prestige of its namesake.

mounts.name: Prototype A.S.M.R.
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Chrome King Gallywix
Zone: Liberation of Undermine
mounts.desc: Representing the pinnacle of goblin propaganda technology, Gallywix commissioned the Automatic Sonic Machine Resonator to sway his most stubborn critics.

mounts.name: Prototype Leaper
mounts.srcText: Profession: Protoform Synthesis
mounts.desc: An ancient schematic allows for the instantiation of this early, but functional, bufonid design.

mounts.name: Proudmoore Sea Scout
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Provisioner Fray
Zone: Tiragarde Sound
Faction: Proudmoore Admiralty - Exalted
Cost: 90000g
mounts.desc: Only a few gryphons are selected to be Sea Scouts operating from flag ships in the fleet. Their long range reconnaissance is an integral part of Kul Tiran sea dominance.

mounts.name: Prowling Shredclaw
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Thraxadar
Zone: Masters' Perch
Faction: Slayer's Duellum - Exalted
Cost: 6000 Voidlight Marl
mounts.desc: According to ren'dorei scouts, shredclaws are often seen hunting in packs.

mounts.name: Pureblood Fire Hawk
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Ragnaros
Zone: Firelands
mounts.desc: Legends state that the Pureblood line may be traced back to the very creation of the Firelands.

mounts.name: Pureheart Courser
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: 100 Exalted Reputations
Category: Reputation
mounts.desc: These coursers have long been known to exist, but only befriend those that have gone to great lengths for friendship.

mounts.name: Purple Dragon Turtle
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Turtlemaster Odai
Zone: Orgrimmar
Cost: 1g
Vendor: Old Whitenose
Zone: Stormwind City
Cost: 1g
mounts.desc: Cherished for their heavy carrying capacity and steady gait, these stalwart beasts are the mount of choice for most native Pandaren.

mounts.name: Purple Elekk
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Torallius the Pack Handler
Zone: Azuremyst Isle
Cost: 1g
mounts.desc: Patient and strong, the Elekk exemplify the Draenei attitude towards the hardships of life.

mounts.name: Purple Hawkstrider
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Winaestra
Zone: Eversong Woods (Burning Crusade)
Cost: 1g
mounts.desc: Some of our brethren prefer horses, but the hawkstrider will always be the true symbol of Silvermoon. -Winaestra

mounts.name: Purple Netherwing Drake
mounts.srcText:
Quest: Malfas the Purple Netherwing Drake
Zone: Shattrath City, Outland
mounts.desc: After promising to fly you to the ends of Outland, the netherwing drake was eventually drawn to the blue skies of Azeroth as well.

mounts.name: Purple Riding Nether Ray
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Grella
Zone: Terokkar Forest, Outland
Faction: Sha'tari Skyguard - Exalted
Cost: 200g
mounts.desc: Nether Rays are among the most trusted, versatile mounts in all of Outland and beyond.

mounts.name: Purple Shado-Pan Riding Tiger
mounts.srcText: World Event: WoW Remix: Mists of Pandaria
mounts.desc: "When waking a tiger, use a long stick. Better yet, tell your friend to wake the tiger instead." -Pandaren Proverb

mounts.name: Purple Skeletal Warhorse
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Zachariah Post
Zone: Tirisfal Glades
Cost: 10g
mounts.desc: When fallen heroes are raised into undeath, so too are their horses.

mounts.name: Pyrewood Rebel's Rouncey
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: After diligent training from riders in both worgen and human forms, these horses will now bear any rider in Gilnean finery.

mounts.name: Qinsho's Eternal Hound
mounts.srcText: Drop: Island Expeditions
mounts.desc: Qinsho wrought his eternal guardian from pure gold and imbued it with the resilience of the earth.

mounts.name: Quawks
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: Squawks's older (and somehow louder) brother appears to tolerate your presence. For now. You should probably track down some crackers while you still can.

mounts.name: Quel'dorei Steed
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Hiren Loresong
Zone: Icecrown
Faction: The Silver Covenant - Exalted
Cost: 100 Champion's Seal
mounts.desc: Comes from a lineage of fine horses that once grazed near the shores of the Well of Eternity.

mounts.name: Quirky Turkey
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: This creature might not be majestic but it certainly will turn heads!

mounts.name: Rabbit'ath
mounts.srcText: Promotion: BlizzCon 2026
mounts.desc: The presence of Rabbit'ath brings doom and despair to all who witness. Legend says that in its eyes, you can glimpse the end of all things.

mounts.name: Radiant Imperial Lynx
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Lars Bronsmaelt
Zone: Hallowfall
mounts.desc: The Radiant Imperial Lynx embodies the ongoing strength and courage it takes to chase back the darkness. They hoist us up so that we may hold our torches high for all who seek refuge from the encroaching darkness.

mounts.name: Raging Cinderbee
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Ruffious's Bid
Category: World
mounts.desc: Temper as hot as its flames, this breed of cinderbee can only be tamed by those who share its insatiable penchant for violence.

mounts.name: Raging Magmammoth
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Glory of the Vault Raider
Category: Dungeons & Raids
mounts.desc: Most lava flows. This lava charges.

mounts.name: Rajani Warserpent
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Zhang Ku
Zone: Vale of Eternal Blossoms
Cost: 1 Pristine Cloud Serpent Scale
mounts.desc: Fierce companions of the followers of Ra-den, the Rajani Warserpents are a force to be reckoned with.

mounts.name: Rampaging Mauler
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Konthrogz the Obliterator
Zone: Korthia
mounts.desc: One would think controlling a rampaging mount would be difficult, but if you can learn to control the direction of the rampage it can be quite useful.

mounts.name: Rampart Screecher
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Glory of the Nathria Raider
Category: Dungeons & Raids
mounts.desc: Roosting among the ramparts of Castle Nathria, these giant dredbats act as sentinels and are trained to take down threats approaching the castle from the air.

mounts.name: Raptora Swooper
mounts.srcText: Profession: Protoform Synthesis
mounts.desc: The raptora swooper is one of the most vicious iterations of its kind, perfectly suited for its ecological niche. Needing no further adjustments, the ones synthesized today are identical to those created in the past.

mounts.name: Ratstallion
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Underbelly Tycoon
Category: Broken Isles
mounts.desc: Years of chain-chugging potions in Dalaran's sewer system have allowed him to grow large, agile, and shadow resistant.

mounts.name: Raven Lord
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Anzu
Zone: Sethekk Halls (Heroic)
mounts.desc: The rest be forgotten to walk upon the ground, clipped wings and shame. -Word of the Raven

mounts.name: Ravenous Black Gryphon
mounts.srcText:
Alliance
Drop: Time Rifts
Vendor: Warden Krizzik
Zone: Tyrhold Reservoir
Cost: 3000 Paracausal Flakes
Horde
Item: Gift of the Ravenous Black Gryphon
mounts.desc: War corrupted these once-proud creatures. The susurration of their wings now whispers omens of imminent demise.

mounts.name: Ravenous Shredclaw
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Void Researcher Anomander
Zone: Voidstorm
Cost: 6000 Voidlight Marl
mounts.desc: Fast and dependable, Shredclaws were one of the first creatures tamed in the Voidstorm. Their owners learned quickly not to leave them alone with their pets.

mounts.name: Red Dragon Turtle
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Turtlemaster Odai
Zone: Orgrimmar
Cost: 1g
Vendor: Old Whitenose
Zone: Stormwind City
Cost: 1g
mounts.desc: Cherished for their heavy carrying capacity and steady gait, these stalwart beasts are the mount of choice for most native Pandaren.

mounts.name: Red Dragonhawk
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Mountain o' Mounts
Category: General
mounts.desc: Dragonhawks are among the deadliest known predators. They are able to spot prey from great distances, rush in, and rend with both talon and beak.

mounts.name: Red Drake
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Cielstrasza
Zone: Dragonblight
Faction: The Wyrmrest Accord - Exalted
Cost: 2000g
mounts.desc: You should never listen to minstrels' fancies. A dragon would never hurt a soul, unless they tried to hurt him first.

mounts.name: Red Flying Cloud
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Tan Shin Tiao
Zone: Vale of Eternal Blossoms
Faction: The Lorewalkers - Exalted
Cost: 600g
mounts.desc: An ancient mogu artifact awarded to those who are deeply committed to the discovery and sharing of Pandaren lore.

mounts.name: Red Hawkstrider
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Winaestra
Zone: Eversong Woods (Burning Crusade)
Cost: 1g
mounts.desc: Some of our brethren prefer horses, but the hawkstrider will always be the true symbol of Silvermoon. -Winaestra

mounts.name: Red Mechanostrider
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Milli Featherwhistle
Zone: Dun Morogh
Cost: 1g
mounts.desc: "The terradynamic exo-plotters are conjoined by hydraulic imaging to the equilibrium enhancers..." -Binjy Featherwhistle

mounts.name: Red Primal Raptor
mounts.srcText: Drop: Cracked Primal Egg
mounts.desc: Raptors have spread to nearly all of the lands of Azeroth. It is uncertain whether the trolls led them or followed them.

mounts.name: Red Proto-Drake
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Glory of the Hero
Category: Dungeons & Raids
mounts.desc: The vrykul were the first to recognize their potential. Or maybe the second, depending on how you look at it.

mounts.name: Red Qiraji Battle Tank
mounts.srcText:
Drop: World Drop
Location: Temple of Ahn'Qiraj
mounts.desc: This (relatively) domesticated silithid is at home only in the desert sands of Ahn'Qiraj.

mounts.name: Red Qiraji War Tank
mounts.srcText: World Event: Call of the Scarab
mounts.desc: The Qiraji War Tank has only been seen recently during the Call of the Scarab, could this hint at a resurfacing of the deadly creatures?

mounts.name: Red Riding Nether Ray
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Grella
Zone: Terokkar Forest, Outland
Faction: Sha'tari Skyguard - Exalted
Cost: 200g
mounts.desc: Nether Rays are among the most trusted, versatile mounts in all of Outland and beyond.

mounts.name: Red Shado-Pan Riding Tiger
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Rushi the Fox
Zone: Townlong Steppes
Faction: Shado-Pan - Exalted
Cost: 2500g
mounts.desc: "When waking a tiger, use a long stick. Better yet, tell your friend to wake the tiger instead." -Pandaren Proverb

mounts.name: Red Skeletal Horse
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Zachariah Post
Zone: Tirisfal Glades
Cost: 1g
mounts.desc: The Forsaken believe that without a purpose, even beasts of burden suffer in undeath.

mounts.name: Red Skeletal Warhorse
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Raider Bork
Zone: Orgrimmar
Cost: 15 Mark of Honor
mounts.desc: When fallen heroes are raised into undeath, so too are their horses.

mounts.name: Regal Corpsefly
mounts.srcText:
Covenant: Necrolord
Vendor: Su Zettai
Zone: Maldraxxus
Cost: 7500 Reservoir Anima
mounts.desc: Only the forces of Maldraxxus would call a corpsefly "regal."

mounts.name: Regal Riding Crane
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Jaluu the Generous
Zone: Vale of Eternal Blossoms
Faction: Golden Lotus - Exalted
Cost: 1500g
mounts.desc: The crane is a symbol of wisdom and nobility. Their ability to carry us into the skies is nothing short of miraculous. - Jaluu the Generous

mounts.name: Rekindled Dreamstag
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Talisa Whisperbloom
Zone: Emerald Dream
Cost: 1 Seedbloom
mounts.desc: Ashes of fallen leaves are fertile soil for dreamstags to arise from.

mounts.name: Relinquished Scarlet Charger
mounts.srcText: Quest: Relinquishing Relics
mounts.desc: No longer a tool of the Scarlet Crusade, this charger now guides recruits down the path of the Light with renewed purpose.

mounts.name: Remembered Golden Gryphon
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Remembrancer Amuul
Zone: Dalaran
Cost: 25
mounts.desc: They love lions in Stormwind, and the gryphon is half lion. This is why these creatures are an air travel staple throughout the Alliance.

mounts.name: Remembered Wind Rider
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Remembrancer Amuul
Zone: Dalaran
Cost: 25
mounts.desc: Hundreds of battles across a dozen campaigns have been fought and won on the backs of these honored creatures.

mounts.name: Ren's Stalwart Hound
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Houndlord Ren
Zone: Vale of Eternal Blossoms
mounts.desc: Houndlord Ren used his strongest quilen to carry him across Pandaria to subjugate the Vale for the Mogu empire.

mounts.name: Renewed Magmammoth
mounts.srcText: Drop: Dreamsurges
mounts.desc: Reforged after destruction at the hands of the Druids of the Flame, this magmammoth is ready to stomp any foes in its path.

mounts.name: Renewed Proto-Drake
mounts.srcText: Achievement: Dragon Isles: A New Friend
mounts.desc: As the isles awaken, these proto-drakes answer the call to soar the skies alongside mortals.

mounts.name: Renewed Proto-Drake
mounts.srcText: Achievement: Dragon Isles: A New Friend
mounts.desc: As the isles awaken, these proto-drakes answer the call to soar the skies alongside mortals.

mounts.name: Resplendent K'arroc
mounts.srcText:
World Quest: The Hope of K'aresh
Zone: K'aresh
mounts.desc: A technological marvel in the flesh, this K'arroc represents hope for a brighter K'aresh.

mounts.name: Restoration Deathwalker
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Shadowlands Keystone Master: Season Four
Category: Dungeons
mounts.desc: With the death of the Jailer and the ascension of a new Arbiter, the Shadowlands is returning to its great Purpose. Some deathwalkers recognize the role that mortal heroes have played, and are willing to serve as mounts.

mounts.name: Retrained Skyrazor
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Materialist Ophinell
Zone: Twilight Highlands
Cost: 100 Twilight's Blade Insignia
mounts.desc: One of a handful of skyrazors captured by Arathi forces during the Sureki offensive after Queen Ansurek's downfall, this beast has found great use in sniffing out void corruption at home and abroad.

mounts.name: Riddler's Mind-Worm
mounts.srcText: Drop: Gift of the Mind-Seekers
mounts.desc: It feeds on your thoughts, even the ones you are thinking as you read this.

mounts.name: Riding Turtle
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Landro Longshot
Location: Booty Bay
mounts.desc: Slow and steady might not always win you the race but it'll get you there... eventually.

mounts.name: Risen Mare
mounts.srcText: Drop: Island Expeditions
mounts.desc: Something terrible happened in the lost town of Havenswood.

mounts.name: Rivendare's Deathcharger
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Lord Aurius Rivendare
Location: Stratholme
mounts.desc: When Baron Rivendare became a champion of the Scourge, he condemned his favorite horse to join him in undeath.

mounts.name: Riverwalker Mushan
mounts.srcText: World Event: WoW Remix: Mists of Pandaria
mounts.desc: The Mushan is a voracious beast. Though it can be tamed, it will demand a second, third, and even fourth breakfast every day.

mounts.name: Rocket Shredder 9001
mounts.srcText: Recruit-a-Friend
mounts.desc: The salesgoblin always tells people about the RS-9001's huge variety of attachments, but somehow neglects to mention that you never get to pick the attachments it'll have when you mount up.

mounts.name: Rocktusk Battleboar
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Trader Araanda
Zone: Lunarfall
Cost: 10000g
Vendor: Trader Darakk
Zone: Frostwall
Cost: 10000g
mounts.desc: It's not the metal helmet that attracts mates; it's the sweet mohawk.

mounts.name: Rootstalker Grimlynx
mounts.srcText: Drop: Harandar Rare Creatures
mounts.desc: With fur to match the deep roots and armor to match the vast foliage, these Grimlynx are equipped to be some of the ultimate hunters of Harandar.

mounts.name: Rose Riding Crane
mounts.srcText: World Event: WoW Remix: Mists of Pandaria
mounts.desc: This brightly-colored bird is often confused with a flamingo or marabou.

mounts.name: Royal Court Undercrawler
mounts.srcText:
Vendors: Yamas the Provider, Tulumun
Zone: Azj-Kahet
Cost: 2020 Kej
mounts.desc: Patents of lineage are used to demarcate the history and value of thoroughbred undercrawlers in Kaheti high society. This practice can prove somewhat difficult when said undercrawlers are prone to the sudden consumption of their record-keepers.

mounts.name: Royal Seafeather
mounts.srcText: Special Event: Plunderstorm
mounts.desc: The sharp beaks of these parrots are capable of breaking open large nuts with ease.

mounts.name: Royal Snapdragon
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Ankoan Supplies
Drop: Unshackled Supplies
mounts.desc: Captured at a young age and raised to serve naga hunters, snapdragons are loyal and fierce companions.

mounts.name: Royal Swarmer
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: These drones will swarm anyone who dares approach their queen uninvited.

mounts.name: Royal Voidwing
mounts.srcText: Quest: A Twilight Oath's End
mounts.desc: A cosmic terror warped and hardened by the cruelties of the Nexus-King, now oathsworn to your service.

mounts.name: Ruby Butterfly
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: The elusive Ruby Butterfly is highly sought after by Twilight Witches.

mounts.name: Ruby Panther
mounts.srcText: Profession: Jewelcrafting
mounts.desc: Legends say that an ancient pandaren emperor crafted the first jeweled panther for his son after the boy's twin brother died of an illness.

mounts.name: Ruby Void Creeper
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Om'sirik
Zone: K'aresh
Cost: 8125 Resonance Crystals
mounts.desc: "Rescued" by the K'aresh Trust for study, this void creeper has turned out to be an incredibly sturdy mount.

mounts.name: Ruby Writhe
mounts.srcText: Drop: The Coiled Isle Rare Creatures
mounts.desc: Riding on a writhe makes it thrice as nice.

mounts.name: Rubyshell Krolusk
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Provisioner Mukra
Zone: Zuldazar
Cost: 200 Honorbound Service Medal
mounts.desc: Captured from the desolate sands of Vol'dun, this mount is surprisingly docile in captivity.

mounts.name: Ruddy Sporeglider
mounts.srcText:
Treasure: Peculiar Cauldron
Zone: Harandar
mounts.desc: This sporeglider derived its striking hue from the unique fungus growing around Teldrassil's roots.

mounts.name: Runebound Firelord
mounts.srcText: Promotion: Cataclysm Classic
mounts.desc: By fire be purged the obstacles in your path!

mounts.name: Russet Bufonid
mounts.srcText: Profession: Protoform Synthesis
mounts.desc: Russet is a rare color among bufonids that is normally only seen on specimens that are tainted by other cosmic forces, or synthesized from a perplexing schematic that invokes that color.

mounts.name: Russet Ruinstrider
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Toraan the Revered
Zone: Argus
Faction: Argussian Reach - Exalted
Cost: 10000g
mounts.desc: Talbuks, native to Argus, have evolved chitinous plates to survive the decades of ceaseless war that ravages the landscape.

mounts.name: Rustbolt Resistor
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Stolen Royal Vendorbot
Zone: Mechagon
Faction: Rustbolt Resistance - Exalted
Cost: 524288g
mounts.desc: "R E S I S T" is carved into the seat in crude letters, along with several, more profane things.

mounts.name: Rusted Proto-Drake
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Glory of the Ulduar Raider
Category: Dungeons & Raids
mounts.desc: Not as shiny as the other one, but it's still a great find lads. Brann Bronzebeard

mounts.name: Rusty Mechanocrawler
mounts.srcText: Drop: Mechagon
mounts.desc: The check engine light is always on, it's when it goes off that you should be worried.

mounts.name: Sable Ruinstrider
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Toraan the Revered
Zone: Argus
Faction: Argussian Reach - Exalted
Cost: 10000g
mounts.desc: Talbuks, native to Argus, have evolved chitinous plates to survive the decades of ceaseless war that ravages the landscape.

mounts.name: Salatrancer
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Elianna
Zone: Emerald Dream
Cost: 1 Dream Infusion
mounts.desc: While most salamanthers' attention jumps freely from one attraction to the next, this one enjoys long periods of deep observation.

mounts.name: Saltwater Seahorse
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Captain Klarisa
Zone: Tiragarde Sound
Cost: 500 Seafarer's Dubloon
Vendor: Captain Zen'taga
Zone: Zuldazar
Cost: 500 Seafarer's Dubloon
mounts.desc: These giant seahorses are naturally curious, and are often found exploring sunken ship wreckage for shiny things.

mounts.name: Salvaged Goblin Gazillionaire's Flying Machine
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Gallagio Garbage
Zone: Undermine
mounts.desc: Once the prized possession of elite goblin society, this flying machine was sadly relegated to the scrap heap after something bigger, brighter, and more explosive arrived on the market.

mounts.name: Sanctum Gloomcharger
mounts.srcText:
Drop: The Nine
Zone: Sanctum of Domination
mounts.desc: Only the Jailer's most powerful lieutenants are gifted these steeds to stalk the halls of the Tower.

mounts.name: Sandstone Drake
mounts.srcText: Profession: Alchemy
mounts.desc: Sandstone Drakes were studied in great detail long ago by the famed alchemist Walleye Sprysprocket. It has even been said that Walleye developed potions to mimic the drakes' physiology.

mounts.name: Sandy Nightsaber
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Provisioner Stoutforge
Zone: Tiragarde Sound
Cost: 350 7th Legion Service Medal
Vendor: Provisioner Mukra
Zone: Zuldazar
Cost: 350 7th Legion Service Medal
mounts.desc: A rare color for a nightsaber, and rarely seen, they are prized amongst huntresses.

mounts.name: Sandy Shalewing
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Any Timewalking Vendor
Cost: 5000 Timewarped Badge
mounts.desc: The patterns on the wings of that creature resemble sand flowing through an hourglass. One could gaze upon them for ages...

mounts.name: Sanguine Harrower
mounts.srcText: Drop: Voidstorm Rare Creatures
mounts.desc: A brutal aerial predator of the Voidstorm, the Sanguine Harrower makes up for its lack of stealth with a terrifying visage and hunting prowess.

mounts.name: Sapphire Panther
mounts.srcText: Profession: Jewelcrafting
mounts.desc: Legends say that an ancient pandaren emperor crafted the first jeweled panther for his son after the boy's twin brother died of an illness.

mounts.name: Sapphire Riverbeast
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Silthide
Zone: Talador
mounts.desc: This animal's color mimics the clear blue of Draenor's river shallows, making it almost invisible to aquatic predators.

mounts.name: Sapphire Skyblazer
mounts.srcText: Promotion
mounts.desc: These brilliant blue birds burn brighter (and hotter) than their orange cousins, though the origin of both remains a mystery.

mounts.name: Sapphire Vorquin
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Treysh
Zone: The Forbidden Reach
Cost: 40g
Vendor: Tethalash
Zone: Valdrakken
Cost: 40g
mounts.desc: Respected for their resilience in battle, even against dragonfire, these noble beasts are the prized mounts of the dracthyr cavalry.

mounts.name: Sarge's Tale
mounts.srcText: Promotion
mounts.desc: Hold on a sec, Sarge isn't that large, someone must have spun a tall tale in the Hearthstone Tavern...

mounts.name: Savage Alabaster Battle Turtle
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: Wisdom throughout the ages has led to a well-known saying, "Nothing can outrun a cannon."

mounts.name: Savage Blue Battle Turtle
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: Don't feel blue chasing your foes, you've got cannons. Nothing can outrun a cannon.

mounts.name: Savage Crimson Battle Turtle
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: This savage turtle sees red at every turn. Though slow in speed, it is vital to remember that nothing can outrun a cannon.

mounts.name: Savage Ebony Battle Turtle
mounts.srcText: Promotion
mounts.desc: The cannons are powered by an unquenchable rage to seek out enemies and bring them to justice. Nothing can outrun a cannon.

mounts.name: Savage Green Battle Turtle
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: Turtle too slow to chase down your foes? Just add cannons. Nothing can outrun a cannon.

mounts.name: Savage Raptor
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Landro Longshot
Location: Booty Bay
mounts.desc: One-time companion of Kanga the Primal, the fallen troll hero. The raptor's name is unknown, for Kanga only spoke to it in bear form.

mounts.name: Savage Snapvine
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: The Snapvines have always been dangerous, but we never realized that the deep variants were independent, and could fly. Why would anyone want to find one of those things, much less ride one? But the fruit is good.

mounts.name: Scarlet Helicid
mounts.srcText: Profession: Protoform Synthesis
mounts.desc: This helicid's unusual reddish tint is clearly intentional in its design, but the only other difference between these and other helicids is the unusual lack of any ooze.

mounts.name: Scarlet Pterrordax
mounts.srcText: Quest: Time to Fly
mounts.desc: This pterrordax was so eager to take to the skies that its handler couldn't finish training it.

mounts.name: Scarlet Void Flyer
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: The War Within Keystone Legend: Season Three
Category: Dungeons
mounts.desc: Driven mad by the void, these winged creatures are a flurry of claws and teeth.

mounts.name: Scarlet Witchwick's Rider
mounts.srcText: In-Game Shop
mounts.desc: Sleek, stylish, and spooky, the Witchwick Rider offers a smooth and surprisingly comfortable ride, thanks to the ergonomic saddle requested by many a spellcaster seeking cushioned support.

mounts.name: Scintillating Mana Ray
mounts.srcText: Drop: Fel-Spotted Egg
mounts.desc: Some of the natural wildlife of Argus, like the mana ray, has survived and adapted to life on the shattered world.

mounts.name: Scorching Valor
mounts.srcText: In-Game Shop
mounts.desc: Some cannot be held back or restrained. Scorching Valor will seek greatness and only serve those who can serve their pursuit.

mounts.name: Scourgebound Vanquisher
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Time Rifts
Vendor: Baron Silver
Zone: Tyrhold Reservoir
Cost: 3000 Paracausal Flakes
mounts.desc: Once bound in service to the Scourge, these undead dragons exist only to spread death, disease, and destruction.

mounts.name: Scrapforged Mechaspider
mounts.srcText:
Quest: Drive It Away Today
Zone: Mechagon
mounts.desc: You built this yourself, you should be proud, even though it's smoky, sparky, and loud.

mounts.name: Scrappy Worldsnail
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Dealer Vexil
Zone: The Waking Shores
Cost: 1000 Magmote
mounts.desc: For the Worldbreakers, a portable footstool. For you, a hardy mount.

mounts.name: Sea Turtle
mounts.srcText: Profession: Fishing
mounts.desc: Often caught by fishermen at a young age, these mounts are much more comfortable in the water than they are on land.

mounts.name: Sea-Dwelling Isle Serpent
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Second Mate Sluggs
Zone: The Coiled Isle
mounts.desc: This oozing serpent has a taste for fish. As long as you can feed them, they should remain friendly. Should.

mounts.name: Seabraid Stallion
mounts.srcText: Promotion: Battle for Azeroth Collector's Edition
mounts.desc: Horses in the Kul Tiran military are bred from an early age not to fear the sea, and revel in galloping along the shoreline and through the spray.

mounts.name: Seething Slug
mounts.srcText:
Treasure: Seething Cache
Zone: Zaralek Cavern
mounts.desc: Drawn forth from its abyss by the rage of the Zaqali.

mounts.name: Sentinel War Wolf
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: Captured in a Sentinel raid, the loyalty of the wolf favors the strongest.
