mounts.name: Serenade
mounts.srcText: Profession: Protoform Synthesis
mounts.desc: These beautiful helicids emerge only at night. When they are pleased, their shells hum with a joyful melody.

mounts.name: Sha-Warped Cloud Serpent
mounts.srcText: Promotion: Mists of Pandaria Classic
mounts.desc: Sha has warped this cloud serpent into an even more fearsome creature. The emotions that flow through this creature make it an unmistakable harbinger of doom.

mounts.name: Sha-Warped Owl
mounts.srcText: Promotion
mounts.desc: Sha has warped this owl into an even more fearsome creature. The emotions that flow through this creature make it an unmistakable harbinger of doom.

mounts.name: Sha-Warped Riding Tiger
mounts.srcText: Promotion: Mists of Pandaria Classic
mounts.desc: Sha has warped this tiger into an even more fearsome creature. The emotions that flow through this creature make it an unmistakable harbinger of doom.

mounts.name: Sha-Warped Riding Wolf
mounts.srcText: Promotion
mounts.desc: Sha has warped this wolf into an even more fearsome creature. The emotions that flow through this creature make it an unmistakable harbinger of doom.

mounts.name: Shackled Shadow
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Auralia Steelstrike
Zone: Hallowfall
Cost: 11375 Resonance Crystals
mounts.desc: Who would have guessed that a shadow elemental would make for such a comfortable ride?

mounts.name: Shackled Ur'zul
mounts.srcText: Drop: Argus the Unmaker (Mythic)
mounts.desc: Formed from the tormented bodies and souls of fallen members of the Army of the Light, the Ur'zul is both fascinating and horrifying.

mounts.name: Shadeleaf Runestag
mounts.srcText:
Covenant: Night Fae
Zone: Ardenweald
mounts.desc: The shadeleaf runestag are bred for their ferocity as well as their beauty by the Wild Hunt. They feel no fear charging into the den of any predator.

mounts.name: Shadow Dusk Dreamsaber
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Glory of the Dream Raider
Category: Dungeons & Raids
mounts.desc: A dreamsaber strikes quickly from the shadows, capturing small animals and slipping back into darkness without a sound. The lucky few who have seen a feeding dreamsaber can see them revel in lazily toying with their prey before beginning their meal.

mounts.name: Shadow of Doubt
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: You Xal Not Pass
Category: Exploration
mounts.desc: Manifesting after Xal'atath's disappearance, this shadow's very existence begs the question: Were her schemes truly thwarted? Or have we just played deeper into her hands?

mounts.name: Shadowbarb Drone
mounts.srcText:
Quest: My Own Drone
Zone: Uldum
mounts.desc: Void, jelly, and a very full belly is all this drone needs.

mounts.name: Shadowblade's Baneful Omen
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Zan Shivsproket
Zone: Dalaran
mounts.desc: For the toxin-inclined.

mounts.name: Shadowblade's Crimson Omen
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Zan Shivsproket
Zone: Dalaran
mounts.desc: The blood of your enemies won't even show up, blends right in.

mounts.name: Shadowblade's Felscorned Omen
mounts.srcText: World Event: WoW Remix: Legion
mounts.desc: Your enemies will know fear before their end.

mounts.name: Shadowblade's Lethal Omen
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Zan Shivsproket
Zone: Dalaran
mounts.desc: They'll never hear you coming.

mounts.name: Shadowblade's Murderous Omen
mounts.srcText: Quest: Hiding In Plain Sight
mounts.desc: The preferred vehicle for assassinations, they make no sounds when flying - really great for sneaking up on people.

mounts.name: Shadowed Swarmite
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Glory of the Nerub-ar Raider
Category: Dungeons & Raids
mounts.desc: Swarmites are a common sight both in the wilds of Azj-Kahet and among the nerubians who have long domesticated them, but that doesn't make them any less dangerous to incautious adventurers.

mounts.name: Shadowflame Shalewing
mounts.srcText: Achievement: Glory of the Aberrus Raider
mounts.desc: Born from the magma, its carapace was originally molten blobs cooled to form dark-colored volcanic rock. Being imbued by shadowflame has only solidified its unbreakable nature.

mounts.name: Shadowhide Pearltusk
mounts.srcText: Drop: Invader's Forgotten Treasure
mounts.desc: Some legends say the draenei first befriended the elekk after one of the beasts saved an injured scout from a pack of vicious podlings.

mounts.name: Shadowmane Charger
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Ravenspeaker Skeega / Shadow-Sage Brakoss
Faction: Arakkoa Outcasts - Exalted
Location: Stormshield / Warspear
Cost: 5,000g + 5,000 Apexis Crystal
mounts.desc: Draenei poets have likened this talbuk's coloring to shadows cast by moonlight in an ashen forest.

mounts.name: Shale Ramolith
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Auditor Balwurz
Zone: Dornogal
Cost: 8125 Resonance Crystals
mounts.desc: Earthen have long used ramoliths as beasts of burden due to their hardy nature. Shale ramoliths are considered to be friendlier than most others, though that isn't saying much.

mounts.name: Shaohao's Sage Serpent
mounts.srcText: Promotion: Mists of Pandaria Classic
mounts.desc: The lessons Shaohao learned in life and death and the passion he held for his home have coalesced into this ethereal serpent, a reflection of the Emperor's wisdom.

mounts.name: Sharkbait
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Harlan Sweete
Zone: Freehold (Mythic)
Treasure: Challenger's Cache
Zone: Freehold
mounts.desc: Sharkbait's loyalty lies with whomever keeps the crackers coming.

mounts.name: Sharktested Crest-Horn
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: The Crest-Horn will often be drawn to graze on the plants that grow in the sea. Some have braved the fiercest wildlife there, making them true Kalu'ak.

mounts.name: Shellack
mounts.srcText: Achievement: Glory of the Dragonflight Hero
mounts.desc: Fed by victory and hardened by glory, this snail is nothing less than a tribute to mastery.

mounts.name: Shimmering Aurelid
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Glory of the Sepulcher Raider
Category: Dungeons & Raids
mounts.desc: Though it was once created to defend the Sepulcher of the First Ones, with its primary function now completed, it now obediently follows your command.

mounts.name: Shimmermist Free Runner
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: Unburdened from the saddle and bit, these valerunners are truly free.

mounts.name: Shimmermist Runner
mounts.srcText:
Area: Mistveil Tangle
Zone: Ardenweald
mounts.desc: Mischievous spriggans and the valerunners have a natural enmity. No valerunner would deign to allow a spriggan rider because they can sense their inherent malevolence. This angers the trickster spriggans who take twisted enjoyment in playing cruel pranks on these majestic creatures.

mounts.name: Shu-Zen, the Divine Sentinel
mounts.srcText: In-Game Shop
mounts.desc: As the Golden Lotus worked tirelessly to repair the Vale of Eternal Blossoms, a single statue came to life and wordlessly defended them from the Sha that assaulted them. Believed by some to be a sign of good fortune and others to be a gift from the Light, Shu-Zen provides faithful companionship to any that would defend Azeroth from the maddening whispers of the Old Gods.

mounts.name: Siesbarg
mounts.srcText:
World Quest: Consolation Flies
Zone: Azj-Kahet
Zone: City of Threads
mounts.desc: Poor guy.

mounts.name: Silent Glider
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Soundless
Zone: Nazjatar
mounts.desc: Gasses naturally stored within the creature allowed it to survive within the depths, those same gasses also allow them to effortlessly float through the air.

mounts.name: Silky Shimmermoth
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Master Clerk Salorn
Zone: Ardenweald
Cost: 5000 Reservoir Anima
mounts.desc: The moths of Ardenweald play a vital role in the ecosystem, carrying spores, anima, and pollen from one part of the forest to the other, providing nourishment and variation to the denizens living below.

mounts.name: Siltwing Albatross
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Captain Klarisa
Zone: Tiragarde Sound
Cost: 1000 Seafarer's Dubloon
Vendor: Captain Zen'taga
Zone: Zuldazar
Cost: 1000 Seafarer's Dubloon
mounts.desc: One of the rarest of birds seen on the islands of the Great Sea, and a prized possession amongst traders, if they can capture it.

mounts.name: Silver Covenant Hippogryph
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Hiren Loresong
Zone: Icecrown
Faction: The Silver Covenant - Exalted
Cost: 150 Champion's Seal
mounts.desc: Silver Covenant Hippogryphs are fiercely loyal, both to their riding partners, and to the Alliance.

mounts.name: Silver Riding Crane
mounts.srcText: World Event: WoW Remix: Mists of Pandaria
mounts.desc: This tall bird is one of the most graceful and elegant cranes, slightly moreso than the Bronze Crane but less than the Golden Crane.

mounts.name: Silver Riding Nether Ray
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Grella
Zone: Terokkar Forest, Outland
Faction: Sha'tari Skyguard - Exalted
Cost: 200g
mounts.desc: Nether Rays are among the most trusted, versatile mounts in all of Outland and beyond.

mounts.name: Silver Riding Talbuk
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Provisioner Nasela
Zone: Nagrand, Outland
Faction: The Mag'har - Exalted
Cost: 70g
Vendor: Trader Narasu
Zone: Nagrand, Outland
Faction: The Kurenai - Exalted
Cost: 70g
mounts.desc: The orcs once hunted these graceful herd animals as part of the om'riggor rite of passage ceremony.

mounts.name: Silver Tidestallion
mounts.srcText: Special Event: Plunderstorm
mounts.desc: This tidestallion and its silvery scales were drawn to the glint of plunder in your pocket.

mounts.name: Silver War Talbuk
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Provisioner Nasela
Zone: Nagrand, Outland
Faction: The Mag'har - Exalted
Cost: 100g
Vendor: Trader Narasu
Zone: Nagrand, Outland
Faction: The Kurenai - Exalted
Cost: 100g
mounts.desc: Despite their docile nature, talbuks have been known to gore seasoned warriors to death when threatened.

mounts.name: Silvermoon Hawkstrider
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Trellis Morningsun
Zone: Icecrown
Cost: 100 Champion's Seal
mounts.desc: So I says I feel like chicken tonight. Next thing, I am flat out and that thing is trying to see what my eyes taste like. -Bozzle Blastbolt

mounts.name: Silvermoon Sweeper
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: The Silvermoon color scheme for the "Motion By Emotion" has been a success all across Azeroth.

mounts.name: Silvermoon's Arcane Defender
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Telemancer Astrandis
Zone: Silvermoon City
Cost: 10 Voidlight Marl
mounts.desc: A gilded variant of the Arcane Guardian, most often seen guarding the more opulent districts of Silvermoon City.

mounts.name: Silvertip Dredwing
mounts.srcText:
Covenant Feature: The Ember Court
Covenant: Venthyr
Covenant Feature: Queen's Conservatory
Covenant: Night Fae
Covenant Feature: Path of Ascension
Covenant: Kyrian
Covenant Feature: Abomination Factory
Covenant: Necrolord
mounts.desc: Bred by the Revendreth prince, Renathal, these rare dredwing are fiercely loyal and will only let those deemed worthy by the prince himself to interact with them.

mounts.name: Silverwind Larion
mounts.srcText:
Treasure: Gift of the Silver Wind
Zone: Bastion
mounts.desc: This gift of the silvery winds is only bestowed upon those that search high and low for the wisdom of Bastion.

mounts.name: Sinfall Gargon
mounts.srcText:
Covenant: Venthyr
Zone: Revendreth
mounts.desc: The gargon are the loyal mounts and companions of the Venthyr and Renathal has found many abandoned at Sinfall, awaiting reawakening and assignment to worthy members of the covenant.

mounts.name: Sinfall Gravewing
mounts.srcText:
Covenant: Venthyr
Zone: Revendreth
mounts.desc: With anima once again flowing in Sinfall, the Stonewright has been able to infuse these Stoneborn, making them valuable allies in the battles to come.

mounts.name: Sinrunner Blanchy
mounts.srcText:
NPC: Dead Blanchy
Location: Revendreth
mounts.desc: In life, Blanchy appeared to be an affectionate, well-behaved horse of excellent disposition and appetite. What evils must she have committed in secret to have earned her place among the condemned souls of Revendreth?

mounts.name: Sintouched Deathwalker
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Shadowlands Keystone Master: Season One
Category: Dungeons
mounts.desc: Forged from the sins of countless diabolical dungeon denizens. Only those with the skills to overcome them may hold its reins.

mounts.name: Skullripper
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Skullripper
Zone: Arathi Highlands
mounts.desc: She's a clever girl.

mounts.name: Sky Golem
mounts.srcText: Profession: Engineering
mounts.desc: A glorious feat of engineering, the sky golem takes traditional shredder technology to a whole new level (and altitude!).

mounts.name: Sky Surfer
mounts.srcText: World Event: WoW Remix: Mists of Pandaria
mounts.desc: An ancient mogu artifact awarded to those who are deeply committed to the skies.

mounts.name: Sky Witch's Sweeper
mounts.srcText: In-Game Shop
mounts.desc: The sky's the limit when you mount up on this "Motion By Emotion" magic broom model.

mounts.name: Skypaw Glimmerfur
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Collector Ta'steld
Zone: Oribos
Cost: 5000 Timewarped Badge
mounts.desc: A Glimmerfur's coat takes on properties of its environment much like a camouflage. Patterns of bright blue skies and majestic white clouds have earned this glimmerfur the nickname "Skypaw."

mounts.name: Skyskin Hornstrider
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Brendormi
Cost: 150 Essence of the Storm 3000 Elemental Overflow
mounts.desc: The instability of primalist storms in potential timelines sometimes causes creatures to absorb the energies from the very storms. These creatures tend to be docile towards those who are able to face the fury of these chronomatic anomalies.

mounts.name: Slag Basilisk
mounts.srcText: World Event: WoW Remix: Legion
mounts.desc: Originally dwelling deep underground where their diet consisted of obsidian and basalt, the slag basilisks surfaced when their homes were disturbed by the Legion.

mounts.name: Slate Primordial Direhorn
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Zandalari Warbringer
Zone: Dread Wastes, Krasarang Wilds, Kun-Lai Summit, Townlong Steppes, Valley of the Four Winds
mounts.desc: The masks aren't to control the direhorn; they are so no one sees your face when it turns on you.

mounts.name: Slatestone Ramolith
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Allied Races: Earthen
Category: War Within
mounts.desc: Earthen ranchers talk often of this creature's resilience and how the rain ricochets off of its lustrous coat.

mounts.name: Slayer's Felbroken Shrieker
mounts.srcText: Quest: To Fel and Back
mounts.desc: You broke it, you bought it.

mounts.name: Slayer's Felscorned Shrieker
mounts.srcText: World Event: WoW Remix: Legion
mounts.desc: Torn from the heavens by only the most cunning of Demon Hunters.

mounts.name: Slime Serpent
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Slime Serpent
Zone: Plaguefall
mounts.desc: This mysterious creature lurks beneath the slime pools of Plaguefall. No one knows where it came from.

mounts.name: Smoky Charger
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Quartermaster Alcorn
Zone: Drustvar
Faction: Order of Embers - Exalted
Cost: 10000g
mounts.desc: Among the oldest horse breeds in Kul Tiras, they even led many a charge in the original struggle with the drust.

mounts.name: Smoky Direwolf
mounts.srcText: Drop: Invader's Forgotten Treasure
mounts.desc: Believed to reside mostly in the north. Hates weddings.

mounts.name: Smoldering Cinderbee
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Auditor Balwurz
Zone: Dornogal
Cost: 11375 Resonance Crystals
mounts.desc: A somewhat surprising choice of mount, the Council of Dornogal assures you riding it is safe. Mostly.

mounts.name: Smoldering Ember Wyrm
mounts.srcText: Zone: Return to Karazhan
mounts.desc: Arcanagos sought to turn Medivh away from experiments into the arcane, but the influence of Sargeras had corrupted the wizard too deeply, and the great dragon paid for the transgression with eternal, burning agony.

mounts.name: Snapback Scuttler
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Undersea Usurper
Category: Battle for Azeroth
mounts.desc: Giant crabs are native to Nazjatar and a favored food of the naga. This one must have been well-kept to grow this large.

mounts.name: Snapdragon Kelpstalker
mounts.srcText:
Quest: Good Girl
Zone: Nazjatar
mounts.desc: When a snapdragon bites you, the worry isn't about the bite itself, but the poison that will begin to eat away at the wound.

mounts.name: Snowfeather Hunter
mounts.srcText: Quest: Snowfeather Reunion
mounts.desc: Capable of hiding in a fog bank until prey approaches, then slicing them open with one claw-raised jump.

mounts.name: Snowfluff Dreamtalon
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Talisa Whisperbloom
Zone: Emerald Dream
Cost: 1 Seedbloom
mounts.desc: As lighthearted and gentle as the snow, they can bounce from one snowdrift to the next without leaving a print.

mounts.name: Snowpaw Glimmerfur Prowler
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Collector Ta'steld
Zone: Oribos
Cost: 5000 Timewarped Badge
mounts.desc: The snowpaw inhabit the frigid afterlives of the Shadowlands, reveling in their frosty environment. Travelers thought lost to the deadly blizzards of Northrend would sometimes miraculously be found alive, proclaiming that they owe their lives to the mysterious foxes that protected them.

mounts.name: Snowstorm
mounts.srcText: Blizzard's 30th Anniversary
mounts.desc: He comes from the ice and snow, under the Azeroth sun where adventurers go.

mounts.name: Snowy Darkmoon Charger
mounts.srcText: Trading Post

mounts.name: Snowy Gryphon
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Tannec Stonebeak
Zone: Stormwind City
Cost: 50g
mounts.desc: They love lions in Stormwind, and the gryphon is half lion. Of course they might not like which half. -Gryphon Master Talonaxe

mounts.name: Snowy Highmountain Eagle
mounts.srcText: World Event: WoW Remix: Legion
mounts.desc: To find the feather of a snowy eagle in Highmountain is an omen of shifting winds and temperature drops.

mounts.name: Snowy Riding Goat
mounts.srcText: World Event: WoW Remix: Mists of Pandaria
mounts.desc: The Kun-Lai Summit mountain goats are known for climbing even the highest peaks in search of kafa beans and salt licks.

mounts.name: Soaring Meaderbee
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Cendvin
Zone: The Isle of Dorn
Cost: 900 Sizzling Cinderpollen
mounts.desc: This humble bee dreams of open skies. Whether or not an adventurer is along for the ride is of no consequence to it.

mounts.name: Soaring Razorwing
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Archivist Roh-Suir
Zone: Korthia
Faction: The Archivists' Codex - Tier 6
Cost: 5000 Cataloged Research
mounts.desc: The hide of the razorwing is light, allowing it to fly, but also quite tough, allowing them to survive passage into the Maw.

mounts.name: Soaring Sky Fox
mounts.srcText: In-Game Shop
mounts.desc: Take to the sky on the most loyal and loving fox on Azeroth.

mounts.name: Soaring Skyterror
mounts.srcText: Achievement: Draenor Pathfinder
mounts.desc: The extra-light equipment on this chromatic rylak allows it to swoop and glide through the clouds easily, free from the bounds of the land below.

mounts.name: Soaring Spelltome
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: A Tour of Towers
Category: Timewalking
mounts.desc: In the forgotten depths of the Dalaran library, this oversized tome was found flapping madly around the room. Open the pages of this arcane-infused book and hitch a ride to magical adventure.

mounts.name: Solar Spirehawk
mounts.srcText: Drop: Rukhmar
mounts.desc: Looking into the eyes of this mystical beast is like peering into the heart of the sun. Goggles are recommended when you're riding.

mounts.name: Son of Galleon
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Galleon
Location: Valley of the Four Winds
mounts.desc: Trained from a young age, these massive Mushan are taught to thunder into battle carrying a full saurok warband.

mounts.name: Soulbound Gloomcharger
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Mysterious Gift from Ve'nari
Zone: The Maw
mounts.desc: Ve'nari has many methods of sneaking around the Maw and disrupting the Jailer's plans, including binding his own minions.

mounts.name: Soultwisted Deathwalker
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Shadowlands Keystone Master: Season Two
Category: Dungeons
mounts.desc: A howling vortex of tormented souls, ridden only by those who wish to demonstrate their impressive tolerance for pain and suffering.

mounts.name: Soweezi's Vintage Waveshredder
mounts.srcText:
Zone: Siren Isle
Vendor: Soweezi
mounts.desc: This pretty lil' thing has a beautiful platinum sheen. It'll take ya sky-high in seconds! You'll be dancing around the sun to your heart's content for the low, low price of ten thousand smackeroonies.

mounts.name: Spawn of Galakras
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Glory of the Orgrimmar Raider
Category: Dungeons & Raids
mounts.desc: This formidable creature's lineage may be traced to Galakras, and yet further to Galakrond, one of the most infamous of all proto-dragons.

mounts.name: Spawn of Horridon
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Horridon
Zone: Throne of Thunder
mounts.desc: When you see a hurricane coming, you get out of the way. Horridon would fight the hurricane and win.

mounts.name: Spawn of Vyranoth
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Master of the Turbulent Timeways V
Category: Timewalking
mounts.desc: Vyranoth's brood was decimated by the aspects, yet Vyranoth's actions have brought many of her surviving progeny to follow in her frigid path and aid in Azeroth's defense.

mounts.name: Spectral Gryphon
mounts.srcText: Promotion: Scroll of Resurrection
mounts.desc: When you said an old friend was coming back, this was not quite what I expected. -Bralla Cloudwing

mounts.name: Spectral Hawkstrider
mounts.srcText:
Drop: The Restless Heart
Zone: Windrunner Spire (Mythic)
Drop: Challenger's Cache
Zone: Windrunner Spire
mounts.desc: Phalanx Breaker of the Silvermoon Cavalry, this companion of the past ever wills its rider forward.

mounts.name: Spectral Pterrorwing
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Natal'hakata
Zone: Zuldazar
Faction: Zandalari Empire - Exalted
Cost: 90000g
mounts.desc: Vengeful spectres abound in the spirit realm surrounding Dazar'alor.

mounts.name: Spectral Steed
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Quartermaster Brazie
Zone: Tol Barad Peninsula
Faction: Baradin's Wardens - Exalted
Cost: 165 Tol Barad Commendation
mounts.desc: Dark spirits flee before the radiance of its presence.

mounts.name: Spectral Tiger
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Landro Longshot
Location: Booty Bay
mounts.desc: In true goblin fashion, Landro Longshot has put a stranglehold on the distribution of these mysterious incorporeal mounts.

mounts.name: Spectral Wind Rider
mounts.srcText: Promotion: Scroll of Resurrection
mounts.desc: How do you not fall right through that thing? -Maztha

mounts.name: Spectral Wolf
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Pogg
Zone: Tol Barad Peninsula
Faction: Hellscream's Reach - Exalted
Cost: 165 Tol Barad Commendation
mounts.desc: Fears only fire.

mounts.name: Speculative Shreddertank
mounts.srcText: Vendor: Lindormi
mounts.desc: The numbers look great if it doesn't explode.

mounts.name: Spinemaw Gladechewer
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Gormtamer Tizo
Zone: Ardenweald
mounts.desc: Spriggan riders tie bits of anima-less detritus to the end of sticks in front of their gorm mounts to steer. It's... an imperfect art.

mounts.name: Spirit of Eche'ro
mounts.srcText: Profession: Archaeology
mounts.desc: The spirit of Huln Highmountain's pet moose.

mounts.name: Spirit of Tok'jara
mounts.srcText:
Quest: The Innocent Essence
Zone: Vaults of Atal'Utek
mounts.desc: Now freed from the curse, the great eagle Tok'jara continues to serve the Amani even through death.

mounts.name: Spotted Black Riding Goat
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: One time a farmhand walked by without petting this goat. That's all it took for the goat to make it personal.

mounts.name: Spotted Frostsaber
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Lelanai
Zone: Darnassus
Cost: 1g
mounts.desc: This hearty mount's ferocious appetite earned it the nickname "Dragon Belly" in the night elf language.

mounts.name: Spring Butterfly
mounts.srcText:
World Event: Love is in the Air
Drop: Apothecary Hummel
mounts.desc: Take to the skies on a glittering, shimmering, spring butterfly.

mounts.name: Spring Harvesthog
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: The Spring Harvesthog is at its most energetic in the early morning. It will spend most of its day snuffling for food or bellowing out calls for other harvesthogs.

mounts.name: Spring Panda
mounts.srcText: In-Game Shop
mounts.desc: Equipped with bamboo tools, food and a napping cub, the Spring Panda is ready for an amazing adventure.

mounts.name: Springfur Alpaca
mounts.srcText:
Quest: Alpaca It In
Zone: Uldum
mounts.desc: The kind nature of alpacas makes them perfect as companions for the intrepid adventurer.

mounts.name: Springtide Dreamtalon
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Talisa Whisperbloom
Zone: Emerald Dream
Cost: 1 Seedbloom
mounts.desc: Surging with the kind of energy and enthusiasm that can make anyone envious.

mounts.name: Squawks
mounts.srcText: Drop: Island Expeditions
mounts.desc: Guess why he's called that? It's not because he's a nice, quiet pet.

mounts.name: Squeakers, the Trickster
mounts.srcText: In-Game Shop
mounts.desc: The locals in Halfhill swear that whenever a batch of grain is missing, a farmworking instrument is misplaced, or a bushel of berries can't be found, you can hear a mischievous squeaking, and are reminded to slow down and accept what life gives you.

mounts.name: Starcursed Voidstrider
mounts.srcText: Achievement: Allied Races: Void Elf
mounts.desc: This shadow-infused strider embodies the elves' commitment to harness the power of the Void in the name of the Alliance.

mounts.name: Stargrazer
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Elianna
Zone: Emerald Dream
Cost: 1 Dream Infusion
mounts.desc: One can't help but think what it might feel like to pluck the stars from their fixture in the sky. Perhaps, Stargrazer will show us how someday.

mounts.name: Starspark Netherdrake
mounts.srcText: Promotion: Burning Crusade Classic
mounts.desc: After flying you to the ends of Outland and beyond, the netherwing drake was eventually drawn to the blue skies of Azeroth as well.

mounts.name: Startouched Furline
mounts.srcText: In-Game Shop
mounts.desc: An early eternal traveler encountered the furline and befriended a pair. Accompanying the traveler back to their domain, these furline kittens were forever changed by living there and accompanying the travelers.

mounts.name: Steamscale Incinerator
mounts.srcText: In-Game Shop
mounts.desc: A mad gnomish inventor had a dream to ride a dragon, so he created this metal monstrosity. He powered it with a trapped demon, in order to create "an authentic dragon soul," and did not survive its activation.

mounts.name: Steamwheedle Supplier
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Steamwheedle Trove
Zone: Undermine
mounts.desc: Supplies you with a quick trip, or your enemies with a large explosion!

mounts.name: Steel Prototype Panther MK-0
mounts.srcText: In-Game Shop
mounts.desc: The first Steel Horde soldiers crossing the Dark Portal captured a ferocious nightsaber. Blackrock artisans armed it with magma armor, transforming it into a combat weapon. Warriors may customize its parts at the Morphing Forum to suit their fighting style and dominate the battlefield.

mounts.name: Steelbound Devourer
mounts.srcText: Profession: Blacksmithing
mounts.desc: Only the sturdiest-forged chains can restrain this beast.

mounts.name: Sthaarbs's Last Lunch
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Sthaarbs
Zone: K'aresh
mounts.desc: When one cosmically invasive threat meets another, sometimes the smaller will end up on the menu of the larger. At least cosmic observers don't always chew their meals.

mounts.name: Stoneforged Sentinel
mounts.srcText: In-Game Shop
mounts.desc: Sometimes the right tool for the job cannot be simply pulled from a shelf. Craftsmen from across Azeroth have developed the Stoneforged Sentinel to address this need, allowing each to create the perfect guardian for the time and place it is used.

mounts.name: Stonehide Elderhorn
mounts.srcText: Drop: Island Expeditions
mounts.desc: Stonehide elderhorns, one of the few types of moose to inhabit island climates, have thinner fur than most elderhorns.

mounts.name: Stonevault Mechsuit
mounts.srcText:
Quest: Repurposed, Restored
Zone: The Ringing Deeps
mounts.desc: Metal once ruined, restored to life by scrap and song.

mounts.name: Stormgilded Celestial
mounts.srcText: In-Game Shop
mounts.desc: Gilded in thunder, chosen by destiny. Golden lightning wraps its hooves, piercing the sky like tearing through night. Legends tie it closely to Emperor Shaohao.

mounts.name: Stormhide Salamanther
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Mythressa
Cost: 2000 Elemental Overflow
mounts.desc: Sometimes when storm energies infuse a creature, it simply... becomes larger and more placid. Few salamanthers are willing to be ridden, but these children of the storm are a notable exception.

mounts.name: Stormpike Battle Charger
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Thanthaldis Snowgleam
Zone: Hillsbrad Foothills
Cost: 2000 Honor
mounts.desc: The Stormpike clan's mount trainers have a tradition of etching their names onto the left horn of every battle ram they raise.

mounts.name: Stormpike Battle Ram
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Alterac Valley of Olde
Category: Alterac Valley
mounts.desc: Raised in the Alterac Mountains by the Stormpike Clan, trained to headbutt orcs.

mounts.name: Stormsong Coastwatcher
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Sister Lilyana
Zone: Stormsong Valley
Faction: Storm's Wake - Exalted
Cost: 90000g
mounts.desc: Tasked with keeping watch on the seas for approaching dangers, the Stormsong Coastwatchers fly constant patrols.

mounts.name: Stormtouched Bruffalon
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Across the Isles
Category: Exploration
mounts.desc: Even from within her prison, Raszageth's primal scorn brought the mightiest beasts to heel.

mounts.name: Stormwind Skychaser
mounts.srcText: Blizzcon 2017
mounts.desc: "Give me all the engines you got." - Engineer Cogspinner

mounts.name: Stormwind Steed
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Corporal Arthur Flew
Zone: Icecrown
Cost: 100 Champion's Seal
mounts.desc: Although raised in Stormwind, this breed showed unusual aptitude for the cold weather in Icecrown.

mounts.name: Striped Dawnsaber
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Lelanai
Zone: Teldrassil
Cost: 1g
mounts.desc: Night elves once believed that seeing this light colored saber breed in the wild was an ill omen.

mounts.name: Striped Frostsaber
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Lelanai
Zone: Darnassus
Cost: 1g
mounts.desc: This hearty mount's ferocious appetite earned it the nickname "Dragon Belly" in the night elf language.

mounts.name: Striped Nightsaber
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Lelanai
Zone: Darnassus
Cost: 1g
mounts.desc: Considered one of Azeroth's perfect predators, these agile beasts can sprint through dense forests without making a sound.

mounts.name: Subdued Seahorse
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Poseidus
Zone: Vashj'ir
mounts.desc: "One has not truly lived until they have felt the tidal current rushing through their hair while atop a majestic seahorse," said no one. Ever.

mounts.name: Subterranean Magmammoth
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Sacratros
Zone: Zaralek Cavern
Cost: 100 Coveted Bauble
mounts.desc: Awakened from a long slumber, this beast has yet to see the light of day.

mounts.name: Sulfur Hound
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Time Rifts
Vendor: Provisioner Qorra
Zone: Tyrhold Reservoir
Cost: 3000 Paracausal Flakes
mounts.desc: The Black Empire subjugated these humbled and hateful hounds. Utterly obedient, they still serve the strong.

mounts.name: Summer Harvesthog
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: The Summer Harvesthog enjoys laying out in the sun or going for a swim in a clear lake. They are excellent at foraging for food, but need to be coaxed into it.

mounts.name: Summer Wilderling
mounts.srcText:
Covenant: Night Fae
Drop: Escaped Wilderling
Zone: Korthia
mounts.desc: Stubborn and rebellious, this wilderling is loyal to very few. But those few are bonded for life.

mounts.name: Sun Festival's Painted Roc
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Ahune
Holiday: Midsummer
mounts.desc: Long ago, this elusive summer roc inspired many legends, many believing them to be descendants of phoenixes. The ancient tauren saw these majestic creatures as living manifestations of An'she's fire.

mounts.name: Sundancer
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Sundancer
Zone: Bastion
mounts.desc: This sun-dappled courser gallops on lightbeams with carefree abandon.

mounts.name: Sundered Zerethsteed
mounts.srcText: Profession: Protoform Synthesis
mounts.desc: Whatever the purpose of these cervids once was, it is long forgotten. Though they are not Dominated, they have been corrupted by the unintended presence of Mawsworn in the sacred realm of Zereth Mortis.

mounts.name: Sunflare Driftmoth
mounts.srcText: In-Game Shop
mounts.desc: Although they offer some of the smoothest rides of any mounts in the world, the Sunflare Driftmoth are rare to find in the wild, and rarer still to tame.

mounts.name: Sunhide Gronnling
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Poundfist
Zone: Gorgrond
mounts.desc: Loves the sun, hates everything else.

mounts.name: Sunreaver Dragonhawk
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Vasarin Redmorn
Zone: Icecrown
Faction: The Sunreavers - Exalted
Cost: 150 Champion's Seal
mounts.desc: The Sunreavers of Dalaran select only the swiftest and most formidable of dragonhawks as their mounts.

mounts.name: Sunreaver Hawkstrider
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Vasarin Redmorn
Zone: Icecrown
Faction: The Sunreavers - Exalted
Cost: 100 Champion's Seal
mounts.desc: I demand speed, grace and discipline on the battlefield. This one will serve nicely. -Eressea Dawnsinger

mounts.name: Sunstone Panther
mounts.srcText: Profession: Jewelcrafting
mounts.desc: Legends say that an ancient pandaren emperor crafted the first jeweled panther for his son after the boy's twin brother died of an illness.

mounts.name: Suntouched Dreamstag
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Moon Priestess Lasara
Zone: Emerald Dream
Cost: 1200 Dragon Isles Supplies
mounts.desc: The sun's radiant energy nurtures these dreamstags, helping them rapidly reach maturity.

mounts.name: Sunwalker Kodo
mounts.srcText: Paladin
mounts.desc: This magnificent beast, adorned in sacred charms and painted with holy imagery, radiates with the warmth of the sun.

mounts.name: Sunwarmed Furline
mounts.srcText: In-Game Shop
mounts.desc: The presence of the giant felines heralds the beginning of the end for the birds of Azeroth.

mounts.name: Sureki Skyrazor
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Queen Ansurek
Zone: Nerub-ar Palace
mounts.desc: The skyrazor was one of the most vicious abominations to emerge from Queen Ansurek's experiments with the Black Blood of the Old Gods.

mounts.name: Surf Jelly
mounts.srcText: Drop: Island Expeditions
mounts.desc: The time between being stung and being enveloped and devoured is short enough to consider not swimming in the Great Sea.

mounts.name: Swarmite Skyhunter
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Khaz Algar Glyph Hunter
Category: War Within
mounts.desc: Typically found in the smallest nooks and crannies of rock ceilings, the swarmite skyhunter is more at home in the air than at rest.

mounts.name: Swift Albino Raptor
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Beastrider Kama
Zone: Arathi Highlands
mounts.desc: The Witherbark warrior Beastrider Kama once cut bloody swathes of terror across the Arathi Highlands astride such a monster.

mounts.name: Swift Armored Vorquin
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Treysh
Zone: The Forbidden Reach
Cost: 80g
Vendor: Tethalash
Zone: Valdrakken
Cost: 80g
mounts.desc: Trained using ancient dracthyr methods, these armored vorquin are the pinnacle of tactical mounted ground warfare.

mounts.name: Swift Blue Gryphon
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Tannec Stonebeak
Zone: Stormwind City
Cost: 50g
mounts.desc: The Horde had dragons, we had the gryphons. We won that war. - Ilsa Blusterbrew

mounts.name: Swift Blue Raptor
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Zjolnir
Zone: Durotar
Cost: 10g
mounts.desc: Longtime allies of the trolls, these jungle hunters form a special bond with their masters. They become steed, guardian, and friend.

mounts.name: Swift Breezestrider
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Pathrunner
Zone: Shadowmoon Valley
mounts.desc: Draenei have relied on this mount, the swiftest of all talbuk, to relay messengers and their missives safely to their destinations.

mounts.name: Swift Brewfest Ram
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Keg-Shaped Treasure Chest
Holiday: Brewfest
mounts.desc: Dwarves attribute this breed's even temperament to rigorous training, but other races argue that a daily diet of strong ale has something to do with it.

mounts.name: Swift Brown Ram
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Veron Amberstill
Zone: Dun Morogh
Cost: 10g
mounts.desc: The Barak Tor'ol ram's thick bony skull and massive horns make it the ideal mount for charging through groups of armored enemies.

mounts.name: Swift Brown Steed
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Katie Stokx
Zone: Stormwind City
Cost: 1g
mounts.desc: A veteran of some of the toughest battles fought by the Argent Crusade.

mounts.name: Swift Brown Wolf
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Ogunaro Wolfrunner
Zone: Orgrimmar
Cost: 1g
mounts.desc: The wolves of the Horde are befriended, not domesticated.

mounts.name: Swift Burgundy Wolf
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Freka Bloodaxe
Zone: Icecrown
Cost: 500g
mounts.desc: The wolves of the Horde are befriended, not domesticated.

mounts.name: Swift Forest Strider
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Lhara
Zone: Darkmoon Island
Cost: 180 Darkmoon Prize Ticket
mounts.desc: This vibrant breed can only be found in the forests of Darkmoon Island.

mounts.name: Swift Frostsaber
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Lelanai
Location: Darnassus
Cost: 10g
mounts.desc: Night elves raise frostsaber cubs from infancy, forging lifelong bonds of trust between rider and beast.

mounts.name: Swift Frostwolf
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Beska Redtusk
Faction: Frostwolf Orcs - Exalted
Location: Warspear
Cost: 5,000g + 5,000 Apexis Crystal
mounts.desc: Amidst the cold heights of Frostfire, the frostwolves hunt anything they can catch. The fastest among them eat well.

mounts.name: Swift Gloomhoof
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Night Mare
Zone: Ardenweald
mounts.desc: The ballads of Ardenweald claim that the birth of gloomrunner heralds the passing of a particularly benevolent wild god. Seeing a gloomrunner is therefore a blessing and a curse.

mounts.name: Swift Gray Ram
mounts.srcText:

mounts.name: Swift Spectral Tiger
mounts.srcText:

Location: Booty Bay
mounts.desc: Historians claim that these incorporeal beasts were created when Draenor exploded, unleashing energies that warped the world's flora and fauna.

mounts.name: Swift Springstrider
mounts.srcText:

Dun Morogh, Elwynn Forest, Teldrassil

mounts.name: Swift Stormsaber
mounts.srcText:

mounts.name: Swift Zhevra
mounts.srcText: Recruit-a-Friend

mounts.name: Swift Zulian Panther
mounts.srcText:
Drop: High Priestess Kilnara
Zone: Zul'Gurub
mounts.desc: The jungle trolls have long coveted panther fangs, using them for rituals or as ingredients in mojos.

mounts.name: Sylverian Dreamer
mounts.srcText: In-Game Shop
mounts.desc: An artist in the magical city of Dalaran fell asleep on her brush, and dreamed of painting a beautiful feathered dragon. Her artwork leapt from the page, and when she awoke, she found it sleeping gently beside her.

mounts.name: Taivan
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: A World Awoken
Category: Expansion Features
mounts.desc: You don't have to be what the world expects you to be. Be who Taivan knows you *can* be.

mounts.name: Talont
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Elianna
Zone: Emerald Dream
Cost: 1 Dream Infusion
mounts.desc: Some daydreams are filled with wondrous possibilities, but shatter when reminded of reality's limitations. Some dreams are not so burdened, even when they carry a rider.

mounts.name: Tamed Mauler
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Supplies of the Archivist's Codex
Zone: Korthia
mounts.desc: When it comes to taming devourers, all it takes is a little anima and a lot of patience. And a lot of healing potions.

mounts.name: Tamed Skitterfly
mounts.srcText:
Faction: Dragonscale Expedition
Renown: 25
Vendor: Granpap Whiskers
Location: Dragonscale Basecamp
mounts.desc: It didn't take long for Granpap Whiskers to tame the skitterflies around the Dragonscale Basecamp and set them to helping move Expedition personnel and cargo.

mounts.name: Tan Riding Camel
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Blacksmith Abasi
Zone: Uldum
Faction: Ramkahen - Exalted
Cost: 100g
mounts.desc: Fennimore Quigley is credited with milking the first camel and breaking the record for "longest unintentional flight," all in the same afternoon.

mounts.name: Tan Riding Talbuk
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Provisioner Nasela
Zone: Nagrand, Outland
Faction: The Mag'har - Exalted
Cost: 70g
Vendor: Trader Narasu
Zone: Nagrand, Outland
Faction: The Kurenai - Exalted
Cost: 70g
mounts.desc: The orcs once hunted these graceful herd animals as part of the om'riggor rite of passage ceremony.

mounts.name: Tan War Talbuk
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Provisioner Nasela
Zone: Nagrand, Outland
Faction: The Mag'har - Exalted
Cost: 100g
Vendor: Trader Narasu
Zone: Nagrand, Outland
Faction: The Kurenai - Exalted
Cost: 100g
mounts.desc: Despite their docile nature, talbuks have been known to gore seasoned warriors to death when threatened.

mounts.name: Tangled Dreamweaver
mounts.srcText: Promotion: Dragonflight Heroic Edition
mounts.desc: The last of the sleepers are finally awakening, bringing the dreams of the dragons back to the lands.

mounts.name: Tarachnid Creeper
mounts.srcText: Profession: Protoform Synthesis
mounts.desc: These tarachnids make their home in the darkest corners of Zereth Mortis, coming out only to hunt (or, sometimes, carry a rider around).

mounts.name: Tarecgosa's Visage
mounts.srcText: Quest: Rhapsody in Blue
mounts.desc: "Farewell, Tarecgosa. A dear sister, hero, student, and teacher. Though blood does not bind us, you will always be family. May your soul find its place soaring among the stars."

mounts.name: Tawny Wind Rider
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Drakma
Zone: Orgrimmar
Cost: 50g
mounts.desc: After being freed from vicious harpies by Cairne and Thrall, many of these creatures became valuable companions of the Horde.

mounts.name: Tazavesh Gearglider
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Fake It 'Til You Make It
Category: Shadowlands Dungeon
mounts.desc: Brokers of all types use these gliders to travel around Tazavesh and similar nearby outposts, and carry their goods as well.

mounts.name: Teldrassil Hippogryph
mounts.srcText: Quest: From the Ashes...
mounts.desc: One of the last of the great armored hippogryphs to escape the burning of Teldrassil, it carried the last few citizens it could to safety before collapsing of exhaustion.

mounts.name: Telix the Stormhorn
mounts.srcText: Promotion
mounts.desc: Once a simple beetle of the Forbidden Reach, Telix became infused with storm magic when Raszageth was unleashed. With its newly heightened senses, Telix roams the Dragon Isles alongside the Dragonscale Expedition--and you!

mounts.name: Temperamental Skyclaw
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Zon'Wogi
Zone: The Azure Span
mounts.desc: Slyverns are rarely comfortable acting as mounts. Only those willing to feed their gluttonous appetites and keep a careful eye on them should attempt to ride.

mounts.name: Tenebrous Harrower
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Glory of the Midnight Raider
Category: Dungeons & Raids
mounts.desc: The fiercest harrowers of Voidstorm are often twisted by the void and bound to Xal'atath's will.

mounts.name: Terrified Pack Mule
mounts.srcText: Zone: Drustvar
mounts.desc: This poor mule was around Drustvar when the witches took over. He's seen too much.

mounts.name: Terror of the Night
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Vigilante
Category: War Within
mounts.desc: Don't be deceived by its bright colors, it is capable of sneaking up on anyone (or anything).

mounts.name: Terror of the Wastes
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Om'sirik
Zone: K'aresh
Cost: 11375 Resonance Crystals
mounts.desc: It's not world-devouringly bad, just misunderstood.

mounts.name: Thalassian Charger
mounts.srcText: Paladin
mounts.desc: Basking in the power of M'uru has strengthened its will.

mounts.name: Thalassian Warhorse
mounts.srcText: Paladin
mounts.desc: A loyal companion to any who would protect Silvermoon.

mounts.name: The Big G
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Chrome King Gallywix
Zone: Liberation of Undermine (Mythic)
mounts.desc: Doesn't actually seem like anything too special under the hood, but just wait until those goblins next door see you pull up for the next pool party.

mounts.name: The Bone Freezer
mounts.srcText:
Faction: Manaforge Vandals
Renown: 14
Location: Shadow Point
mounts.desc: Bitter rival to The Bone Melter, this creeper was ousted from their lair near Manaforge Omega after a crushing defeat. It now seeks to learn from the one that dethroned its greatest foe.

mounts.name: The Breaker's Song
mounts.srcText:
Zone: Siren Isle
Achievement: Isle Remember You
mounts.desc: 'Tis a rare moment in history when a sailor carves the very monster that left 'em stranded to die upon the bow of their ship. Our lot is a blasphemous and piddly bunch. To think one of us might have the humility to honor such a creature is damn near mad.

mounts.name: The Dreadwake
mounts.srcText: In-Game Shop
mounts.desc: A ship unlike any other, held aloft by a gift from an unknown kraken-faced god of the deeps.

mounts.name: The Headless Horseman's Burning Charger
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: The fires blaze on, in the steed's heart and soul, now take to the sky as a sight to behold.

mounts.name: The Headless Horseman's Chilling Charger
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: Through the air you will fly, on your foes you descend, this charger will carry you to deliver their end.

mounts.name: The Headless Horseman's Ghoulish Charger
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Loot-Filled Pumpkin
Holiday: Hallow's End
mounts.desc: Tricks have been played, your enemies beaten, this ghoulish charger awaits a treat, friend.

mounts.name: The Headless Horseman's Hallowed Charger
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: Your future's unknown, with ghosts in your past. With your steed at your side, how long can you last?

mounts.name: The Hivemind
mounts.srcText: Drop: The Hivemind
mounts.desc: A true union of minds.

mounts.name: The Topskimmer Special
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Smaks Topskimmer
Zone: Undermine
Cost: 11375 Resonance Crystals
mounts.desc: Smaks is sure this rocket won't explode mid-flight. Absolutely. Positively. 100%. Sure.

mounts.name: The Writhing Brood
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Zul'jan
Zone: Altar of Fangs
mounts.desc: A grotesque conglomerate of serpents, it has yielded to you after witnessing your battle against The Writhing Coil.

mounts.name: Thrayir, Eyes of the Siren
mounts.srcText: Zone: Siren Isle
mounts.desc: In a fit of rage and despair, Thrayir conjured a storm that would ravage the land and annihilate Cyrce's enemies. After nearly ten thousand years, the seafury tempest continues to roil as an echo of his power.

mounts.name: Thunder Bluff Kodo
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Doru Thunderhorn
Zone: Icecrown
Cost: 100 Champion's Seal
mounts.desc: An alpha member of the herd, this kodo is a prime example of the mighty creatures which thunder through Mulgore.

mounts.name: Thunder-Ridged Elekk
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: Even infusion with demonic magics could not break the spirits of these majestic beasts, and their twisted forms were never integrated into the Legion's service.

mounts.name: Thunderdrum Misfire
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Ando the Gat
Zone: Liberation of Undermine
Cost: 500g
mounts.desc: Recovered from the Cauldron's bleachers during a particularly gruesome clash. When asked if it was a dud, Torq's operator simply replied: 'Probably?'

mounts.name: Thunderhoof Celestial
mounts.srcText: In-Game Shop
mounts.desc: After the Thunder King's fall, his lingering thunder merged with the spirit of a white dragon. It strides on azure lightning, clouds swirling in its wake-where tyranny once reigned, now guardian light remains.

mounts.name: Thundering August Cloud Serpent
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Sage Whiteheart (Alliance)
Zone: Vale of Eternal Blossoms
Faction: The August Celestials - Exalted
Cost: 10000g
Vendor: Sage Lotusbloom (Horde)
Zone: Vale of Eternal Blossoms
Faction: The August Celestials - Exalted
Cost: 10000g
mounts.desc: From their infancy, Thundering Cloud Serpents are drawn to storms. They have been known to chase lightning through the blackened, roiling clouds, and to bathe in the pouring rain.

mounts.name: Thundering Cobalt Cloud Serpent
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Nalak
Location: Isle of Thunder
mounts.desc: This is a descendant of the irascible Nalak. Lightning erupts from its scales and arcs over the saddle. Dare you sit?

mounts.name: Thundering Jade Cloud Serpent
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Shay Pressler (Alliance)
Zone: Stormwind City
Cost: 3000g
Vendor: Goram (Horde)
Zone: Orgrimmar
Cost: 3000g
mounts.desc: From their infancy, Thundering Cloud Serpents are drawn to storms. They have been known to chase lightning through the blackened, roiling clouds, and to bathe in the pouring rain.

mounts.name: Thundering Onyx Cloud Serpent
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Huolon
Location: Timeless Isle
mounts.desc: This ebony cloud serpent is a lightning-wreathed vision of such rarity as to have driven many mortals to madness.

mounts.name: Thundering Ruby Cloud Serpent
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Alani
Zone: Vale of Eternal Blossoms
mounts.desc: From their infancy, Thundering Cloud Serpents are drawn to storms. They have been known to chase lightning through the blackened, roiling clouds, and to bathe in the pouring rain.

mounts.name: Timber Wolf
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Ogunaro Wolfrunner
Zone: Orgrimmar
Cost: 1g
mounts.desc: Can howl loudly enough to be heard for miles.

mounts.name: Timbered Sky Snake
mounts.srcText: In-Game Shop
mounts.desc: A living, breathing, flying work of art.

mounts.name: Time-Lost Proto-Drake
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Time-Lost Proto-Drake
Zone: The Storm Peaks
mounts.desc: The only reason for time is so that everything doesn't happen at once.

mounts.name: Timely Buzzbee
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Any Timewalking Vendor
Cost: 5000 Timewarped Badge
mounts.desc: Buzzing through the time punctual as ever, these Buzzbees harvest the errant sands of time and return them safely to the Timeways.

mounts.name: Tomb Stalker
mounts.srcText:
Drop: King Dazar
Zone: Kings' Rest (Mythic)
Treasure: Challenger's Cache
Zone: Kings' Rest
mounts.desc: These fierce beasts are entombed alongside kings so they may carry their masters through the afterlife.

mounts.name: Topaz Skyfang
mounts.srcText: Drop: The Coiled Isle Rare Creatures
mounts.desc: This elusive wind serpent likes to hide in the forest canopy before stooping down on unsuspecting prey.

mounts.name: Tortured Gorger
mounts.srcText:
Zones: Val and Naigtal
Achievement: Heroic Showdowns
Vendor: Kifaan
Cost: 15 Voidlight Marl
mounts.desc: Both domanaar and ethereals have tried to cage this devourer. Each time they have failed. Now, soaked in the energies of the void, this tormented gorger is ready to unleash havoc.

mounts.name: Trader's Gilded Brutosaur
mounts.srcText: In-Game Shop
mounts.desc: Morten and Killia never realized how much their new trading partnership across faction lines would pay off. That is until the day they were able to purchase this fine creature to aid them in their travels. And of course do it in gilded style.

mounts.name: Trained Icehoof
mounts.srcText: Source: Garrison Stables
mounts.desc: It wasn't until you owned this mount that you understood how much the world of Draenor would test you. Clefthoof hair gets in everything!

mounts.name: Trained Meadowstomper
mounts.srcText: Quest: Garrison Stables
mounts.desc: The draenei perfected elekk husbandry long ago, adorning the creatures with Light-infused crystals to make them more docile.

mounts.name: Trained Riverwallow
mounts.srcText: Quest: Garrison Stables
mounts.desc: Riverwallows are one of the heartiest beasts on Draenor, resulting in their increased stamina and distinctive coloring.

mounts.name: Trained Rocktusk
mounts.srcText: Quest: Garrison Stables
mounts.desc: Thoroughly trained in how to snort, trot, and stomp on the faces of its enemies.

mounts.name: Trained Silverpelt
mounts.srcText: Location: Garrison Stables
mounts.desc: Prized for its intelligence, this breed of talbuk can be trained to execute defensive kicks and gorings in battle.

mounts.name: Trained Snarler
mounts.srcText: Quest: Garrison Stables
mounts.desc: Enormously cute as a puppy. Slightly less so now.

mounts.name: Translocated Gorger
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Devourer Swarms
Zone: Tazavesh
mounts.desc: Accidentally transported when the Brokers moved Tazavesh, this gorger has found a new world ripe with potential sources of energy, such as anima beacons...and riders.

mounts.name: Traveler's Tundra Mammoth
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Mei Francis
Zone: Crystalsong Forest
Cost: 20000g
mounts.desc: Ancient manuscripts depict merchants traveling across the frozen tundra with these colossal beasts, leading scholars to believe they are the first domesticated mounts.

mounts.name: Traveler's Tundra Mammoth
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Mei Francis
Zone: Crystalsong Forest
Cost: 20000g
mounts.desc: Riders and merchants alike trust only this strong and steadfast mammoth to carry them safely across the frigid tundra.

mounts.name: Treetop Highmountain Eagle
mounts.srcText: World Event: WoW Remix: Legion
mounts.desc: The majestic eagle is a symbol of pride for the Highmountain tribes. This great beast's ability to carry tauren on their backs speaks to the sheer strength and size of the creatures of Highmountain.

mounts.name: Tropical Riding Crane
mounts.srcText: World Event: WoW Remix: Mists of Pandaria
mounts.desc: This Jade Forest native uses its coloration as camouflage.

mounts.name: Tundra Icehoof
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Vengeance, Deathtalon, Terrorfist, Doomroller
Zone: Tanaan Jungle
mounts.desc: A translucent layer of down hair covers this breed's leathery hide, acting as the perfect insulation for cold environments.

mounts.name: Turbo-Charged Flying Machine
mounts.srcText: Profession: Engineering
mounts.desc: Only the most talented engineers have the courage and the mental stamina to create a flying machine that boasts stability and safety. Turbo-charging one is just crazy!

mounts.name: Turbostrider
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Rillie Spindlenut
Zone: Icecrown
Cost: 500g
mounts.desc: The mirror's not so you can look back, but so your foes can see something besides your tailpipes. -Rillie Spindlenut

mounts.name: Turquoise Courser
mounts.srcText: World Event: WoW Remix: Legion
mounts.desc: Named for its uniquely colored eyes that seem to pierce your soul, the turquoise courser shows more intelligence than her dreamrunner cousins and is known to be an excellent judge of character.

mounts.name: Turquoise Raptor
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Zjolnir
Zone: Durotar
Cost: 1g
mounts.desc: Bred from the fiercest stock anywhere and guaranteed not to bite (much).

mounts.name: Tuskarr Shoreglider
mounts.srcText: Promotion
mounts.desc: The Tuskarr learned long ago that some of the bones of the sea creatures they hunted were light and buoyant, making for effective glider materials.

mounts.name: Twilight Avenger
mounts.srcText: Drop: Island Expeditions
mounts.desc: Little is known about the fate of the twilight dragonflight, though they seem to exist in numbers in Grim Batol to this day.

mounts.name: Twilight Courser

Achievement: Treasures of Harandar
Category: Midnight
mounts.desc: Catching a chloroceros mane leaf mid-air is considered a sign of good luck among the Haranir. The more vivacious the leaf, the greater the luck.

mounts.name: Vivid Chloroceros
mounts.srcText:
Quest: Vivid Chloroceros
Zone: Harandar
mounts.desc: The healthier the chloroceros, the more vivid the foliage.

mounts.name: Void-Corrupted Hex Eagle
mounts.srcText: Ritual Site: Broken Throne
mounts.desc: A vile ritual can give the ritual master great power. It can also give the target of the ritual great power. This can sometimes go well or poorly for the ritual master.

mounts.name: Void-Corrupted Lynx
mounts.srcText: Ritual Sites: Treasure and Rare Spoils
mounts.desc: The Eversong lynxes are known for their curiosity and this one especially. Sneaking into supply stores, and treasure boxes around ritual sites has changed it forever. Anyone who manages to leash it will have a feisty mount on their hands.

mounts.name: Void-Crystal Panther
mounts.srcText: Profession: Jewelcrafting
mounts.desc: Although many precious gems have been corrupted by void energies in horrific visions, Master Jewelcrafters can still utilize them to craft mighty panther steeds.

mounts.name: Void-Forged Overseer
mounts.srcText: Promotion
mounts.desc: After the Sepulcher of the First Ones was opened, this construct of the First Ones was stolen by the brokers and sold to the ethereals in a transaction at the Veiled Market. Under the ethereals' ingenious modifications, it integrated the mysteries of the Aether, gliding through the air with extraordinary elegance, leaving behind a trail of shimmering stardust.

mounts.name: Void-Forged Stallion
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Void-Forged Stallion
Zone: Vision of Stormwind (Revisited)
mounts.desc: Forged just as their shoes once were, these beasts are less horses now and void energy in their likeness.

mounts.name: Void-Razed Elekk
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: Their temperament is as wild as the twisted forces that warped their creation and they only serve who they choose.

mounts.name: Void-Scarred Gryphon
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Void-Scarred Gryphon
Zone: Vision of Stormwind (Revisited)
mounts.desc: Abandoned by its trainers the Void-Scarred Gryphon scrounged on any scrap of food that remained, most corrupted by the void. With the void now sustaining them, they only land when their fickle tastes are satisfied by untainted food that they just remember enjoying.

mounts.name: Void-Scarred Lynx
mounts.srcText: Drop: Confiscated Cultist's Bag
mounts.desc: Taming lynxes is a practice that the Arathi have honed for years. While the Nightfall cultists remain devoted to their cause, they are still ones for passing that tradition along.

mounts.name: Void-Scarred Pack Mother
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Void-Scarred Pack Mother
Zone: Vision of Orgrimmar (Revisited)
mounts.desc: Fighting her corrupted handlers this pack mother freed herself and her pups. However, freedom from their handlers did not free them from the void in this lost place. She taught her pups to be even more dangerous beasts, and they now stalk throughout Orgrimmar fetching her food as all compete to survive.

mounts.name: Void-Scarred Windrider
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Void-Scarred Windrider
Zone: Vision of Orgrimmar (Revisited)
mounts.desc: When the void energies were released, it drove most windriders feral. They killed each other and their trainers. The gates to their roost were locked by the survivors. Some surviving windriders can still be seen gliding above, but none dare return to their new deadly domain to see what remains.

mounts.name: Void-Touched Hawkstrider
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Sergeant Vornin
Zone: Silvermoon City
Renown: Ritual Sites Rank 8
Cost: 4500 Voidlight Marl
mounts.desc: Almost no beasts are immune to the void's touch. A few of our scouts' hawkstriders have been affected by the void. I have been observing them now for a bit and they are still fit for service. In some ways they are even more fit for the kind of work you are up to. - Sergeant Vornin

mounts.name: Void-Touched Snapdragon
mounts.srcText: Ritual Site: Daggerspine Point
mounts.desc: The snapdragon is a resilient creature and loyal by nature. This has made them preferred companions of the naga. However, their latest ritual has made this snapdragon ready for a new home.

mounts.name: Voidbound Stormray
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Void Researcher Anomander
Zone: Voidstorm
Cost: 8000 Voidlight Marl
mounts.desc: With its razor-sharp teeth, the Voidbound Stormray look eager to bite you. It will, but only if you let it.

mounts.name: Voidfire Deathcycle
mounts.srcText:
Zone: Vision of Stormwind (Revisited)
Zone: Vision of Orgrimmar (Revisited)
mounts.desc: The prized possession of Haymar the devout. Unclear if he would be anything if not for his epic void bike. Formerly assigned to patrolling the streets of Stormwind after its fall.

mounts.name: Voidlight Surger
mounts.srcText: Promotion
mounts.desc: Shifting between radiant light and consuming void, it surges through the skies in a dance of balance.

mounts.name: Voidmancer's Starcarver
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: A Trip Around the Stars
Zone: Val
Vendor: Kifaan
Cost: 15 Voidlight Marl
mounts.desc: This pinnacle of Voidmancer transport technology was once a symbol of status and power among high ranking domanaar. After its creator mysteriously vanished, it was viewed as unseemly when used on core worlds gatherings.

mounts.name: Voidtalon of the Dark Star
mounts.srcText: Drop: Voidtalon Egg
mounts.desc: Corrupted by the presence of the Dark Star in Draenor, the Voidtalons resisted being broken by the Shadowmoon Clan and were ultimately destroyed by Ner'zhul. Only a single egg remains, lost in the void.

mounts.name: Voidwing Dragonhawk
mounts.srcText: Promotion
mounts.desc: Cutting through the skies, it flies with silent wings and eyes that glow with the echo of forgotten stars.

mounts.name: Volcanic Stone Drake
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Glory of the Cataclysm Hero
Category: Dungeons & Raids
mounts.desc: Fire can transform stone in exciting ways, but never let the Stonemother know I said that. -Earthcaller Yevaa

mounts.name: Voldunai Dunescraper
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Hoarder Jena
Zone: Vol'dun
Faction: Voldunai - Exalted
Cost: 90000g
mounts.desc: These brightly-colored fliers are rarely captured in the wild due to their naturally untrusting natures.

mounts.name: Voracious Gorger
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Glory of the Shadowlands Hero
Category: Dungeons & Raids
mounts.desc: The devourers are presumed to have their origins in the In-Between, a space between the lands of the Shadowlands that few have explored.

mounts.name: Voyaging Wilderling
mounts.srcText: Achievement: Awakening the Dragonflight Raids
mounts.desc: These playful visitors from another realm thrive while traveling to new lands with new friends.

mounts.name: Vulpine Familiar
mounts.srcText: In-Game Shop
mounts.desc: A fiercely intelligent and curious species, these fox-like creatures have travelled the Great Dark Beyond and found their way to Azeroth. Drawn to Azeroth's champions, they seek adventure and companionship.

mounts.name: Wailing Banshee's Charger
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: These shadow-graced steeds silently carry the Priests of the Forgotten Shadow through the darkened woods of Tirisfal.

mounts.name: Wakener's Runestag
mounts.srcText:
Covenant: Night Fae
Zone: Ardenweald
mounts.desc: Runestags enjoy lying near wildseeds. The Wakeners believe they can hear the sleepers' dreams. These runestags display a range of emotions in their vigil, signaling the dreams or nightmares of the spirits within.

mounts.name: Wandering Ancient
mounts.srcText: Promotion
mounts.desc: A staunch defender of the forests of Azeroth, the ancients are also known for their glorious canopies of leaves, which change color with the seasons.

mounts.name: War-Bred Tauralus
mounts.srcText:
Covenant: Necrolord
Zone: Maldraxxus
mounts.desc: The soldiers of Maldraxxus protect the Shadowlands, and require a mount that is both capable and calm when faced with overwhelming odds.

mounts.name: Warforged Nightmare
mounts.srcText: In-Game Shop
mounts.desc: A nightmarish steed of hardened steel and vengeful spirits, this companion will follow you to the depths of the Firelands and back without complaint.

mounts.name: Warhorse
mounts.srcText: Paladin
mounts.desc: Trained to stand firm in righteous combat.

mounts.name: Warlord's Deathwheel
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Warlord's Deathwheel
Category: Feats of Strength
mounts.desc: Often referred to as the "Goblin Lawn Mower", this growling behemoth treats enemies like they are made of grass... ready to be mown down.

mounts.name: Warsong Direfang
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Vengeance, Deathtalon, Terrorfist, Doomroller
Zone: Tanaan Jungle
mounts.desc: Has a will of iron but is a sweetheart if you give it a clefthoof bone to chew on.

mounts.name: Warstitched Darkhound
mounts.srcText: Adventures: Shadowlands
mounts.desc: These warhounds are crafted by the House of Constructs to carry any rider into the thick of battle, rending and tearing enemy mounts all the while.

mounts.name: Waste Marauder
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Rotfeaster
Zone: Uldum
mounts.desc: Larger than most of its kin, this vulture has shown sick and strong beasts alike why they need to fear the skies.

mounts.name: Wastewander Skyterror
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Provisioner Qorra
Zone: Uldum
Faction: Uldum Accord - Exalted
Cost: 24000g
mounts.desc: Doubting a Wastewander Skyterror's capabilities is a quick way to find yourself missing a limb.

mounts.name: Wastewarped Deathwalker
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Shadowlands Keystone Master: Season Three
Category: Dungeons
mounts.desc: Raw swirling energy bound together into a cohesive form, it will only bend to the will of those strong enough to bind it.

mounts.name: Wen Lo, the River's Edge
mounts.srcText: In-Game Shop
mounts.desc: The rivers of Pandaria, like Wen Lo, are unpredictable in nature. They may remain calm, bringing water to the crops, or flood, bringing ruin. Wen Lo reminds us that we must adapt to the challenges of life.

mounts.name: White Kodo
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Harb Clawhoof
Zone: Mulgore
Cost: 1g
mounts.desc: "The kodo is the backbone of our people. Wherever the Horde goes - in trade, settlement, or war - there you will find the mighty kodo." - Harb Clawhoof

mounts.name: White Polar Bear
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Hyldnir Spoils
Location: The Storm Peaks
mounts.desc: The frost vrykul believe that wearing a necklace of polar bear claws will grant them otherworldly strength.

mounts.name: White Ram
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Veron Amberstill
Zone: Dun Morogh
Cost: 1g
mounts.desc: Male rams will often smash their thick skulls against each other for hours to impress a female. In that way, they're very similar to dwarves.

mounts.name: White Riding Camel
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Landro Longshot
Location: Booty Bay
mounts.desc: Fennimore Quigley is credited with milking the first camel and breaking the record for "longest unintentional flight," all in the same afternoon.

mounts.name: White Riding Goat
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Gina Mudclaw
Zone: Timeless Isle
Faction: The Tillers - Exalted
Cost: 3250g
Vendor: Gina Mudclaw
Zone: Valley of the Four Winds
Faction: The Tillers - Exalted
Cost: 3250g
mounts.desc: It takes unflagging patience and a gentle touch to train obstinate mountain goats for riding.

mounts.name: White Riding Talbuk
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Provisioner Nasela
Zone: Nagrand, Outland
Faction: The Mag'har - Exalted
Cost: 70g
Vendor: Trader Narasu
Zone: Nagrand, Outland
Faction: The Kurenai - Exalted
Cost: 70g
mounts.desc: The orcs once hunted these graceful herd animals as part of the om'riggor rite of passage ceremony.

mounts.name: White Skeletal Warhorse
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Eliza Killian
Zone: Icecrown
Cost: 500g
mounts.desc: When fallen heroes are raised into undeath, so too are their horses.

mounts.name: White War Talbuk
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Provisioner Nasela
Zone: Nagrand, Outland
Faction: The Mag'har - Exalted
Cost: 100g
Vendor: Trader Narasu
Zone: Nagrand, Outland
Faction: The Kurenai - Exalted
Cost: 100g
mounts.desc: Despite their docile nature, talbuks have been known to gore seasoned warriors to death when threatened.

mounts.name: White War Wolf
mounts.srcText:
Horde
Drop: Time Rifts
Vendor: Warden Krizzik
Zone: Tyrhold Reservoir
Cost: 3000 Paracausal Flakes
Alliance
Item: Gift of the White War Wolf
mounts.desc: Can a wolf's hunger ever be satiated? These lupine brutes seek and devour the enemies of the Horde.

mounts.name: Whoofle Bramblewing
mounts.srcText: In-Game Shop
mounts.desc: Patient and precious, this feathered friend is also just a little warmer than most mounts. Cozy ride, but keeping a close eye on your tailfeathers is recommended.

mounts.name: Wick
mounts.srcText:
Drop: The Darkness
Zone: Darkflame Cleft (Mythic)
Drop: Challenger's Cache
Zone: Darkflame Cleft
mounts.desc: Rescued from the ruthless charge of Ol' Waxbeard and the looming threat of The Darkness, now able to nibble on loose wax in peace.

mounts.name: Wicked Swarmer
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Wrathion
Zone: Chamber of Heart
Cost: 100000 Corrupted Mementos
mounts.desc: When the Void reached out, the Aqir were formed in its terrible image.

mounts.name: Widow's Undercrawler
mounts.srcText:
Vendors: Yamas the Provider, Bobbin
Zone: Azj-Kahet
Cost: 2020 Kej
mounts.desc: Surface-dwelling children often profess desires for a pony or wolf of their own upon reaching certain milestones of age. A young Widow Arak'nai had similar ambitions, though her tastes would likely be considered eclectic by some standards.

mounts.name: Wild Dreamrunner
mounts.srcText: Drop: Dreamweaver Cache
mounts.desc: Dreamrunners flit between this world and the Emerald Dream at will, reveling in their wild nature.

mounts.name: Wild Glimmerfur Prowler
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Valfir the Unrelenting
Covenant: Night Fae
Zone: Ardenweald
mounts.desc: This prowler's brilliant green coat distinguishes it from the blues and purples of Ardenweald, making it much easier for others of its kind to see through the midnight woods.

mounts.name: Wild Goretusk
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Z'tenga the Walker
Zone: Tanaan Jungle
Faction: The Saberstalkers - Honored
Cost: 1000 Blackfang Claw
mounts.desc: If you want a gentle ride, go find a "tame happytusk" or something.

mounts.name: Wild Hunt Legsplitter
mounts.srcText:
Drop: War Chest of the Wild Hunt
Zone: The Maw
mounts.desc: Integrated into the depleted forces of the Wild Hunt, the fawn riders quickly found that the gorm's powerful mandibles were perfect for cutting down close enemy ranks.

mounts.name: Wildseed Cradle
mounts.srcText:
Treasure: Cache of the Moon
Zone: Ardenweald
mounts.desc: The most precious cargo in all Ardenweald, the wildseeds, are cradled by this lovingly-crafted cart. It is imbued with anima to allow it to hover over the ground.

mounts.name: Windborne Velocidrake
mounts.srcText: Achievement: Dragon Isles: Windborne Velocidrake
mounts.desc: The long talons of the velocidrake give it an edge on the plains.

mounts.name: Windborne Velocidrake
mounts.srcText: Achievement: Dragon Isles: Windborne Velocidrake
mounts.desc: The long talons of the velocidrake give it an edge on the plains.

mounts.name: Winding Slitherdrake
mounts.srcText: Achievement: A Serpentine Discovery
mounts.desc: These drakes feel at home in the depths of the earth and the far reaches of the sky.

mounts.name: Winding Slitherdrake
mounts.srcText: Achievement: A Serpentine Discovery
mounts.desc: These drakes feel at home in the depths of the earth and the far reaches of the sky.

mounts.name: Winged Guardian
mounts.srcText: In-Game Shop
mounts.desc: Unearthed recently in an ancient tomb, this mighty winged lion may have once served one of the ancient Tol'vir princes.

mounts.name: Winged Steed of the Ebon Blade
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Dread Commander Thalanor
Zone: Eastern Plaguelands
Cost: 1000g
mounts.desc: Dead or alive, you're coming with me.

mounts.name: Winter Harvesthog
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: Winter Harvesthogs are primarily nocturnal creatures. They are slightly slower than other harvesthogs, but their endurance is unmatched.

mounts.name: Winter Night Dreamsaber
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Dreamseed Cache
Zone: Emerald Dream
mounts.desc: These nocturnal dreamsabers carry the chill of winter with them and will often hibernate for days on end if not otherwise awoken.

mounts.name: Winter Wilderling
mounts.srcText:
Covenant: Night Fae
Vendor: Duchess Mynx
Zone: Korthia
Cost: 1000 Stygia
Achievement: On the Offensive
mounts.desc: Wilderlings serve as support units in battle, preserving their allies and rendering enemy magics useless.

mounts.name: Winterborn Runestag
mounts.srcText:
Covenant: Night Fae
Zone: Ardenweald
mounts.desc: Winterborn runestags are blessed by the Winter Queen herself. Their runes flare brilliantly when predators are nearby, warning the entire herd.

mounts.name: Winterspring Frostsaber
mounts.srcText:
Quest: They Grow Up So Fast
Zone: Winterspring
mounts.desc: Taming this savage breed requires patience, strength, and a large supply of fake mice and twine.

mounts.name: Wintry Witchwick's Rider
mounts.srcText: In-Game Shop
mounts.desc: Sleek, stylish, and spooky, the Witchwick Rider offers a smooth and surprisingly comfortable ride, thanks to the ergonomic saddle requested by many a spellcaster seeking cushioned support.

mounts.name: Witherbark Direwing
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Nimar the Slayer
Zone: Arathi Highlands
mounts.desc: Only a handful of these giant bats remain in the Arathi Highlands, carefully raised by the Witherbark forest trolls who first brought them here.

mounts.name: Witherbark Pango
mounts.srcText: Drop: Zul'Aman Rare Creatures
mounts.desc: This rather rambunctious Pango escaped from the Witherbark Tribe after having its armor affixed. Finders keepers!

mounts.name: Witherbark Warbear Mother
mounts.srcText: Ritual Site: Broken Throne
mounts.desc: This warbear mother was captured by the Twilight's Blade while protecting her cub. Her continued separation from her cub is only angering her more. Anyone who manages to reunite her with her cub will have her eternal loyalty.

mounts.name: Witherhide Cliffstomper
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Trader Araanda
Zone: Lunarfall
Cost: 20000g
Vendor: Trader Darakk
Zone: Frostwall
Cost: 20000g
mounts.desc: Tiny notches cover the hooves of this variation of clefthoof, allowing it to safely scale mountainous regions in search of food.

mounts.name: Wonderwing 2.0
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Battle for Azeroth Pathfinder, Part Two
Category: Battle for Azeroth
mounts.desc: Don't ask what happened to the first one -- Mechagon technology is still gnome technology!

mounts.name: Wondrous Wavewhisker
mounts.srcText: In-Game Shop
mounts.desc: They say one of these magical fish is born when a fisherfolk dreams of the one that got away... and grows bigger with each retelling of the tale.

mounts.name: Wooly Mammoth
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Mei Francis
Zone: Crystalsong Forest
Cost: 10000g
mounts.desc: This wild variant of the mammoth is not bred for riding. Most wooly mammoths are captured in the wild and tamed by their riders, resulting in a fierce, cunning mount.

mounts.name: Wooly Mammoth
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Mei Francis
Zone: Crystalsong Forest
Cost: 10000g
mounts.desc: Directly descended from the original progenitor of the mammoth race, wooly mammoths are considered more feral and primal than their shorter-haired cousins.

mounts.name: Wooly White Rhino
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Landro Longshot
Location: Booty Bay
mounts.desc: Captured by Toby "Mother Goose" Ironbolt on the Borean Tundra, this shaggy beast carries an enormous grudge after being bridled by a gnome.

mounts.name: Wretched Fel Bat
mounts.srcText: World Event: WoW Remix: Legion
mounts.desc: Its bracers seem to be a bit snug.

mounts.name: Wriggling Parasite
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Glory of the Ny'alotha Raider
Category: Dungeons & Raids
mounts.desc: It's so wiggly! Just looking at it move is chaotic and unnerving.

mounts.name: X-45 Heartbreaker
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Heart-Shaped Box
Holiday: Love is in the Air
mounts.desc: Apothecary Hummel painted this masterpiece bright pink for an unrequited love.

mounts.name: X-51 Nether-Rocket
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Landro Longshot
Location: Booty Bay
mounts.desc: First designed as a booster for a much larger rocket, the X-51 was determined to give the perfect thrust capacity for a single rider payload.

mounts.name: X-51 Nether-Rocket X-TREME
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Landro Longshot
Location: Booty Bay
mounts.desc: What it lacks in safety features it more than makes up for in speed and style. Not for the faint of heart.

mounts.name: X-53 Touring Rocket
mounts.srcText: Trading Post
mounts.desc: Riding a giant cylinder filled with highly explosive goblin rocket fuel all by yourself is just crazy...so bring a friend.

mounts.name: X-995 Mechanocat
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Pascal-K1N6
Zone: Mechagon
mounts.desc: The X-995 is the ultimate in customizeable feline robo-companionship.

mounts.name: Xinlao
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Anh-De the Loyal
Zone: Vale of Eternal Blossoms
mounts.desc: The only thing stronger than a quilen's loyalty is its fierce devotion to making sure it covers its owner in kisses.

mounts.name: Xiwyllag ATV
mounts.srcText: Profession: Blacksmithing & Engineering
mounts.desc: It was said that this invention was modeled after the likeness of a very wealthy goblin. Although others don't really see the resemblance.

mounts.name: Xy Trustee's Gearglider
mounts.srcText: Source: [REDACTED]
mounts.desc: Cartel Xy trades in many currencies; none are as valuable to its inner circle as loyalty.

mounts.name: Yellow Marsh Hopper
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Gottum
Zone: Nazmir
Cost: 333333g
mounts.desc: No one makes giant, slimy spawns like Krag'wa the Huge.

mounts.name: Yellow Qiraji Battle Tank
mounts.srcText:
Drop: World Drop
Location: Temple of Ahn'Qiraj
mounts.desc: This (relatively) domesticated silithid is at home only in the desert sands of Ahn'Qiraj.

mounts.name: Yellow Scouting Ottuk
mounts.srcText:
Faction: Iskaara Tuskarr
Renown: 25
Vendor: Tatto
Location: Iskaara
Cost: 2 Mastodon Tusk 2 Aquatic Maw 750 Dragon Isles Supplies
mounts.desc: The yellow scouting ottuk love to hide and they blend in well to their surroundings. When not 'playing' hide and seek with their riders, they are perfect companions when scouting enemy encampments.

mounts.name: Yellow War Ottuk
mounts.srcText:
Faction: Iskaara Tuskarr
Renown: 30
Vendor: Tatto
Location: Iskaara
Cost: 5 Mastodon Tusk 5 Aquatic Maw 1000 Dragon Isles Supplies
mounts.desc: The yellow ottuks of the Azure Span are sleek, sneaky, and smart. Those trained for war are the finest tuskarr cavalry mounts, equally capable on the ground and in the waters.

mounts.name: Yu'lei, Daughter of Jade
mounts.srcText:
Vendor: Mistweaver Xia
Zone: Timeless Isle
Cost: 5000 Timewarped Badge
mounts.desc: Warmth and wisdom emanate from this great creature, which glows like moonlight passing through the finest jade.

mounts.name: Zandalari Direhorn
mounts.srcText: Achievement: Allied Races: Zandalari Troll
mounts.desc: The Zandalari pride themselves on being the first to raise and train all of the most ferocious lizards on Azeroth.

mounts.name: Zenet Hatchling
mounts.srcText:
Drop: Zenet Egg
Zone: Ohn'ahran Plains
mounts.desc: The hardest winds begin with a gust and a flap.

mounts.name: Zereth Overseer
mounts.srcText:
Drop: The Jailer
Zone: Sepulcher of the First Ones
Difficulty: Mythic
mounts.desc: Enigmatic and aloof, this construct of the First Ones flies on a graceful stream of perfect geometric understanding.

mounts.name: Zovaal's Soul Eater
mounts.srcText:
Achievement: Back from the Beyond
Category: Expansion Features
mounts.desc: "Was I a good boy?" the soul asked Zovaal. "No. I'm told you were the worst."
